doc: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

tlabel: Health Care Organization, Revenue Net of Patient Service Revenue Provisions
doc: Amount of patient service revenue recognized, net of contractual allowances and discounts, less the provision for bad debts related to patient service revenue plus all other revenue.

tlabel: Inventory Valuation Reserves
doc: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials
doc: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items held by the entity which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. Includes supplies used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

tlabel: Inventory Write-down
doc: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

tlabel: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
doc: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

tlabel: Investment Banking Revenue
doc: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

tlabel: Investment Building and Building Improvements
doc: Aggregate of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of investments in building and building improvements.

tlabel: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
doc: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

tlabel: Repossessed Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance; includes real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts.

tlabel: Foreclosed Real Estate Expense
doc: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Current
doc: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
doc: Costs incurred to effect a business combination which have been expensed during the period. Such costs could include business integration costs, systems integration and conversion costs, and severance and other employee-related costs.

tlabel: Development in Process
doc: The current amount of expenditures for a real estate project that has not yet been completed.

tlabel: Direct Costs of Leased and Rented Property or Equipment
doc: Amount of expense incurred and directly related to generating revenue by lessor from operating lease of rented property and equipment.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date, including liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, compensation costs, payroll taxes and fringe benefits (other than pension and postretirement obligations), contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer), including liabilities for compensation costs, fringe benefits other than pension and postretirement obligations, rent, contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Settlements Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Lease Acquisition Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Leasing Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from lessees arising from lease agreements.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Life Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in life insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans, Deferred Income
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in net unamortized loan origination fees and other fees that are collected at origination but recorded as income over the life of the loan.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of loans or securitized loans that are held with the intention to sell in the near future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Long-term Receivables, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Margin Deposits Outstanding
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in money or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivative position.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of mortgage loans that are held with the intention to sell or be securitized in the near future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed by the reporting entry in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion (due within one year or one business cycle, whichever is longer) of the amount owed by the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from note holders for outstanding loans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Participating Mortgage Loans, Participation Liabilities, Amount
doc: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

tlabel: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

tlabel: Partners' Capital
doc: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Acquisitions
doc: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
doc: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Deferred Compensation
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to deferred compensation. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
doc: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account
doc: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Amount
doc: The total amount of distributions to limited partners.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
doc: The number of limited partner units issued.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
doc: The number of limited partner units outstanding.

tlabel: Long-term Line of Credit
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed tax basis earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution
doc: Amount of dividend distribution from ordinary income and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

tlabel: Investment Company, Expense Offset Arrangement
doc: Amount of expense reduction under arrangement in which third party explicitly reduces its fee by specified amount for service provided in exchange for use of investment company's assets.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Measure of Progress
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in measure of progress which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
doc: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

tlabel: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
doc: Including both current and noncurrent portions, Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Deposit Assets
doc: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

tlabel: Deposit Contracts, Liabilities
doc: Carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts received by the insurer or reinsurer from the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

tlabel: Deposit Liability, Current
doc: The current portion, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of deposits held other than customer deposits.

tlabel: Deposits
doc: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

tlabel: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share
doc: Per share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss).

tlabel: Investment Company, Net Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in net assets of investment company.

tlabel: Direct Operating Costs
doc: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

tlabel: Direct Operating Maintenance Supplies Costs
doc: Costs of maintenance supplies used that are directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

tlabel: Cost, Direct Tax and License
doc: Amount of tax incurred and cost of license directly related to good produced or service rendered.

tlabel: Direct-to-television Film Costs
doc: The amount of direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a direct-to-television film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

tlabel: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
doc: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

tlabel: Loss on Contracts
doc: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

tlabel: Loss on Sale of Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

tlabel: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
doc: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Line of Credit, Current
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Costs to Dispose of Assets and Liabilities
doc: Amount of estimated accrued costs to dispose of assets or other items expected to be sold in liquidation.

tlabel: Estimated Litigation Liability, Current
doc: Carrying amount of reserve for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid within one year of the date of the statement of financial position.

tlabel: Litigation Settlement, Expense
doc: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

tlabel: Loan Portfolio Expense
doc: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

tlabel: Loan Processing Fee
doc: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
doc: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of assets used to generate operating income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all assets and liabilities used in operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Insurance Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in insurance liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Loans
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Policyholder Funds
doc: The change in other policyholder funds recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
doc: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, before Tax, after Adjustments, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, before tax, after adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Amortized Cost, before Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount, before other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) accretion, of investment in debt securities measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

tlabel: Asset Impairment Charges
doc: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation
doc: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
doc: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
doc: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
doc: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount Capitalized
doc: Amount of cost capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash Used to Settle Award
doc: Aggregate cash paid by the entity during the period to settle equity instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
doc: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
doc: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares
doc: Represents the carrying amount of shares held by the ESOP as of the balance sheet date in which no ESOP participant has a vested interest and no lender has a claim.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Realized
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Unrealized
doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Loss, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized loss recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
doc: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
doc: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Dividend
doc: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Investment Expense
doc: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

tlabel: Investment Income, Net
doc: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
doc: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Nonoperating
doc: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in over (under) Energy Recovery
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the asset or liability created by an over or under recovery. An over under-recovery means that the basic energy price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less (over) or more (under) than the basic energy price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
doc: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal officers, directors and stockholders may be combined in the customer captions if they are not material and the combination is disclosed in the oath that is required to accompany the annual audited FOCUS Report.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Premiums Receivable
doc: The change in the premium receivable balance on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expenses, Other
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
doc: The change in prepaid reinsurance premiums recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Casualty Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in property and casualty insurance liabilities balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Other Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of cash payments due to taxing authorities for non-income-related taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables under Repurchase Agreements
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity under agreements to sell and repurchase securities.

tlabel: Accounts Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
doc: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount for accounts payable to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties
doc: Amount for accounts payable to related parties.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of accounts payable to related parties, due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amount of receivables arising from transactions with related parties.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount of receivables arising from transactions with related parties due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
doc: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
doc: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
doc: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Reissued
doc: Value of units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the monetary value of these units which were reissued during the period.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units
doc: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Contributed
doc: Units contributed by each class of partners during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
doc: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units
doc: Total units issued during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
doc: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Reissued
doc: Units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the number of these units which were reissued during the period.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Number of Units
doc: Number of units issued for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

tlabel: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year One
doc: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Deposits Assets
doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment in the future.

tlabel: Deposits Assets, Current
doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment within one year or during the operating cycle, if shorter.

tlabel: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Deposits, Domestic
doc: The aggregate of all domestic interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Deposits, Money Market Deposits and Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
doc: Amount of deposits in accounts that offer many of the same services as checking accounts although transactions may be somewhat more limited, share some of the characteristics of a money market fund and are insured by the Federal government, also known as money market accounts. Also includes amount of deposits in interest-bearing transaction accounts at banks or savings and loans, that are restricted in regard to ownership and can usually only be held by individuals, nonprofit entities and governments. Negotiable order of withdrawal accounts differ from money market demand accounts as they typically have higher reserve requirements and no limit on the number of checks that can be written.

tlabel: Deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
doc: Amount of deposits in interest-bearing transaction accounts at banks or savings and loans, that are restricted in regard to ownership and can usually only be held by individuals, nonprofit entities and governments. Negotiable order of withdrawal accounts differ from money market demand accounts as they typically have higher reserve requirements and no limit on the number of checks that can be written.

tlabel: Deposits, Savings Deposits
doc: Amount of interest bearing deposits with no stated maturity, which may include passbook and statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs).

tlabel: Deposits with Clearing Organizations and Others, Securities
doc: The amount of securities on deposit with clearing organizations and other entities which provide services necessary to operations of the Company. This item would include, for instance, securities advanced as refundable collateral for securities borrowed.

tlabel: Depreciation
doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

tlabel: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

tlabel: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability
doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
doc: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Current
doc: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as current.

tlabel: Contribution of Property
doc: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Contributions in Aid of Construction
doc: Developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities will provide the entity with cash, or in some cases property, to extend its services to their properties. Nonrefundable contributions are recorded as contributions in aid of construction ("CIAC").

tlabel: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
doc: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Conversion of Stock, Amount Converted
doc: The value of the stock converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued
doc: The value of the financial instrument issued [noncash or part noncash] in the conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Assets
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

tlabel: Assets, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Gain (Loss) on Transactions in Deferred Shares
doc: The difference between cost and fair value added or subtracted from paid-in capital, arising from contribution of shares to an ESOP or commitments-to-release ESOP shares.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Committed-to-be-Released Shares
doc: The shares that, although not legally released, will be released by a future scheduled and committed debt service payment and will be allocated to employees for service rendered in the current accounting period. The ESOP documents typically define the period of service to which the shares relate. ESOP shares are released to compensate employees directly, to settle employer liabilities for other employee benefits, and to replace dividends on allocated shares that are used for debt service.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
doc: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Transfers and Changes
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale, from reclassification, impairment, donation, or changes classified as other. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Inventory
doc: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to inventory acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Cash and Equivalents
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, acquired at the acquisition date. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Management Fee Expense
doc: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

tlabel: Management Fee Payable
doc: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs (revenues) to the balance sheet. This element is a the increase (decrease) of regulatory assets and liabilities combined.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Payables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to other insurance companies when the reporting entity has assumed a portion of the cedant's insurance risk which has resulted in insurance losses.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities. This may include cash restricted for regulatory purposes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Retail Related Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Royalties Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for compensation payments related to the use of copyrights, patents, trade names, licenses, technology. Royalty payments are also paid by the lease holders for oil, gas, and mineral extraction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Borrowed
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity arising from securities borrowed transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Lending Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of the liability pertaining to obligations to return collateral that the entity received when it loaned securities to the counterparty to the transaction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Loaned Transactions
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Security Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in security deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
doc: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Unbilled Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amount of revenue for work performed for which billing has not occurred, net of uncollectible accounts.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

tlabel: (Increase) Decrease in Unearned Premiums, Net
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Workers' Compensation Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due for insurance (or actual expenses) to cover the medical expenses and lost income for employees that are injured during the course of doing work-related activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Impact of Restatement on Opening Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount after tax of cumulative effect of restatement on the opening retained earnings of the earliest year presented.

tlabel: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Accrual Method
doc: Amount of interest income recognized that the financing receivables (with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses) were impaired.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of an intangible asset (excluding goodwill) to fair value.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Finite-lived
doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of a finite-lived intangible asset to fair value.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
doc: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Impairment of Leasehold
doc: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

tlabel: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

tlabel: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

tlabel: Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
doc: The expense recorded to reduce the value of oil and gas assets consisting of proved properties and unproved properties as the estimate of future successful production from these properties is reduced.

tlabel: Impairment of Ongoing Project
doc: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

tlabel: Impairment of Real Estate
doc: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

tlabel: Incentive Distribution, Distribution Per Unit
doc: Per-share or per-unit amount of incentive dividend declared and paid to managing member or general partner.

tlabel: Incentive Fee Expense
doc: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

tlabel: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: Income or Loss from continuing operations, net of taxes, including net Income or Loss from discontinued operations but before extraordinary items.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
doc: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
doc: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
doc: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Income (Loss) before Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of income (loss) before gain (loss) on sale of properties of Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Interest Expense, Interest Income, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interests, Net
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted share of common stock or unit when the per share amount is the same for both basic and diluted shares.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).
