tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of income (loss) from consolidated real estate investments attributed to parent.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
doc: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each limited partnership and general partnership unit in instances when basic and diluted earnings per unit are the same amount and aggregated on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per unit is the amount of net income or loss for the period per unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per unit includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each limited and general partnership unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Construction Payables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of obligations, not classified as trade payables, incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies, and services pertaining to construction projects.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cost in Excess of Billing on Uncompleted Contract
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, or (c) a combination of (a) and (b).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Leasing Fees
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of deferred leasing fees. Amortization of these fees over the terms of the leases reduces deferred leasing fees. Originating new leases increases the balance of deferred leasing fees.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities
doc: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Payments for Origination and Purchases of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

tlabel: Payments for Origination of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

tlabel: Payments for Other Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for operating activities classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Previous Acquisition
doc: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
doc: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
doc: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Federal Reserve Bank stock represents an equity interest in the Federal Reserve Bank. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

tlabel: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking and Servicing
doc: Income from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions) and servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others net of any related impairment of capitalized service costs. Also includes any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans.

tlabel: Security Deposit
doc: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

tlabel: Security Deposit Liability
doc: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

tlabel: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value and pledged to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions.

tlabel: Securitized Regulatory Transition Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value of the regulatory asset that represents capitalized stranded costs that have been securitized (financed with debt) and are expected to be recoverable through a transition charge after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer). A transition charge is a charge approved by a regulator that allows deregulated utilities to recover investments in certain assets, such as power plants, over a transition period leading into a deregulated market.

tlabel: Capital Expenditure, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

tlabel: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

tlabel: Capitalization, Long-term Debt and Equity
doc: This element represents the total consolidated (as applicable) capitalization of the entity which is comprised of its long-term debt and equity instruments. The table may be detailed by subsidiary (legal entity) and include information by type of debt or equity detailed by instrument.

tlabel: Mineral Properties, Net
doc: Mineral properties, net of adjustments.

tlabel: Mineral Rights
doc: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral rights, or rights to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment in the form of a royalty for the extraction of minerals, net of amortization.

tlabel: Mine Reclamation and Closing Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of a reclamation and mine closing liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of a mine including the removal of buildings, equipment, machinery and other physical remnants of mining, closure of tailings impoundments, leach pads and other mine features, and contouring, covering and revegetation of waste rock piles and other disturbed areas.

tlabel: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability
doc: Amount of funds held as security for payments to be received under reinsurance contracts.

tlabel: Furniture and Fixtures, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

tlabel: Funds Held for Clients
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

tlabel: Information Technology and Data Processing
doc: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

tlabel: Insurance Commissions
doc: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

tlabel: Insurance Commissions and Fees
doc: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of an acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, (c) the increase (decrease) during the reporting period, excluding the portion taken into income, in the liability reflecting services yet to be performed by the reporting entity for which cash or other forms of consideration was received or recorded as a receivable, or (d) some combination of (a), (b), and (c).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Reinsurance Payable
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables, Case Basis
doc: The sum for all reinsurance arrangements of the known and estimated amount recoverable as of the balance sheet date from a given reinsurer for claims paid or incurred by the ceding insurer and associated claims settlement expenses for each reinsurance arrangement (or, the sum of all cases determined individually, probably applying different assumptions to each arrangement).

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid and amounts expected for incurred losses and settlement expenses, which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables, Including Reinsurance Premium Paid
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts including premium paid under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

tlabel: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

tlabel: Accumulated Distributions in Excess of Net Income
doc: The amount as of the balance sheet date by which cumulative distributions to shareholders (or partners) exceed retained earnings (or accumulated earnings).

tlabel: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
doc: Amount, before Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessment, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
doc: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

tlabel: Consideration Received for Beneficial Interest Obtained for Transferring Financial Asset
doc: Amount of beneficial interest received as consideration for transferring noncash financial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, trade receivable in securitization transaction.

tlabel: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not arise in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

tlabel: Net Investment Income
doc: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

tlabel: Net Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Trading Securities
doc: The sum of the realized and unrealized net gain (loss) on trading securities during the period.

tlabel: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Shares
doc: Net number of shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

tlabel: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Value
doc: Value of net shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Continuing Cash Flows after Disposal
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) the discontinued operation after the disposal transaction.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: Per basic and diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation, when the per share amount is the same.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-term Investments
doc: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Deposits
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-term Investments
doc: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

tlabel: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
doc: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

tlabel: Payments for Removal Costs
doc: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
doc: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Joint Ventures
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in joint ventures included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Limited Partnerships
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners of a limited partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Operating Partnerships
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners in an operating partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Preferred Unit Holders
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling preferred unit holders in an entity included in the reporting entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
doc: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
doc: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

tlabel: Lease, Cost
doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

tlabel: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

tlabel: Lease Incentive Receivable
doc: This item represents a receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

tlabel: Lease Income
doc: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-term Investments
doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

tlabel: Long-term Line of Credit, Noncurrent
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Loans Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
doc: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
doc: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Derivative, Fair Value, Net
doc: Fair value of the assets less the liabilities of a derivative or group of derivatives.

tlabel: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
doc: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
doc: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
doc: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
doc: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost
doc: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
doc: This item represents the cost of equity securities, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading, net of adjustments for other-than-temporary impairments recognized in earnings (less any cumulative-effect adjustments recognized, as defined), and fair value hedge accounting adjustments, if any.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities
doc: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
doc: This item represents the cost of debt and equity securities, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading, net of adjustments including accretion, amortization, collection of cash, previous other-than-temporary impairments recognized in earnings (less any cumulative-effect adjustments recognized, as defined), and fair value hedge accounting adjustments, if any.

tlabel: Equipment Expense
doc: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

tlabel: Equity, Fair Value Adjustment
doc: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Accumulated Amortization
doc: For each balance sheet presented, the amount of accumulated amortization for capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Amortization
doc: Amount of expense for amortization of capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
doc: Amount of impairment loss from capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
doc: The carrying amount of capitalized computer software costs net of accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Current
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as current.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization and Valuation Allowance Relating to Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization and valuation allowance relating to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs of Unproved Properties Excluded from Amortization, Cumulative
doc: The sum of the capitalized costs incurred, as of the balance sheet date, of unproved properties excluded from amortization including acquisition costs, exploration costs, development costs, and production costs.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Condemnation
doc: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
doc: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
doc: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: Acquisition Costs, Period Cost
doc: The capitalized costs incurred during the period (excluded from amortization) to purchase, lease or otherwise acquire an unproved property, including costs of lease bonuses and options to purchase or lease properties, the portion of costs applicable to minerals when land including mineral rights is purchased in fee, brokers' fees, recording fees, legal costs, and other costs incurred in acquiring properties.

tlabel: Insurance Investment Income
doc: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

tlabel: Insurance Recoveries
doc: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

tlabel: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

tlabel: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

tlabel: Proceeds and Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
doc: The aggregate cash inflow comprised of the amount received from (a) employees to acquire the entity's shares under incentive awards, including stock option exercises and restricted stock arrangements, and (b) the excess tax benefit arising from such transactions.

tlabel: Proceeds from Advances for Construction
doc: The cash inflow from borrowing by the entity from developers, builders, government agencies and municipalities for construction that are repaid in cash, generally on a straight-line basis over periods ranging from five to forty years.

tlabel: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates
doc: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

tlabel: Proceeds from Bank Debt
doc: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid Claims and Claims Adjustments
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to and paid by the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Allowance
doc: Amount of valuation allowance for reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Allowance
doc: Amount of valuation allowance for reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Related Party Costs
doc: Direct costs arising from transactions with related parties who are not affiliates or joint Ventures. These costs are categorized as cost of goods sold.

tlabel: Legal Fees
doc: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

tlabel: Standard Product Warranty Accrual
doc: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Commodity Contracts
doc: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
doc: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
doc: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
doc: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
doc: The aggregate net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of marketable securities categorized as trading held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period, which may have arisen from (a) securities classified as trading, (b) the unrealized holding gain (loss) on held-to-maturity securities transferred to the trading security category, and (c) the cumulative unrealized gain (loss) which was included in other comprehensive income (a separate component of shareholders' equity) on available-for-sale securities transferred to trading securities during the period and/or any unrealized gains or losses on investments that are separately or otherwise not categorized as trading or available-for-sale.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Securities
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in the income statement on unsold other securities.

tlabel: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contributed Capital
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction
doc: The cash inflow from developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities that provide the entity with cash to extend its construction services to their properties.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
doc: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

tlabel: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
doc: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

tlabel: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

tlabel: Proceeds from Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
doc: Cash inflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

tlabel: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
doc: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

tlabel: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
doc: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Distributions Received from Real Estate Partnerships
doc: The cash inflow from earnings received from real estate partnerships.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

tlabel: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Sale of Interest by Parent
doc: Represents a sale by the parent of a portion of its equity interest in a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The sale of the equity interest represented by this element does not result in a loss of control by the parent.

tlabel: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
doc: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

tlabel: Construction in Progress, Gross
doc: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

tlabel: Construction Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Construction Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

tlabel: Real Estate Held-for-sale
doc: Amount of investment in land and building held for sale. Excludes real estate considered inventory.

tlabel: Real Estate Insurance
doc: A contract to provide coverage or protection in exchange for a payment or "premium". Examples of insurance protection include liability and property insurance. The entity paying the premiums for the protection will have insurance expense and possibly an asset, Prepaid Insurance (if the premiums are paid in advance).

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Current
doc: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Net (Including Goodwill)
doc: Carrying amount of finite-lived intangible assets, indefinite-lived intangible assets and goodwill. Goodwill is an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized. Intangible assets are assets, not including financial assets, lacking physical substance.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
doc: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

tlabel: Proceeds from Dividends Received
doc: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Fees Received
doc: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

tlabel: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
doc: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

tlabel: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
doc: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
doc: The amount of cash received during the period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

tlabel: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Interest Received
doc: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
doc: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
doc: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
doc: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received on Transaction
doc: Cash received on stock transaction after deduction of issuance costs.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
doc: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

tlabel: Sales Commissions and Fees
doc: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Next Rolling Twelve Months
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-term Notes
doc: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

tlabel: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
doc: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

tlabel: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
doc: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

tlabel: Proceeds from Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Long-term Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Adoption, Quantification (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Represents the quantification of the effect of adopting the new accounting standard or change in accounting principle expected by the entity to have a significant effect on the entity's financial statements.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Income (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the effect of a change in accounting principle on net income.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Operating Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the effect of a change in accounting principle on operating profit or loss.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
doc: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
