doc: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
doc: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

tlabel: Payments for Restructuring
doc: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Payments for Royalties
doc: The amount of cash paid for royalties during the current period.

tlabel: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

tlabel: Payments for Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Payments for Tenant Improvements
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the allowance granted to lessee and/or direct costs incurred by lessor used to prepare the leased premises for tenant's occupancy.

tlabel: Payments of Capital Distribution
doc: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

tlabel: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
doc: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

tlabel: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

tlabel: Payments of Derivative Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of a derivative security.

tlabel: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
doc: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Payments of Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments of Financing Costs
doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Payments of Loan Costs
doc: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

tlabel: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

tlabel: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

tlabel: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net
doc: The effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Gain Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
doc: The effective portion of gain reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
doc: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Current
doc: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as trading securities nor held-to-maturity securities and intended be sold or mature one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
doc: This item represents an other than temporary decline in value that has been recognized against an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting. The excess of the carrying amount over the fair value of the investment represents the amount of the write down which is or was reflected in earnings. The written down value is a new cost basis with the adjusted value of the investment becoming its new carrying value subject to the equity accounting method. Evidence of a loss in value might include, but would not necessarily be limited to, absence of an ability to recover the carrying amount of the investment or inability of the investee to sustain an earnings capacity which would justify the carrying amount of the investment.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Ownership Percentage
doc: The percentage of ownership of common stock or equity participation in the investee accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
doc: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

tlabel: Equity Method Investments
doc: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

tlabel: Equity Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the equity method.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Oil and Gas Producing Activities, Net
doc: Net amount of capitalized costs relating to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Proved Properties
doc: Capitalized costs of proved properties incurred for any combination mineral interests acquisitions; wells and related equipment; support equipment and facilities; and uncompleted wells and equipment and other costs not previously disclosed within this table.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Support Equipment and Facilities
doc: Capitalized costs incurred for support equipment and facilities used in oil and gas producing activities (such as seismic equipment, drilling equipment, construction and grading equipment, vehicles, repair shops, warehouses, supply points, camps, and division, district, or field offices).

tlabel: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations
doc: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
doc: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Lease Obligation Incurred
doc: Amount of increase in lease obligation from new lease.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Net
doc: The total gross amount less the charge for the use of the long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
doc: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
doc: The net gain (loss) during the reporting period due to ineffectiveness in interest rate cash flow hedges. Recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Investments
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
doc: This item represents the net total realized and unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period as a result of selling or holding marketable securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, including the unrealized holding gain (loss) of held-to-maturity securities transferred to the trading security category and the cumulative unrealized gain (loss) which was included in other comprehensive income (a separate component of shareholders' equity) for available-for-sale securities transferred to trading securities during the period. Additionally, this item would include any gains (losses) realized during the period from the sale of investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
doc: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Repayments and Calls of Debt Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Mortgage Deposits
doc: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

tlabel: Proceeds from Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Deposits
doc: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Equity
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
doc: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from payments to deposit account and application of deposits to retire or pay down debt during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-term
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
doc: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Proceeds from Principal Repayments on Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written Off, Recovery
doc: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Preferred Stock
doc: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

tlabel: Noncash Merger Related Costs
doc: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Accounts Receivable Acquired
doc: The amount of accounts receivable that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
doc: The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The cash outflow to acquire debt and equity securities not classified as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities which would be classified as available-for-sale securities and reported at fair value, with unrealized gains and losses excluded from earnings and reported in a separate component of shareholders' equity.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
doc: The cash outflow to acquire equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities, because they are not classified as trading securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Buildings
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
doc: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
doc: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Land
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Land Held-for-use
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

tlabel: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
doc: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
doc: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)
doc: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.

tlabel: Mortgage-backed Securities Available-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as available-for-sale.

tlabel: Mortgage Loan Related to Property Sales
doc: Mortgage loan related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
doc: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Foreclosure
doc: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from foreclosure.

tlabel: Derivative Liability
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Current
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Proceeds from Related Party Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from cash and cash items that are not available for withdrawal or usage.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as current.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI and without Readily Determinable Fair Value
doc: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
doc: Cost of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain
doc: Amount of realized gain from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
doc: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Securities Received as Collateral
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

tlabel: Securities Segregated under Commodity Exchange Act Regulation (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Securities Segregated under Other Regulations
doc: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value of Collateral
doc: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Current
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Equity Securities
doc: Amount of equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor as trading.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Equity Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading which are intended be sold more than one year from the balance sheet date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
doc: This item represents the difference between the gross realized gains and losses realized on the sale of debt or equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: This item represents the difference between the gross realized gains and losses realized on the sale of debt or equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities. Additionally, this item would include any losses recognized for other than temporary impairments (OTTI) of the subject investments in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
doc: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
doc: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of equity securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading or available-for-sale. This element includes investments in which the entity holds a small ownership stake (generally, less than 20 percent of the shares outstanding) and cannot exert significant influence.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
doc: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
doc: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of financing receivable.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, before Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period gross of the applicable income taxes realized.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Net of Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period net of the applicable income taxes realized.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

tlabel: Proceeds from Royalties Received
doc: Cash received for royalties during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of debt and equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
doc: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

tlabel: Amortization
doc: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

tlabel: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Gross of Tax
doc: Current period adjustment resulting from gains and losses on intercompany foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, that is, settlement is not planned or anticipated in the foreseeable future. Resulting from the entities to the transaction being consolidated, combined, or accounted for by the equity method in the reporting entity's financial statements.

tlabel: Adjustment of Warrants Granted for Services
doc: Adjustment for noncash service expenses paid for by granting of warrants.

tlabel: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
doc: The aggregate amount of adjustments to net income or loss necessary to remove the effects of all items whose cash effects are investing or financing cash flows. The aggregate amount also includes all noncash expenses and income items which reduce or increase net income and are thus added back or deducted when calculating cash provided by or used in operating activities.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
doc: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
doc: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

tlabel: Interest and Debt Expense
doc: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
doc: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating
doc: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Interest and Dividends Payable
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity).

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases
doc: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
doc: The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-in-portfolio
doc: Interest and fee income generated by loans the Entity intends and has the ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (1) industrial and agricultural; (2) real estate; and (3) real estate construction loans; (4) trade financing; (5) lease financing; (6) home equity lines-of-credit; (7) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (8) credit card and other revolving-type loans. Also includes interest income for leases held by the Entity.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
doc: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired
doc: The amount of fixed assets that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
doc: The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
doc: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)
doc: The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued
doc: The number of shares issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired
doc: Amount of assets, classified as other, acquired in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed
doc: Amount of liabilities, classified as other, assumed in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed
doc: The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
doc: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed
doc: The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
doc: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Flight Equipment
doc: Cash received from sales of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
doc: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
doc: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-use
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Long-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Long-term Investments
doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mineral Rights
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-maturity
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
doc: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
doc: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
doc: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
doc: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Receivables
doc: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

tlabel: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
doc: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Annual Amount
doc: Amount of impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Escrow Deposit
doc: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

tlabel: Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition
doc: Amount of escrow deposit disbursements related to property acquisition in noncash investing or financing transactions.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Investments in debt and equity securities which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading and which are intended to be sold or mature more than one year from the balance sheet date or operating cycle, if longer. Such securities are reported at fair value; unrealized gains (losses) related to Available-for-sale Securities are excluded from earnings and reported in a separate component of shareholders' equity (other comprehensive income), unless the Available-for-sale security is designated as a hedge or is determined to have had an other than temporary decline in fair value below its amortized cost basis. All or a portion of the unrealized holding gain (loss) of an Available-for-sale security that is designated as being hedged in a fair value hedge is recognized in earnings during the period of the hedge, as are other than temporary declines in fair value below the cost basis for investments in equity securities and debt securities that an entity intends to sell or it is more likely than not that it will be required to sell before the recovery of its amortized cost basis. Other than temporary declines in fair value below the cost basis for debt securities categorized as Available-for-sale that an entity does not intend to sell and for which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before the recovery of its amortized cost basis are bifurcated into credit losses and losses related to all other factors. Other than temporary declines in fair value below cost basis related to credit losses are recognized in earnings, and losses related to all other factors are recognized in other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash
doc: Amount of currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits, held by a disposal group.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
doc: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

tlabel: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
doc: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

tlabel: Gain on Sale of Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Current
doc: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Noncurrent
doc: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Noncurrent
doc: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases
doc: The net investment in direct financing leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Units, Authorized
doc: Number of authorized capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

tlabel: Capital Units, Net Amount
doc: Net amount applicable to investors of capital units or shares.

tlabel: Capital Units, Outstanding
doc: Number of capital units or capital shares outstanding. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

tlabel: Cash
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
doc: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

tlabel: Cash Acquired in Excess of Payments to Acquire Business
doc: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of a business when the cash held by the acquired business exceeds the cash payments to acquire the business.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
