doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: For the entity and the disposal group, cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the Entity may deposit additional funds at any time and also effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Compensating balance arrangements that do not legally restrict the withdrawal or usage of cash amounts may be reported as Cash and Cash Equivalents, while legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or company statements of intention with regard to particular deposits are not generally reported as cash and cash equivalents.

tlabel: Secured Debt
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

tlabel: Secured Debt, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, collateralized debt obligations due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer. Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

tlabel: Secured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Transfer to Investments
doc: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Transfer to Real Estate Owned
doc: Value transferred from mortgage loans to real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the cumulative translation adjustment from gain (loss), after tax, on foreign currency derivatives, that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

tlabel: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
doc: Amount of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings, after tax, related to translation from the functional currency to reporting currency, as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

tlabel: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax
doc: Amount of cumulative translation gain (loss), after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

tlabel: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment, after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

tlabel: Travel and Entertainment Expense
doc: Expenses incurred for travel and entertainment during the period.

tlabel: Treasury Stock Acquired, Average Cost Per Share
doc: Total cost of shares repurchased divided by the total number of shares repurchased.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Carrying Basis
doc: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
doc: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
doc: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

tlabel: Treasury Stock Reissued at Lower than Repurchase Price
doc: In cases when treasury stock is reissued at a price lower than the cost to repurchase, the excess difference between the selling price and cost to repurchase is charged against retained earnings (assuming that all APIC arising from treasury stock transactions has first been exhausted).

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
doc: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount
doc: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the par value method.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares
doc: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
doc: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value
doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Cash and Due from Banks
doc: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

tlabel: Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations
doc: Amount of cash subject to withdrawal restrictions, restricted deposits held as compensating balances, and cash and securities segregated in compliance with regulations (such as cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers).

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Federal Funds Sold
doc: The sum of cash and cash equivalents plus Federal Funds Sold. Cash and cash equivalents consist of short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and are so near their maturity that they present negligible risk of changes in value due to changes in interest rates -- usually with an original maturity less than 90 days.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Short-term Investments
doc: Cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the customer may deposit additional funds at any time and effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid Investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Short-term investments, exclusive of cash equivalents, generally consist of marketable securities intended to be sold within one year (or the normal operating cycle if longer) and may include trading securities, available-for-sale securities, or held-to-maturity securities (if maturing within one year), as applicable.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; excluding effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of cash collateral held for borrowed securities, for which the cash is restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

tlabel: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
doc: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

tlabel: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
doc: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Cash, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash. Cash is the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities of discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities of discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of operating activities of discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Cash Segregated under Commodity Exchange Act Regulation
doc: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

tlabel: Ceded Premiums Written
doc: Amount of written premiums ceded to other entities.

tlabel: Proved Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method
doc: Oil and Gas properties with proved reserves under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

tlabel: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
doc: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

tlabel: Provision for Other Credit Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

tlabel: Provision for Other Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to other loss.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
doc: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

tlabel: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest
doc: Amount capitalized of allowance for funds used during construction.

tlabel: Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
doc: This item represents the total realized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period as a result of selling marketable securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity and any gains or losses realized during the period from the sale of investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting and/or investments that are separately or otherwise not categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity. Additionally, this item would include any losses recognized for other than temporary impairments (OTTI) of the subject investments in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt, Subsequent Adjustments
doc: The amount of subsequent adjustments to additional paid in capital for convertible financial instruments where a component of equity and a component of debt are recognized.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-based Compensation
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax deficiency associated with a share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
doc: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit associated with share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes, but is not limited to, excess tax benefit.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

tlabel: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
doc: The sum of adjustments which are added to or deducted from net income or loss, including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interest, to reflect cash provided by or used in operating activities, in accordance with the indirect cash flow method.

tlabel: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-based Compensation, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit (deficiency) associated with an share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Administrative Fees Expense
doc: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

tlabel: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
doc: Carrying amount of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency or vendor on behalf of the borrower.

tlabel: Receivables from Customers
doc: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

tlabel: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
doc: The total value of forfeitures related to restricted stock awards forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures, Dividends
doc: The value of dividends forfeited related to restricted stock awards forfeited.

tlabel: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings
doc: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

tlabel: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
doc: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost
doc: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
doc: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other nonredeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

tlabel: Long-Lived Assets
doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
doc: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Short-term Investments
doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Trading Securities Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets
doc: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.

tlabel: Payments to Develop Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties
doc: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).

tlabel: Payments to Fund Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

tlabel: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Payments to Purchase Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Payments to Suppliers and Employees
doc: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

tlabel: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
doc: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
doc: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

tlabel: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)
doc: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Authorized
doc: Maximum number of excess stock shares permitted to be issued.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Issued
doc: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Outstanding
doc: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

tlabel: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

tlabel: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial and Residential, Real Estate
doc: Interest and fee income from commercial and residential real estate loans.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
doc: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Real Estate
doc: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by one- to four-family residential properties. This item excludes home equity lines-of-credit.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans Held-for-sale, Mortgages
doc: Interest and fee income from mortgage loans considered to be held-for-sale.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Other Consumer
doc: Interest and fee income from other loans extended to individual consumers.

tlabel: Interest and Other Income
doc: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
doc: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Total amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include brokered, retail, demand, checking, notice of withdrawal, money market and other interest-bearing deposits.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
doc: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Liabilities
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

tlabel: Liabilities and Equity
doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

tlabel: Liabilities Assumed
doc: The fair value of liabilities assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Liabilities, Current
doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Liabilities, Fair Value Adjustment
doc: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which a liability could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

tlabel: Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Property Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
doc: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
doc: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

tlabel: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

tlabel: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Proceeds from Stock Plans
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

tlabel: Proceeds from Unsecured Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

tlabel: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
doc: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Current
doc: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
doc: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Restructuring Charges
doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring Costs
doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
doc: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Redemption Value
doc: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for common shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Fair Value
doc: The aggregate fair value as of the reporting date of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

tlabel: Excise and Sales Taxes
doc: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

tlabel: Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

tlabel: Liabilities Subject to Compromise
doc: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Profit (Loss) from Real Estate Operations
doc: The net cost of operation of other real estate (including provisions for real estate losses, rental income, and gains and losses on sales of real estate).

tlabel: Program Rights Obligations, Current
doc: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid within the next twelve months.

tlabel: Proceeds of Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

tlabel: Production Related Impairments or Charges
doc: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

tlabel: Production Tax Expense
doc: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

tlabel: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense
doc: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

tlabel: Interest Costs Capitalized
doc: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

tlabel: Interest Credited to Policy Owner Account
doc: Amount of expense for unpaid portion of interest credited to policy owner account.

tlabel: Interest Expense
doc: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Borrowings
doc: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Debt
doc: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

tlabel: Distributed Earnings
doc: The total amount of dividends declared in the period for each class of stock and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends). Dividends declared in the current period do not include dividends declared in respect of prior-period unpaid cumulative dividends. Preferred dividends that are cumulative only if earned are deducted only to the extent that they are earned.

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Declared
doc: Amount of equity impact of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid
doc: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Declared
doc: Amount of equity impact of cash distribution declared to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
doc: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

tlabel: Product Warranty Accrual, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

tlabel: Product Warranty Expense
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

tlabel: Professional Fees
doc: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

tlabel: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
doc: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Redemption Premium
doc: The excess of the (1) fair value of consideration transferred to the holders of a security in excess of (2) the carrying amount of the security reported on the registrant's balance sheet, which will be deducted from net earnings to derive net earnings available to common shareholders. This amount is generally an adjustment considered in the computation of earnings per share.

tlabel: Reduction of Short-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing recorded for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities within one year or the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Property Casualty Liability
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to casualty insurance insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date) and the amount needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost required to investigate and settle claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date), whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
doc: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
doc: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Individual and Group Annuities and Supplementary Contracts
doc: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under individual and group annuities and supplementary insurance contracts.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Expense (Income)
doc: Amount of expense (income) recognized due to changes in the accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events.

tlabel: General and Administrative Expense
doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

tlabel: General Insurance Expense
doc: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account
doc: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
doc: The number of general partner units issued.

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
doc: The number of general partner units outstanding.

tlabel: General Partners' Contributed Capital
doc: The amount of capital contributed by the general partner.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
doc: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Demand Deposit Accounts
doc: Interest expense incurred on demand deposit accounts that represent borrowings rather than outstanding drafts.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Deposits
doc: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities
doc: Aggregate amount of all interest expense on domestic deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Domestic Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on all domestic deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
doc: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Long-term
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on long-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
doc: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

tlabel: Interest Expense, NOW Accounts, Money Market Accounts, and Savings Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on the following for deposits in domestic offices: (1) transaction accounts (NOW, and telephone and preauthorized transfer accounts), (2) money market deposits and (3) savings deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other Short-term Borrowings
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on other short-term borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Related Party
doc: Amount of interest expense incurred on a debt or other obligation to related party.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
doc: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Gross expenses on securities sold coupled with an agreement to repurchase the same from the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price within a fixed or variable time period.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

tlabel: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
doc: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

tlabel: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

tlabel: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Payment for Pension Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

tlabel: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Dividend Income, Operating
doc: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

tlabel: Dividends
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Dividends, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

tlabel: Dividends, Paid-in-kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends (PIK) declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
doc: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

tlabel: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
doc: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustments due to changes in the period of the contract, accretion of the discount on the premiums receivable, and adjustments classified as other. Excludes new business written and proceeds from premiums.

tlabel: Advance Rent
doc: Amount at the balance sheet date that has been received by the entity that represents rents paid in advance.

tlabel: Advances from Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of borrowings as of the balance sheet date from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and liquidity shortages.

tlabel: Advances to Affiliate
doc: Long-Term advances receivable from a party that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. This does not include advances to clients.

tlabel: Advertising Expense
doc: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

tlabel: Affiliate Costs
doc: Costs associated with revenues arising from an entity that is an affiliate of the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Program Assessments
doc: Amount of expense for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments required by the Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Program Obligation
doc: Amount of obligation related to Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments required by the Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
doc: Amount of acquisition of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Disposals
doc: Amount of divestiture of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
doc: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
doc: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

tlabel: Bank Overdrafts
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of payments made in excess of existing cash balances, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the entity. Overdrafts generally have a very short time frame for correction or repayment and are therefore more similar to short-term bank financing than trade financing.

tlabel: Bank Owned Life Insurance
doc: The carrying amount of a life insurance policy on an officer, executive or employee for which the reporting entity (a bank) is entitled to proceeds from the policy upon death of the insured or surrender of the insurance policy.

tlabel: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
doc: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings Excluding Federal Funds and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances and other short term borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

tlabel: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
doc: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Operating
doc: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale); classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
doc: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
doc: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Domestic Deposits
doc: Interest earned on deposits in United States money market accounts and other United States interest earning accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), after Provision for Loan Loss
doc: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), Net
doc: The net amount of operating interest income (expense).

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating, Net
doc: The net amount of nonoperating interest income (expense).

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold
doc: Interest income on federal funds sold. Federal funds sold represent the excess federal funds held by one commercial bank which it lends to another commercial bank, usually at an agreed-upon (federal funds) rate of interest. Such loans generally are of short-duration (overnight).

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
doc: Amount of interest income from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned and Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity and pledged to counterparties as collateral, including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
doc: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-backed and Asset-backed Securities, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card receivables), either fixed or revolving, that by their terms convert into cash within a finite time period. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

tlabel: Dividends Payable, Amount Per Share
doc: The per share amount of a dividend declared, but not paid, as of the financial reporting date.

tlabel: Dividends Payable, Current
