doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Dividends Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Paid-in-kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividends, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of other physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
doc: Amount after depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
doc: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense
doc: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
doc: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Directors Fees
doc: Noninterest expense related to directors' fees which are fees paid by an Entity to its directors. Directors' fees may be paid in addition to salary and other benefits.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Investment Advisory Fees
doc: This represents the company's cost incurred during an accounting period for managing the money in a fund, which will be billed back to the client and is a component of noninterest expenses.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment
doc: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
doc: Fees paid to an agent employed by a corporation or mutual fund to maintain shareholder records, including purchases, sales, and account balances. Also includes custodian fees incurred during an accounting period from an agent, bank, trust company, or other organization that holds and safeguards an individual's, mutual fund's, or investment company's assets for them. These fees will be billed back to the client and are a component of noninterest expense.

tlabel: Noninterest Income
doc: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other
doc: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
doc: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

tlabel: Cost, Depreciation, Amortization and Depletion
doc: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives, and reduction in quantity of natural resource due to consumption directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

tlabel: Cost, Direct Labor
doc: Cost of labor directly related to good produced and service rendered. Includes, but is not limited to, payroll cost and equity-based compensation.

tlabel: Cost, Direct Material
doc: Cost of material used for good produced and service rendered.

tlabel: Cost Method Investments
doc: Amount, after adjustment, of cost-method investment. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, dividends received in excess of earnings after date of investment that are considered a return of investment and other than temporary impairments.

tlabel: Cost-method Investments, Other than Temporary Impairment
doc: This item represents an other than temporary decline in value that has been recognized against an investment accounted for under the cost method of accounting. The excess of the carrying amount over the fair value of the investment represents the amount of the write down which is or was reflected in earnings. The written down value is a new cost basis with the adjusted value of the investment becoming its new carrying value. Evidence of a loss in value might include, but would not necessarily be limited to, absence of an ability to recover the carrying amount of the investment or inability of the investee to sustain an earnings capacity which would justify the carrying amount of the investment.

tlabel: Interest Income, Money Market Deposits
doc: Interest earned on funds deposited in US domestic money market accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Operating
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Other
doc: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Income, Related Party
doc: Amount of interest income earned from interest-bearing assets owed to the entity by related party.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Corporate Debt, Operating
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on corporate debt securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Mortgage Backed
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securitized, pass-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Other US Government
doc: Interest income on securities issued by US government agencies not including US Treasury Securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Interest income derived from securities purchased under agreements to resell. The difference in the price at which the institution buys the securities and resells the securities represents interest for the use of the funds by the other party. Most repurchase and sale agreements involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances and negotiable certificates of deposits are sometimes used in such transactions.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, State and Municipal
doc: Interest income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, derived from debt securities issued by municipal governments, local taxing districts and US state government agencies.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury and Other US Government
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on U.S. Treasury securities and other U.S. government securities.

tlabel: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

tlabel: Interest Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Interest Payable
doc: Amount of interest payable on debt, including, but not limited to, trade payables.

tlabel: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

tlabel: Selling and Marketing Expense
doc: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

tlabel: Selling Expense
doc: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.

tlabel: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

tlabel: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

tlabel: Senior Notes
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

tlabel: General Partners' Offering Costs
doc: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the general partner.

tlabel: Good Faith and Margin Deposits with Broker-Dealers
doc: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

tlabel: Goodwill
doc: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
doc: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

tlabel: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
doc: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Physical Commodities Sold
doc: Fair value of obligations arising from physical commodities sold short.

tlabel: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Par Value Per Share
doc: Par value per share of mandatory redeemable financial instrument classified as liability.

tlabel: Due from Affiliate, Current
doc: Amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Affiliates
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Due from Banks
doc: A bank's noninterest bearing demand deposits in other banks (such as correspondents).

tlabel: Due from Employees, Current
doc: Amounts due from an Entity employee, not to include stockholders or officers, which are usually due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
doc: Value of new stock classified as temporary equity issued during the period.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Par Value
doc: Carrying amount of the par value of temporary equity outstanding. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Tenant Improvements
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of improvements having a life longer than one year that were made for the benefit of one or more tenants.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of loans which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation primarily arising from secured borrowings and repurchase agreements, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of mortgage-related securities, classified as available for sale or held for investment, which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, primarily a secured borrowing or repurchase agreement, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them.

tlabel: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
doc: The carrying amount as of the date of the latest financial statement presented of mortgage-related securities classified as available for sale or held for investment which are owned but transferred to another party to serve as collateral to partially or fully secure a debt obligation, repurchase agreement or other current or potential obligation, and for which the transferee does not have the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Inventory
doc: The period end amount for a type of inventory held by the utility in a schedule of inventories.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.

tlabel: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
doc: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
doc: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, from recovery.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
doc: Amount of direct write-downs of accounts receivable charged against the allowance.

tlabel: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
doc: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Loans Acquired
doc: Amount of addition to allowance reserve for credit loss arising from purchase of loan and lease portfolios.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of allowance reserve for credit loss.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
doc: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses Write-offs, Net
doc: Amount, after recoveries, of loans and leases that have been written-off.

tlabel: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
doc: The amount of net gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

tlabel: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

tlabel: Regulatory Assets, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Such costs are capitalized if they meet both of the following criteria: a. It is probable that future revenue in an amount at least equal to the capitalized cost will result from inclusion of that cost in allowable costs for rate-making purposes. b. Based on available evidence, the future revenue will be provided to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost rather than to provide for expected levels of similar future costs. If the revenue will be provided through an automatic rate-adjustment clause, this criterion requires that the regulator's intent clearly be to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost.

tlabel: Regulatory Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are not expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Due from Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from related parties including affiliates, employees, joint ventures, officers and stockholders, immediate families thereof, and pension funds.

tlabel: Due from Related Parties, Current
doc: The aggregate amount of receivables to be collected from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth, at the financial statement date. which are usually due within one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregate amount of receivables to be collected from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth, at the financial statement date, which are usually due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Due to Affiliate, Current
doc: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Due to Affiliate
doc: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Due to Officers or Stockholders, Current
doc: Amounts due to recorded owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Due to Related Parties, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of such liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Due to Related Parties
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties.

tlabel: Due to Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Portion of the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties that is payable after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
doc: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

tlabel: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

tlabel: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Weighted Average Limited Partnership and General Partnership Units Outstanding, Basic
doc: Weighted average number of limited partnership and general partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership and general partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Includes, for example, the number of units distributed to unit holders whereby unit holders have the ability to elect to receive the unit holders' entire distribution in cash or units of equivalent value or there is a potential limitation on the total amount of cash that all unit holders can elect to receive in aggregate.

tlabel: Weighted Average Limited Partnership Units Outstanding, Basic
doc: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

tlabel: Weighted Average Limited Partnership Units Outstanding, Diluted
doc: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Used in the calculation of diluted net income or loss per limited partnership unit.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
doc: The average number of limited partnership and general partnership units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per limited partnership and general partnership unit.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
doc: Average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS).

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
doc: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

tlabel: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
doc: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

tlabel: Stock Dividends, Shares
doc: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock
doc: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Change in Reporting Entity
doc: Impact on total stockholders' equity of cumulative effect of change in reporting entity. A change in reporting entity is considered as follows: (1) presenting consolidated statements in place of the financial statements of individual reporting entities; (2) changing the combination of subsidiaries that make up the group for which the consolidated financial statements are presented; and (3) changing the entities included in the combined financial statements. A business combination accounted for under the purchase method and the consolidation of a variable interest entity are not considered a change in reporting entity.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of stockholders' equity including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interests, after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
doc: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

tlabel: Underwriting Income (Loss)
doc: The difference between the price paid by the public and the contract price less the related expenses. A broker-dealer may underwrite a security offering by contracting to buy the issue either at a fixed price or a price based on selling the offering on a best-effort basis.

tlabel: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Financing Interest Expense
doc: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

tlabel: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Below Market Lease, Acquired
doc: Amount of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Below Market Lease, Net
doc: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Benefits, Losses and Expenses
doc: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

tlabel: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the date of the latest financial statement presented of securities which are owned but transferred to another party to serve as collateral to partially or fully secure a debt obligation, repurchase agreement or other current or potential obligation, and for which the transferee is not permitted to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net
doc: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Other
doc: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for benefits and costs incurred for other insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Account Balance
doc: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

tlabel: Alternative Investment
doc: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

tlabel: Notes and Loans Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Notes and Loans Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of all long-term notes and loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Notes Assumed
doc: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Notes Issued
doc: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Notes Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), payable to related parties, which are due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable to banks, excluding mortgage notes, initially due beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
doc: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
doc: The total amount due within more than 12 month, or the operating cycle if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay.

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Reduction
doc: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

tlabel: Undistributed Earnings, Basic
doc: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

tlabel: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic
doc: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

tlabel: Unearned ESOP Shares
doc: Fair value of unearned shares for all classes of common stock and nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes the sale of shares or the issuance treasury shares to an ESOP.

tlabel: Unearned Premiums
doc: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Gross Investment Income, Operating
doc: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

tlabel: Gross Profit
doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

tlabel: Billed Contracts Receivable
doc: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Billings in Excess of Cost
doc: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method.

tlabel: Billings in Excess of Cost, Current
doc: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized within one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Core Deposits, Gross
doc: Bank deposits belonging to an acquired bank that can be counted on as a stable source of lending funds. These deposits have the following attributes: predictable costs and low sensitivity to interest rates. This intangible asset is usually amortized over its estimated useful life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Acquired-in-Place Leases
doc: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to existing tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Amortization of above and below Market Leases
doc: Amount of non-cash amortization of intangible asset (liability) for above and below market leases.

tlabel: Amortization of Below Market Lease
doc: Amount of amortization of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
doc: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Charges
doc: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
doc: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees
doc: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
doc: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amortization of ESOP Award
doc: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Amortization of Intangible Assets
doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amortization of Leased Asset
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

tlabel: Amortization of Lease Incentives
doc: Amount of amortization of lease incentive costs incurred by the lessor for the benefit of the lessee.

tlabel: Amortization of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
doc: The periodic amortization (in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss) of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Recovery of Direct Costs
doc: Return of or reimbursements received in relation to direct costs and expenses previously paid or incurred.

tlabel: Regulatory Liability, Current
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

tlabel: Units of Partnership Interest, Amount
doc: The number of units or equivalent units outstanding for all classes.

tlabel: Unproved Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method
doc: Oil and Gas properties with unproved reserves under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
doc: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

tlabel: Early Repayment of Subordinated Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets before its maturity.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted
doc: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each share in instances when basic and diluted earnings per share are the same amount and reported as a single line item on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per share is the amount of net income or loss for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per share includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Undistributed
doc: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Undistributed
doc: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security, after giving effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

tlabel: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
doc: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

tlabel: Cost, Amortization
doc: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

tlabel: Cost, Depreciation
doc: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

tlabel: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

tlabel: Cost of Goods Sold, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold during the reporting period, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

tlabel: Cost of Goods Sold, Sales-type Lease
doc: Cost of goods sold for sales-type financing lease.

tlabel: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
doc: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

tlabel: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.

tlabel: Revenue from Related Parties
doc: Amount of revenue, fees and commissions earned from transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiaries; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) an entity and trusts for the benefit of employees, for example, but not limited to, pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; (d) an entity and its principal, owners, management, or members of their immediate families; and (e) affiliates.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
doc: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

tlabel: Postconfirmation, Reorganization Value in Excess of Amounts Allocable to Identifiable Assets
doc: Amount of reorganization value in excess of amounts allocable to identifiable assets at the balance sheet date after fresh-start adjustments.

tlabel: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Current
doc: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable within one year of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent
doc: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
doc: The adjustment to expense previously capitalized costs of drilling exploratory wells when proved reserves are not found or when the entity obtains information that raises substantial doubt about the economic or operational viability of the project.

tlabel: Exploration Expense
doc: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

tlabel: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
doc: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

tlabel: Occupancy, Net
doc: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

tlabel: Office of Finance, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
doc: Amount of a Federal Home Loan Bank's (FHLBank) proportionate share of the costs of operating the Office of Finance.

tlabel: Real Estate Inventory, Construction Materials
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed goods that will be used in the course of a construction project which will become a part of the finished inventory.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Partnership Revenue
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
doc: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, Net
doc: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Net
doc: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Other
doc: Amount of real estate owned for income production and capital accretion potential, not otherwise specified in the existing taxonomy. Such real estate excludes that which is occupied or used in the business, for entertainment purposes, or held in inventory for specific purposes.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Unconsolidated Real Estate and Other Joint Ventures
doc: The carrying amount of investments in unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented. This includes direct and indirect investments.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
doc: Percentage of voting equity interests acquired at the acquisition date in the business combination.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
doc: Period end amount of total net PPE.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
doc: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service
doc: Period end amount of total gross PPE.

tlabel: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
doc: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

tlabel: Recognition of Deferred Revenue
doc: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
doc: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

tlabel: Off-market Lease, Unfavorable
doc: This element represents a liability associated with the acquisition of an off-market lease when the terms of the lease are unfavorable to the market terms for the lease at the date of acquisition.

tlabel: Cost of Merchandise Sales, Buying and Occupancy Costs (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: The aggregate of buying and occupancy costs reported during the period related to merchandise sold. Costs could include, but not be limited to, inbound and outbound freight; costs of operating distribution centers; payroll, benefits, and travel costs directly associated with buying inventory; systems costs related to the buying and tracking of inventory; rent; depreciation; property taxes; and facility operations.

tlabel: Cost of Other Property Operating Expense
doc: Other operating costs incurred during the reporting period and may include amounts paid to maintain the property.

tlabel: Cost of Property Repairs and Maintenance
doc: The aggregate costs of keeping the property in good condition but that do not appreciably prolong the life or increase the value of the property.

tlabel: Cost of Purchased Water
doc: Cost of water purchased, may include any water related assessment. If water is bought on a unit volume basis, would also be considered as commodity costs.

tlabel: Cost of Revenue
doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Provision
doc: Amount of expense recognized in the income statement for a decrease in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

tlabel: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
doc: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

tlabel: Real Estate Tax Expense
doc: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated obligations associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid in the next twelve months or in the normal operating cycle if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash
doc: Amount of decrease in the reserve for full or partial settlement through consideration other than cash.

tlabel: Senior Notes, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to debt holders having a lesser priority of repayment.

tlabel: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Cost of Services, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: The aggregate cost of services rendered during the reporting period, excluding depreciation, depletion and amortization.

tlabel: Costs and Expenses
doc: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

tlabel: Costs and Expenses, Related Party
doc: Costs of sales and operating expenses for the period incurred from transactions with related parties.

tlabel: Costs in Excess of Billings
doc: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

tlabel: Costs in Excess of Billings, Current
doc: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings which is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

tlabel: Repayments of Advances for Construction
doc: The cash outflow for the payments made by the entity, generally on a straight-line basis over periods ranging from five to forty years to developers, builders, government agencies and municipalities for borrowings received in construction.

tlabel: Repayments of Annuities and Investment Certificates
doc: The cash outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

tlabel: Repayments of Assumed Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

tlabel: Repayments of Bank Debt
doc: The cash outflow to settle a bank borrowing during the year.

tlabel: Repayments of Construction Loans Payable
doc: The cash outflow from repayment of borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

tlabel: Repayments of Convertible Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.

tlabel: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Repayments of Lines of Credit
doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
doc: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Lines of Credit
doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
doc: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

tlabel: Repayments of Medium-term Notes
doc: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Repayments of Notes Payable
doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Short-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Pollution Control Bond
doc: The cash outflow from settlement of a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

tlabel: Repayments of Related Party Debt
doc: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.

tlabel: Repayments of Secured Debt
doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Repayments of Senior Debt
doc: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

tlabel: Repayments of Short-term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Regulated Entity, Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue
doc: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Electric, Non-Nuclear
doc: The amount of regulated power revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Water
doc: The amount of regulated water operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulator Expenses, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
doc: Amount of fees or assessments to fund the operations of the regulator of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Separate Account Asset
doc: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

tlabel: Separate Account, Liability
doc: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-15, Insurance Companies, Summary of Investments, Other than Investments in Related Parties, Amount
doc: Amount of investment held by insurance company, excluding investment in related party.

tlabel: Supplemental Deferred Purchase Price
doc: A device of credit enhancement where a part of the purchase price for the receivable/ payable is retained to serve as a cash collateral.

tlabel: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
doc: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

tlabel: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash
doc: Amount of effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances held in foreign currencies. Excludes cash equivalents.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Continuing Operations
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in continuing operations held in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Discontinued Operations
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in discontinuing operations held in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies. Excludes amounts for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Joint Interest Billing Receivables, Current
doc: Current portion of accounts receivable attributable to joint interest partners in oil and gas properties. These are billings to the non-operators associated with the operation of wells and are based on those owners' working interests in the wells. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Net
doc: Oil and gas properties, net of depletion, carried under the full cost method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion Amortization and Impairment
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment of oil and gas property carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of oil and gas property carried under the successful effort method. Oil and gas property include, but not limited to, the entity's wells and related equipment and facilities.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Gross
doc: Oil and Gas properties, gross, carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Net
doc: Oil and gas properties net of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, impairment, and abandonment, carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Sales Payable, Current
