doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to third parties for oil and gas that has been sold but not delivered. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount
doc: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Current
doc: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable within one year of the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
doc: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Maximum Number of Shares
doc: The maximum number of shares that the issuer could be required to issue to redeem the instrument, if applicable.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Number of Shares
doc: The number of shares that would be issued, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the settlement were to occur at the reporting date.

tlabel: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
doc: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Dry Hole Costs
doc: Dry hole costs from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Income before Income Taxes
doc: Income before income taxes for oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Production or Lifting Costs
doc: Production (lifting) costs from oil and gas producing activities, including but not limited to lease operating expense, production and ad valorem taxes, and transportation expense.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Revenue from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: Total revenues from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Transfer from Investments
doc: Value of investments transferred from the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Transfer of Loans Held-for-sale to Portfolio Loans
doc: Value of loans held-for-sale transferred to loans held in the entity's portfolio in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Transfer from Real Estate Owned
doc: Value transferred out of real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Transfer of Portfolio Loans and Leases to Held-for-sale
doc: Value of loans and leases held in the entity's portfolio transferred to loans and leases held-for-sale in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Associated Liabilities, Carrying Amount
doc: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of options vested. Excludes equity instruments other than options, for example, but not limited to, share units, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Number of Shares
doc: Number of options vested.

tlabel: Subordinated Debt
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

tlabel: Retained Earnings, Appropriated
doc: A segregation of retained earnings which is unavailable for dividend distribution. Includes also retained earnings appropriated for loss contingencies.

tlabel: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
doc: A segregation of retained earnings which is available for dividend distribution. Earnings not paid out as dividends but instead reinvested in the core business or used to pay off debt. Unappropriated profit is part of shareholder equity. Also called cumulative distributions or earned surplus or accumulated earnings or unappropriated profit.

tlabel: Revenues
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Revenues, Excluding Interest and Dividends
doc: Revenues from operations, excluding interest and dividend income. Includes revenues from the following sources: investment banking (underwriting and financial advisory), principal transactions (sales and trading, and investment gains and losses), commissions, asset management, and investment advisory and other services.

tlabel: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

tlabel: Supplies and Postage Expense
doc: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

tlabel: Supplies Expense
doc: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

tlabel: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges
doc: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Amounts of Transaction
doc: Amount of transactions with related party during the financial reporting period.

tlabel: Cumulative Dividends
doc: Amount of cumulative cash dividends distributed to shareholders.

tlabel: Cumulative Earnings (Deficit)
doc: Amount of cumulative earnings (deficits) for relevant time periods.

tlabel: Cumulative Effect of New Accounting Principle in Period of Adoption (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) to equity or (increase) decrease to net assets, resulting from the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

tlabel: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, before Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the cumulative effect on retained earnings before related income tax effect.

tlabel: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the cumulative effect on retained earnings net of related income tax effect.

tlabel: Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

tlabel: Current Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Operating Costs and Expenses
doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

tlabel: Operating Expenses
doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

tlabel: Operating Income (Loss)
doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

tlabel: Operating Insurance and Claims Costs, Production
doc: Insurance and claims costs directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Cost
doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Expense
doc: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Lease Income
doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

tlabel: Warehouse Agreement Borrowings
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the outstanding short-term borrowings under a revolving line of credit used by mortgage bankers to finance the origination or purchase of loans.

tlabel: Warrant, Down Round Feature, (Increase) Decrease in Equity, Amount
doc: Amount of (increase) decrease in equity for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

tlabel: Warrants and Rights Outstanding
doc: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

tlabel: Unregulated Operating Revenue
doc: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
doc: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
doc: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
doc: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
doc: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
doc: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

tlabel: Stock Issued, Value, Stock Options Exercised, Net of Tax Benefit (Expense)
doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options, after deduction of related income tax (expense) benefit.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
doc: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
doc: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

tlabel: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

tlabel: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
doc: Expenses recognized resulting from transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party
doc: Reflects the sum of all other revenue and income realized from sales and other transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party during the period.

tlabel: Rental Properties
doc: Carrying amount of income producing properties held for rental.

tlabel: Reorganization Items
doc: Total amount of reorganization items.

tlabel: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Payments, Use
doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
doc: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
doc: The total amount of revenue recognized for the period from operating leases, including minimum lease revenue, contingent revenue, percentage revenue and sublease revenue.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Minimum Lease Revenue
doc: The total amount of lease revenue recognized for the period for which the lessee was obligated under leasing arrangements regardless of any other events or conditions. This amount excludes contingent revenue and sublease revenue.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Sublease Revenue
doc: The amount of revenue recognized for the period under subleasing arrangements.

tlabel: Share Price
doc: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks of a company.

tlabel: Shares, Issued
doc: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Price Per Share
doc: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.

tlabel: Shares, Outstanding
doc: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Withheld for Tax Withholding Obligation
doc: Number of shares used to settle grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Unsecured Debt
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Unsecured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

tlabel: Customer Advances, Current
doc: The current portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

tlabel: Customer Advances for Construction
doc: For utilities only, represents the carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date for payments received by a utility from its customers in advance of performing its obligations under terms of its construction agreements.

tlabel: Customer Deposits, Current
doc: The current portion of money or property received from customers which is either to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or applied to customer receivables in accordance with the terms of the contract or the understandings.

tlabel: Customer Refund Liability, Current
doc: Current regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

tlabel: Straight Line Rent
doc: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

tlabel: Straight Line Rent Adjustments
doc: Amount of the adjustment to rental revenues to measure escalating leasing revenues on a straight line basis.

tlabel: Sublease Income
doc: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

tlabel: Subordinated Borrowing, Interest Rate
doc: Stated interest rate of the subordinated debt.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

tlabel: Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

tlabel: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from investment in debt and equity securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income, and recognized from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Amount
doc: The value of the financial instrument(s) that the original debt is being converted into in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued
doc: The number of shares issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or payments in the period.

tlabel: Royalty Expense
doc: Amount of expense related to royalty payments under a contractual arrangement such as payment for mineral and drilling rights and use of technology or intellectual property.

tlabel: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Current Period Gain Recognized
doc: The portion of the deferred gain that was recognized in the current period.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Net
doc: The portion of the gain that will be recorded as income or a reduction in rent expense in future periods less amounts recognized in the current period.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Amount
doc: The amount of the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt, Current
doc: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
doc: Percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the debt instrument.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Gross
doc: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
doc: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Interest in Subsidiary Earnings
doc: Subsidiary earnings portion attributable to temporary equity.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference
doc: The aggregate liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference Per Share
doc: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Net Income
doc: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Par or Stated Value Per Share
doc: Per share amount of par value or stated value of stock classified as temporary equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Redemption Price Per Share
doc: Amount to be paid per share that is classified as temporary equity by entity upon redemption. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Shares Authorized
doc: The maximum number of securities classified as temporary equity that are permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Shares Issued
doc: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been sold (or granted) to the entity's shareholders. Securities issued include securities outstanding and securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Shares Outstanding
doc: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been issued and are held by the entity's shareholders. Securities outstanding equals securities issued minus securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net of Insurance Proceeds
doc: Amount, after deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Forgiveness
doc: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

tlabel: Time Deposits
doc: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

tlabel: Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
doc: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

tlabel: Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
doc: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of less than $100,000.

tlabel: Value Added Tax Receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of value added taxes due either from customers arising from sales on credit terms, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities.

tlabel: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Expense
doc: The amount of expense between the reporting entity and the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Income or Loss before Tax
doc: Description of the amount of pre-tax income (loss) derived by the reporting entity from the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Revenues
doc: The amount of income between the reporting entity and the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Current, Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets that can only be used to settle obligations of the VIE, classified as current.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Noncurrent, Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets that can only be used to settle obligations of VIE, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) assets that can only be used to settle obligations of VIE.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: The carrying amount of the consolidated Variable Interest Entity's assets included in the reporting entity's statement of financial position.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: The carrying amount of the consolidated Variable Interest Entity's liabilities included in the reporting entity's statement of financial position.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
doc: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

tlabel: Securities for Reverse Repurchase Agreements
doc: The carrying value of securities purchased to be resold in reverse repurchase transactions as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Securities Loaned
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Current, No Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities that do not have recourse to general credit of primary beneficiary, classified as current.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Noncurrent, No Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities that do not have recourse to general credit of primary beneficiary, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of consolidated variable interest entity's (VIE) liabilities that have recourse to general credit of primary beneficiary.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Increase (Decrease) Adjustment
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from adjustment.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Amount
doc: Amount of valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Deduction
doc: Amount of decrease in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
doc: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other
doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
doc: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued
doc: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
doc: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
doc: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan
doc: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
doc: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
doc: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
doc: Number of new stock issued during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
doc: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Purchase of Assets
doc: Number of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
doc: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
doc: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
doc: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

tlabel: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Written-off
doc: The amount of the write-off for research and development assets that were acquired in a transaction other than a business combination.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense
doc: The aggregate costs incurred (1) in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or (2) to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, including the costs of developing computer software up to the point in time of achieving technological feasibility, and costs allocated in accounting for a business combination to in-process projects deemed to have no alternative future use.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
doc: The costs incurred in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, excluding in-process research and development acquired in a business combination consummated during the period. Excludes software research and development, which has a separate concept.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
doc: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

tlabel: Research and Development in Process
doc: The amount of purchased research and development assets that are acquired in a business combination have no alternative future use and are therefore written off in the period of acquisition.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
doc: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
doc: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
doc: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
doc: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
doc: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

tlabel: Trading Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

tlabel: Workers' Compensation Liability, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Workers' Compensation Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the noncurrent portion of the liabilities (due beyond one year; or beyond one operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Write off of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost
doc: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
doc: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Debt Issuance Costs Incurred During Noncash or Partial Noncash Transaction
doc: The amount of debt issuance costs that were incurred during a noncash or partial noncash transaction.

tlabel: Short-term Bank Loans and Notes Payable
doc: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Short-term Debt
doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Short-term Debt, Fair Value
doc: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Short-term Debt, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
doc: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, maximum month-end borrowings during the period.

tlabel: Short-term Investments
doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

tlabel: Short-term Non-bank Loans and Notes Payable
doc: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

tlabel: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
doc: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

tlabel: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
doc: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

tlabel: Debt Securities
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Trading Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of liabilities pertaining to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include, but are not limited to, short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, Amortized Cost
doc: Amortized cost of investments in debt securities classified as trading.

tlabel: Trading Securities, Equity
doc: Fair value of investments in trading equity securities and other forms of trading securities that provide ownership interests.

tlabel: Trading Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) realized from securities classified as trading.

tlabel: Trading Securities, Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized holding gain (loss) recognized in the income statement for investments in debt and equity securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests classified as trading.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Restricted
doc: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Transfer Mortgage Payable
doc: The fair value of transfer of mortgage payable in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain
doc: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading), classified as current.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
doc: Cost of investment in debt investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
doc: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

tlabel: Decommissioning Fund Investments
doc: Decommission fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities through collection of revenues derived from utility assessments and government appropriations. Decommission fund investment for the process whereby a power station, at the end of its economic life, is taken permanently out of service and its site made available for other purposes. In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radioactive material such as nuclear fuel and operational waste is removed and the buildings surrounding the reactor shield are dismantled and finally the reactor itself is dismantled.

tlabel: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

tlabel: Restricted Cash
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Investments
doc: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
doc: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

tlabel: Restricted Cash, Current
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Restricted Investments
doc: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

tlabel: Restricted Investments, Current
doc: This element represents the current portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Restricted Investments, Noncurrent
doc: This element represents the noncurrent portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Settlement Assets, Current
doc: Cash received or short term receivables for unsettled money transfers, money orders, consumer payments, or business to business payments. Settlement assets include clearing and settling customers payments due to and from financial institutions and may include cash and cash equivalents.

tlabel: Settlement Liabilities, Current
doc: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.

tlabel: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Amount
doc: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

tlabel: Severance Costs
doc: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Rights, Percentage
doc: Percentage of vesting of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount
doc: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Vested
doc: Intrinsic value of vested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

tlabel: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

tlabel: Taxes, Miscellaneous
doc: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

tlabel: Taxes, Other
doc: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

tlabel: Taxes Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Taxes Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense
doc: Amount of operating expense of regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of operating expense for depreciation and amortization of regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Fuel Used
doc: Amount of operating expense for fuel used by regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Gas and Petroleum Purchased
doc: Amount of operating expense for purchased gas and petroleum of regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
doc: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses
doc: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Products and Services
doc: Amount of operating expense for products and services of regulated operation.

tlabel: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power
doc: Amount of operating expense for purchased power of regulated operation.

tlabel: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
doc: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

tlabel: Other Deferred Costs, Net
doc: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

tlabel: Other Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Expenses
doc: Amount of expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other General and Administrative Expense
doc: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other General Expense
doc: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

tlabel: Other Income
doc: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

tlabel: Other Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets
doc: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

tlabel: Other Intangible Assets, Net
doc: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Interest and Dividend Income
doc: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

tlabel: Other Interest Earning Assets
doc: Amount of interest earning assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle (such as inventory related to long-term contracts or program rights).

tlabel: Other Inventory, Supplies, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other supplies used within the manufacturing or production process expected to be consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Investments
doc: Amount of investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
doc: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

tlabel: Other Labor-related Expenses
doc: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

tlabel: Other Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt, Current
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-term Investments
doc: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Noncash Expense
doc: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income
doc: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income Tax Expense
doc: The portion of the noncash component of income tax expense for the period other than the portion from the net change in the entity's deferred tax assets and liabilities.

tlabel: Other Noninterest Expense
doc: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Expense
doc: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income
doc: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring Expense
doc: Amount of other expense that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
doc: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable
doc: Amount of long-term notes payable classified as other.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable, Current
doc: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
doc: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

tlabel: Other Operating Income
doc: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

tlabel: Other Ownership Interests, Capital Account
doc: Capital account balance of the other unit holders in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Other Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

tlabel: Other Payments to Acquire Businesses
doc: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

tlabel: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

tlabel: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.

tlabel: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
doc: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Prepaid Expense, Current
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Real Estate
doc: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

tlabel: Other Real Estate and Foreclosed Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Valuation Adjustments
