doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term debt due within one year or the operating cycle if longer identified as Convertible Notes Payable. Convertible Notes Payable is a written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another, related security, at the option of the issuer and the holder.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Gross
doc: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
doc: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Current
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
doc: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

tlabel: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of loss recognized that results from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Interest Expense, Interest Income, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interests, Net
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

tlabel: Income Taxes Paid, Net
doc: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Interest Receivable, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from borrowers for interest payments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Current
doc: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Net (Including Goodwill)
doc: Carrying amount of finite-lived intangible assets, indefinite-lived intangible assets and goodwill. Goodwill is an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized. Intangible assets are assets, not including financial assets, lacking physical substance.

tlabel: Interest Expense
doc: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

tlabel: Interest Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Notes Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Operating Expenses
doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

tlabel: Operating Income (Loss)
doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

tlabel: Other Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Loans
doc: Cash payments for and related to principal collection on loans related to operating activities.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
doc: Total number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued to shareholders (includes related preferred shares that were issued, repurchased, and remain in the treasury). May be all or portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. Excludes preferred shares that are classified as debt.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Proceeds from Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Professional Fees
doc: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense
doc: The aggregate costs incurred (1) in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or (2) to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, including the costs of developing computer software up to the point in time of achieving technological feasibility, and costs allocated in accounting for a business combination to in-process projects deemed to have no alternative future use.

tlabel: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Shares, Issued
doc: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Price Per Share
doc: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
doc: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
doc: Number of new stock issued during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
doc: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
doc: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
doc: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
doc: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Restricted Stock
doc: Number of shares of restricted stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that restricted shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Restricted shares are subject to sales, contractual, regulatory or other restrictions that prevent or inhibit the holder from freely disposing of them before the restriction ends.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date, including liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, compensation costs, payroll taxes and fringe benefits (other than pension and postretirement obligations), contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

tlabel: Accrued Vacation, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

tlabel: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
doc: The sum of adjustments which are added to or deducted from net income or loss, including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interest, to reflect cash provided by or used in operating activities, in accordance with the indirect cash flow method.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Amortization of Intangible Assets
doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Cash
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Common Stock, Other Value, Outstanding
doc: Value of shares of other common stock instruments held by shareholders, such as exchangeable shares. May be all or portion of the number of common shares authorized.

tlabel: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Deposit Assets
doc: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

tlabel: Due from Affiliate, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

tlabel: Income Taxes Paid
doc: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Interest and Other Income
doc: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Goods, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of completed merchandise or goods expected to be sold within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Inventory, Gross
doc: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of raw materials expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
doc: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

tlabel: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

tlabel: Manufacturing Costs
doc: The aggregate costs incurred in the production of goods for sale.

tlabel: Marketing Expense
doc: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

tlabel: Other Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Assets
doc: Amount of assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Income
doc: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

tlabel: Other Intangible Assets, Net
doc: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Expense
doc: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.

tlabel: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
doc: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Selling, General and Administrative Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
doc: Amount of selling, general and administrative expenses resulting from transactions, excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements, with related party.

tlabel: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Due to Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Portion of the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties that is payable after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Investments
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Legal Fees
doc: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
doc: Fees paid to an agent employed by a corporation or mutual fund to maintain shareholder records, including purchases, sales, and account balances. Also includes custodian fees incurred during an accounting period from an agent, bank, trust company, or other organization that holds and safeguards an individual's, mutual fund's, or investment company's assets for them. These fees will be billed back to the client and are a component of noninterest expense.

tlabel: Accrued Professional Fees, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Advertising Expense
doc: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
doc: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

tlabel: Cash, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash. Cash is the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
doc: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

tlabel: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Warrants or Rights
doc: Number of securities into which the class of warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, 500,000 warrants may be converted into 1,000,000 shares.

tlabel: Class of Warrant or Right, Outstanding
doc: Number of warrants or rights outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
doc: Aggregate number of common shares reserved for future issuance.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Current
doc: Amount of debt premium to be amortized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of debt premium to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current
doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

tlabel: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
doc: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
doc: The adjustment to expense previously capitalized costs of drilling exploratory wells when proved reserves are not found or when the entity obtains information that raises substantial doubt about the economic or operational viability of the project.

tlabel: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
doc: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
doc: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
doc: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for goods and services provided by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries, subsidiaries of a common parent, an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

tlabel: Interest Receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
doc: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense, Current
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

tlabel: Proceeds from Loans
doc: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Price Per Share
doc: Per share amount received by subsidiary or equity investee for each share of common stock issued or sold in the stock transaction.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
doc: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
doc: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
doc: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

tlabel: Accrued Payroll Taxes
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory payroll taxes incurred through that date and withheld from employees pertaining to services received from them, including entity's matching share of the employees FICA taxes and contributions to the state and federal unemployment insurance programs.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

tlabel: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
doc: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Carrying Amount
doc: Carrying amount of assets sold under agreements to repurchase when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under repurchase agreements exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Value Assigned
doc: Value of equity interests (such as common shares, preferred shares, or partnership interest) issued or issuable to acquire the entity.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Number of Shares
doc: Number of shares of equity interests issued or issuable to acquire entity.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
doc: Percentage of voting equity interests acquired at the acquisition date in the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the value of a contingent consideration liability, including, but not limited to, differences arising upon settlement.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Assets
doc: Amount of assets acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Net
doc: Amount recognized for assets, including goodwill, in excess of (less than) the aggregate liabilities assumed.

tlabel: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

tlabel: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
doc: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

tlabel: Convertible Debt
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying amount of debt identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument (typically the entity's common stock) as of the balance sheet date, which originally required full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company.

tlabel: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
doc: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.

tlabel: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
doc: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

tlabel: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Amount
doc: The value of the financial instrument(s) that the original debt is being converted into in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued
doc: The number of shares issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Amount
doc: The amount of the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
doc: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
doc: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

tlabel: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

tlabel: Derivative, Fixed Interest Rate
doc: Fixed interest rate related to the interest rate derivative.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
doc: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

tlabel: Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition
doc: Amount of escrow deposit disbursements related to property acquisition in noncash investing or financing transactions.

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Income Tax
doc: Current period income tax expense or benefit pertaining to a gain (loss) on an extinguishment of debt.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability Value
doc: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Furniture and Fixtures, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments which were recognized in earnings, net of offsets by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

tlabel: Goodwill
doc: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
doc: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Finite-lived
doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of a finite-lived intangible asset to fair value.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.

tlabel: Interest and Debt Expense
doc: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
doc: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

tlabel: Interest Payable
doc: Amount of interest payable on debt, including, but not limited to, trade payables.

tlabel: Inventory, LIFO Reserve
doc: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
doc: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

tlabel: Investments and Other Noncurrent Assets
doc: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Issuance of Stock and Warrants for Services or Claims
doc: Fair value of share-based compensation granted to nonemployees as payment for services rendered or acknowledged claims.

tlabel: Litigation Settlement, Expense
doc: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

tlabel: Long-term Debt
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Directors Fees
doc: Noninterest expense related to directors' fees which are fees paid by an Entity to its directors. Directors' fees may be paid in addition to salary and other benefits.

tlabel: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
doc: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Net
doc: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

tlabel: Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

tlabel: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
doc: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

tlabel: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Monthly Rental Payments
doc: The amount of the monthly rental payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transactions involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

tlabel: Security Deposit
doc: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
doc: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
doc: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

tlabel: Share Price
doc: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks of a company.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
doc: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
doc: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
doc: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of operating activities of discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Due to Related Parties
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Notes and Loans Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of all long-term notes and loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Related Party Debt
doc: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

tlabel: Convertible Debt, Current
doc: The portion of the carrying value of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle if longer. Convertible debt is a financial instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
doc: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price
doc: The price per share of the conversion feature embedded in the debt instrument.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Principal
doc: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of debt discount to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

tlabel: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
doc: Amount of increase in assets, excluding financial assets, lacking physical substance with a definite life, from an acquisition.

tlabel: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

tlabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

tlabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, excluding discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Payments for Rent
doc: Cash payments to lessor's for use of assets under operating leases.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Proceeds from Insurance Premiums Collected
doc: Cash received as payments for insurance premiums during the current period.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Repayments of Short-term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.

tlabel: Royalty Guarantees, Commitments, Amount
doc: The amount the entity has committed to make for future royalty guarantees.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of share-based awards for which the grantee gained the right by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
doc: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Purchase of Assets
doc: Number of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
doc: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation
doc: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
doc: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Deposit Liabilities, Accrued Interest
doc: Amount of accrued but unpaid interest on deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

tlabel: Notes Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other General and Administrative Expense
doc: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mineral Rights
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

tlabel: Shares, Outstanding
doc: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

tlabel: Stock Issued
doc: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
doc: Amount of direct write-downs of accounts receivable charged against the allowance.

tlabel: Cash, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Includes cash within disposal group or discontinued operation.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of financing activities of discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities of discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Deferred Revenue
doc: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Deferred Revenue, Current
doc: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: Per basic and diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation, when the per share amount is the same.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash
doc: Amount of currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits, held by a disposal group.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of depreciation and amortization expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
doc: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
doc: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted share of common stock or unit when the per share amount is the same for both basic and diluted shares.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

tlabel: Interest Income, Other
doc: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Expense
doc: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

tlabel: Professional and Contract Services Expense
doc: Professional and contract service expense includes cost reimbursements for support services related to contracted projects, outsourced management, technical and staff support.

tlabel: Taxes Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount for accounts payable to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Common Stock, Value, Outstanding
doc: Value of all classes of common stock held by shareholders. May be all or portion of the number of common shares authorized. These shares exclude common shares repurchased by the entity and held as treasury shares.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed by the reporting entry in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Related Party
doc: Amount of interest expense incurred on a debt or other obligation to related party.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties.

tlabel: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
doc: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

tlabel: Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

tlabel: Cash, FDIC Insured Amount
doc: The amount of cash deposited in financial institutions as of the balance sheet date that is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Debt
doc: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

tlabel: Loans Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
doc: The aggregate amount of adjustments to net income or loss necessary to remove the effects of all items whose cash effects are investing or financing cash flows. The aggregate amount also includes all noncash expenses and income items which reduce or increase net income and are thus added back or deducted when calculating cash provided by or used in operating activities.

tlabel: Common Stock, Discount on Shares
doc: Discount on common shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

tlabel: Current Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
doc: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

tlabel: Accumulated Amortization of Other Deferred Costs
doc: Accumulated amortization of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs, deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies, or deferred leasing costs for real estate operations.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
doc: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

tlabel: Common Stock, No Par Value
doc: Face amount per share of no-par value common stock.
