tlabel: Construction in Progress, Gross
doc: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

tlabel: Costs Incurred, Development Costs
doc: Development costs incurred, including capitalized costs and costs charged to expense, in oil and gas activities.

tlabel: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

tlabel: Deferred Gain on Sale of Property
doc: Amount of gain on the sale of property that does not qualify for gain recognition as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits
doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Deferred Rent Credit, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Net, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting and classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Tax Deferred Income
doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from tax deferred revenue or income classified as other.

tlabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
doc: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
doc: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

tlabel: Investment Building and Building Improvements
doc: Aggregate of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of investments in building and building improvements.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Land and Land Improvements
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of real estate held for productive use and additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use, examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots. Excludes land held for sale.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Supplies, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other supplies used within the manufacturing or production process expected to be consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt, Current
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income
doc: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
doc: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, No Par Value
doc: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Prepaid Rent
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of other physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
doc: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Notes Payable
doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Selling and Marketing Expense
doc: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

tlabel: Selling Expense
doc: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
doc: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

tlabel: Net Assets
doc: Amount of net assets (liabilities).

tlabel: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
doc: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account
doc: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Land
doc: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account
doc: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to General Partners
doc: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to general partners.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to Limited Partners
doc: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to limited partners.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

tlabel: Operating Costs and Expenses
doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

tlabel: Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received classified as other, and expenses incurred but not yet paid, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable
doc: Amount of long-term notes payable classified as other.

tlabel: Partners' Capital
doc: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments
doc: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation pertaining to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

tlabel: Rental Income, Nonoperating
doc: Income earned by providing the use of assets to an outside party in exchange for a payment or series of payments that is nonoperating in nature.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
doc: The average number of limited partnership and general partnership units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per limited partnership and general partnership unit.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Current
doc: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as trading securities nor held-to-maturity securities and intended be sold or mature one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

tlabel: Deferred Costs, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of deferred cost, excluding capitalized cost related to contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
doc: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Dividends Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
doc: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade
doc: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, or (c) a combination of (a) and (b).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Leasing Fees
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of deferred leasing fees. Amortization of these fees over the terms of the leases reduces deferred leasing fees. Originating new leases increases the balance of deferred leasing fees.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Unbilled Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amount of revenue for work performed for which billing has not occurred, net of uncollectible accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Domestic Deposits
doc: Interest earned on deposits in United States money market accounts and other United States interest earning accounts.

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

tlabel: Inventory Valuation Reserves
doc: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

tlabel: Line of Credit, Current
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Receivables
doc: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The cash outflow to acquire debt and equity securities not classified as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities which would be classified as available-for-sale securities and reported at fair value, with unrealized gains and losses excluded from earnings and reported in a separate component of shareholders' equity.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Receivables
doc: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Prepaid Taxes
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Long-term Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares
doc: Number of non-vested options outstanding.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Number of Shares
doc: Number of non-vested options forfeited.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Number of Shares
doc: Number of options vested.

tlabel: State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of current and deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares
doc: Number of common and preferred shares that were previously issued and that were repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury on the financial statement date. This stock has no voting rights and receives no dividends.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value
doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

tlabel: Accrued Salaries, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations incurred through that date and payable for employees' services provided. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to reporting entity's executives and owners.

tlabel: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

tlabel: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: AOCI before Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities
doc: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
doc: This item represents the cost of debt and equity securities, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading, net of adjustments including accretion, amortization, collection of cash, previous other-than-temporary impairments recognized in earnings (less any cumulative-effect adjustments recognized, as defined), and fair value hedge accounting adjustments, if any.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: This item represents the difference between the gross realized gains and losses realized on the sale of debt or equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities. Additionally, this item would include any losses recognized for other than temporary impairments (OTTI) of the subject investments in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
doc: Amount of unrealized gain before deducting unrealized loss on investments in debt and equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized loss before deducting unrealized gain on investments in available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of capitalized costs for computer software, including but not limited to, acquired and internally developed computer software.

tlabel: Lease Obligation Incurred
doc: Amount of increase in lease obligation from new lease.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Noncurrent
doc: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

tlabel: Direct Financing Lease, Revenue
doc: Amount of direct financing lease revenue.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Condemnation
doc: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
doc: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Income, Related Party
doc: Amount of interest income earned from interest-bearing assets owed to the entity by related party.

tlabel: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
doc: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

tlabel: Loss on Sale of Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Net Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Trading Securities
doc: The sum of the realized and unrealized net gain (loss) on trading securities during the period.

tlabel: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Lease Income
doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Five Years
doc: Future rental payments receivable within the fifth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Four Years
doc: Future rental payments receivable within the fourth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Three Years
doc: Future rental payments receivable within the third year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
doc: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

tlabel: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
doc: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Other Assets, Current
doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Investment Transferred from Available-for-sale to Equity Method, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) of investment classified as available-for-sale transferred to equity method.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Prepaid Expense, Current
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Payments for Deposits
doc: The amount of cash paid for deposits on goods and services during the period; excludes time deposits and deposits with other institutions, which pertain to financial service entities.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
doc: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

tlabel: Payments of Debt Restructuring Costs
doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Management Contract Rights
doc: The cash outflow from amounts paid for the rights to manage the property.

tlabel: Prepaid Insurance
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of debt and equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

tlabel: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
doc: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

tlabel: Provision for Other Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to other loss.

tlabel: Receivables, Long-term Contracts or Programs
doc: Amount to be collected within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from customers in accordance with the contractual provisions of long-term contracts or programs including amounts billed and unbilled as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

tlabel: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Loans from Vendors
doc: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.

tlabel: Repayments of Medium-term Notes
doc: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Restricted Cash, Current
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Amount
doc: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
doc: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

tlabel: Trading Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) realized from securities classified as trading.

tlabel: Trading Securities, Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized holding gain (loss) recognized in the income statement for investments in debt and equity securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests classified as trading.

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Short-term Debt
doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer), including liabilities for compensation costs, fringe benefits other than pension and postretirement obligations, rent, contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Loss, Recovery of Bad Debts
doc: Amount of recovery of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially written-off as bad debts.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cost of Other Property Operating Expense
doc: Other operating costs incurred during the reporting period and may include amounts paid to maintain the property.

tlabel: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
doc: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

tlabel: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
doc: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

tlabel: Dividends
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank Borrowings, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of borrowing from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Amortized Cost, before Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount, before other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) accretion, of investment in debt securities measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of assets used to generate operating income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

tlabel: Insurance Services Revenue
doc: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), after Provision for Loan Loss
doc: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), Net
doc: The net amount of operating interest income (expense).

tlabel: Interest Income, Operating
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

tlabel: Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of investment securities, including, but not limited to, marketable securities, derivative financial instruments, and investments accounted for under the equity method.

tlabel: Labor and Related Expense
doc: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
doc: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
doc: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross
doc: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
doc: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Maturities of Subordinated Debt
doc: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

tlabel: Other Assets, Miscellaneous
doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets.

tlabel: Other Expenses
doc: Amount of expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

tlabel: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given
doc: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net
doc: The amount of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses on equity securities, OTTI related to credit losses on debt securities, and OTTI losses on debt securities when the entity intends to sell the securities or it is more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell the securities before recovery of its amortized cost basis. Additionally, this item includes OTTI losses recognized during the period on investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting.

tlabel: Payments of Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
doc: The cash outflow to acquire equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities, because they are not classified as trading securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net
doc: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

tlabel: Premiums Earned, Net
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

tlabel: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
doc: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

tlabel: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
doc: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
doc: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

tlabel: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

tlabel: Repayments of Commercial Paper
doc: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.

tlabel: Repayments of Lines of Credit
doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

tlabel: Repayments of Senior Debt
doc: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

tlabel: Repayments of Subordinated Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

tlabel: Senior Notes
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

tlabel: Senior Notes, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to debt holders having a lesser priority of repayment.

tlabel: Short-term Investments
doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

tlabel: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Capital and Surplus Required
doc: Amount of statutory capital required to be maintained as of the balance sheet date under prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practices.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Change in Reporting Entity
doc: Impact on total stockholders' equity of cumulative effect of change in reporting entity. A change in reporting entity is considered as follows: (1) presenting consolidated statements in place of the financial statements of individual reporting entities; (2) changing the combination of subsidiaries that make up the group for which the consolidated financial statements are presented; and (3) changing the entities included in the combined financial statements. A business combination accounted for under the purchase method and the consolidation of a variable interest entity are not considered a change in reporting entity.

tlabel: Subordinated Debt
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Securities
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in the income statement on unsold other securities.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

tlabel: Due from Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from related parties including affiliates, employees, joint ventures, officers and stockholders, immediate families thereof, and pension funds.

tlabel: Employee Benefit and Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to the reporting entity for good and services provided to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Expense
doc: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Customers
doc: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Operating Activity
doc: Amount of cash inflow from lease payment, classified as operating activity.

tlabel: Recognition of Deferred Revenue
doc: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Revenue
doc: Amount of sales-type lease revenue.

tlabel: Short-term Non-bank Loans and Notes Payable
doc: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

tlabel: Salary and Wage, Officer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by officer. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Other General Expense
doc: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

tlabel: Property Management Fee Revenue
doc: The amount of revenue derived from managing real estate properties.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
doc: Expenses recognized resulting from transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

tlabel: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
doc: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

tlabel: Unbilled Receivables, Current
doc: Amount received for services rendered and products shipped, but not yet billed, for non-contractual agreements due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accrued Sales Commission, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for sales commissions. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Billings in Excess of Cost, Current
doc: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized within one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

tlabel: Costs in Excess of Billings
doc: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Noncurrent
doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Billing in Excess of Cost of Earnings
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability reflecting cash payments received before the related costs have been incurred.

tlabel: Inventory, Parts and Components, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date for elements of machinery or equipment held for the purpose of replacing similar parts in the course of repair or maintenance.

tlabel: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock
doc: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets
doc: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Deferred Rent Credit
doc: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized.

tlabel: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities
doc: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Discontinued Operations
doc: The amount of cash paid during the current period for interest owed on debt associated with discontinued operations.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations
doc: Increase (decrease) in cash associated with the entity's discontinued operations.

tlabel: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received
doc: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
doc: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount
doc: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Due from (to) Related Party
doc: Receivables to be collected from (obligations owed to) related parties, net as of the balance sheet date where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other
doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
doc: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

tlabel: Unsecured Debt, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, uncollateralized debt obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Warrants and Rights Outstanding
doc: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

tlabel: Area of Real Estate Property
doc: Area of a real estate property.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Accumulated Amortization
doc: For each balance sheet presented, the amount of accumulated amortization for capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Amortization
doc: Amount of expense for amortization of capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Notes Issued
doc: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued
doc: The value of the financial instrument issued [noncash or part noncash] in the conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties
doc: Amount for accounts payable to related parties.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

tlabel: Accrued Payroll Taxes, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory payroll taxes incurred through that date and withheld from employees pertaining to services received from them, including entity's matching share of the employees FICA taxes and contributions to the state and federal unemployment insurance programs. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Royalties
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for royalties.

tlabel: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Preferred Stock
doc: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Amortization of ESOP Award
doc: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
doc: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Convertible Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date, net of the amount due in the next twelve months or greater than the normal operating cycle, if longer. The debt is convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

tlabel: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Noncurrent
doc: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

tlabel: Cumulative Earnings (Deficit)
doc: Amount of cumulative earnings (deficits) for relevant time periods.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-based Compensation Expense
doc: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. Excludes amount related to plans that cover generally all employees (for example, but not limited to, qualified pension plans).

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Equity
doc: Value of stock issued under share-based plans to employees or officers which is the unearned portion, accounted for under the fair value method.

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

tlabel: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

tlabel: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts, Notes and Loans Receivable, Net
doc: Amount classified as accounts, notes and loans receivable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
doc: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
doc: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Current
doc: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Prepaid and Other Assets
doc: Amount classified as prepaid and other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment
doc: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Due to Officers or Stockholders
doc: Amounts due to recorded owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company.

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.
