Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Fair Value of Assets Acquired
doc: The fair value of assets acquired in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Patents, Gross
doc: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to the exclusive legal rights granted to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law. Such costs may have been expended to directly apply and receive patent rights, or to acquire such rights.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Trade Names, Gross
doc: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
doc: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

tlabel: Liabilities Subject to Compromise
doc: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

tlabel: Long-term Debt, Fair Value
doc: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

tlabel: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing Operations
doc: The increase (decrease) in cash associated with the entity's continuing operating, investing, and financing activities. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a debit balance consistent with its label.

tlabel: Notes and Loans Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), payable to related parties, which are due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
doc: The total amount due within more than 12 month, or the operating cycle if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

tlabel: Other Employee-related Liabilities
doc: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other.

tlabel: Other Loans Payable, Long-term, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
doc: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
doc: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
doc: Amount of acquisition of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Receivable from Shareholders or Affiliates for Issuance of Capital Stock
doc: Amount due from owner or affiliate of reporting entity for issuance of shares. Includes, but is not limited to, amount due for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount due from officer or director.

tlabel: Repayments of Convertible Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Secured Debt
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

tlabel: Secured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
doc: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

tlabel: Unsecured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Other
doc: Amount of obligations incurred and payable classified as other.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount of receivables arising from transactions with related parties due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Advances to Affiliate
doc: Long-Term advances receivable from a party that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. This does not include advances to clients.

tlabel: Common Stock, Share Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
doc: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated common stock.

tlabel: Derivative Assets (Liabilities), at Fair Value, Net
doc: Fair values as of the balance sheet date of the net amount of all assets and liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Liability
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Rent
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Management Fee Expense
doc: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

tlabel: Other Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets
doc: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

tlabel: Other Notes Payable, Current
doc: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Payments for Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

tlabel: Settlement Liabilities, Current
doc: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.

tlabel: Bank Overdrafts
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of payments made in excess of existing cash balances, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the entity. Overdrafts generally have a very short time frame for correction or repayment and are therefore more similar to short-term bank financing than trade financing.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Book Overdrafts
doc: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

tlabel: Acquisition Costs, Period Cost
doc: The capitalized costs incurred during the period (excluded from amortization) to purchase, lease or otherwise acquire an unproved property, including costs of lease bonuses and options to purchase or lease properties, the portion of costs applicable to minerals when land including mineral rights is purchased in fee, brokers' fees, recording fees, legal costs, and other costs incurred in acquiring properties.

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
doc: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
doc: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
doc: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
doc: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization and Valuation Allowance Relating to Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization and valuation allowance relating to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs of Unproved Properties Excluded from Amortization, Cumulative
doc: The sum of the capitalized costs incurred, as of the balance sheet date, of unproved properties excluded from amortization including acquisition costs, exploration costs, development costs, and production costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Oil and Gas Producing Activities, Gross
doc: The sum of capitalized costs relating to oil and gas producing activities before accounting for accumulated depreciation.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Oil and Gas Producing Activities, Net
doc: Net amount of capitalized costs relating to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Proved Properties
doc: Capitalized costs of proved properties incurred for any combination mineral interests acquisitions; wells and related equipment; support equipment and facilities; and uncompleted wells and equipment and other costs not previously disclosed within this table.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Unproved Properties
doc: Capitalized costs of unproved properties incurred for any combination mineral interests acquisitions and other costs not previously disclosed within this table.

tlabel: Compensated Absences Liability
doc: Amount of liability accrued for the employer's obligation related to an employee's right to receive compensation for future absences that have been earned by employee.

tlabel: Costs Incurred, Exploration Costs
doc: Exploration costs incurred, including capitalized costs and costs charged to expense, in oil and gas activities.

tlabel: Costs Incurred, Oil and Gas Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development Activities
doc: Amount of costs incurred related to oil and gas property acquisition, exploration and development activities, including capitalized costs and costs charged to expense.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

tlabel: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Derivatives
doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from derivatives.

tlabel: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Derivative Asset, Current
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
doc: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Paid-in-kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
doc: The expense recorded to reduce the value of oil and gas assets consisting of proved properties and unproved properties as the estimate of future successful production from these properties is reduced.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

tlabel: Interest Costs Capitalized
doc: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

tlabel: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

tlabel: Loans Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer, excluding current portion.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Depletion
doc: Depletion of oil and gas property carried under the full cost method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Gross
doc: Oil and gas properties, gross, carried under the full cost method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Net
doc: Oil and gas properties, net of depletion, carried under the full cost method.

tlabel: Other Asset Impairment Charges
doc: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

tlabel: Other Deferred Costs, Net
doc: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Receivables, Net, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Production Costs, Period Cost
doc: The capitalized costs incurred during the period (excluded from amortization) to operate and maintain wells and related equipment and facilities, including depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of operating and maintaining those wells and related equipment and facilities. They become part of the cost of oil and gas produced. Examples of production costs (sometimes called lifting costs) are: costs of labor to operate the wells and related equipment and facilities; repairs and maintenance; materials, supplies, and fuel consumed and supplies utilized in operating the wells and related equipment and facilities; property taxes and insurance applicable to proved properties and wells and related equipment and facilities; severance taxes; some support equipment or facilities may serve two or more oil and gas producing activities and may also serve transportation, refining, and marketing activities. To the extent that the support equipment and facilities are used in oil and gas producing activities, their depreciation and applicable operating costs become exploration, development or production costs, as appropriate. Depreciation, depletion, and amortization of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs are not production costs but also become part of the cost of oil and gas produced along with production (lifting) costs identified above.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Lines of Credit
doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
doc: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
doc: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
doc: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

tlabel: Common Stock, Value, Subscriptions
doc: Monetary value of common stock allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of common stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

tlabel: Depreciation, Nonproduction
doc: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Finished Goods and Work in Process Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of finished goods inventory and work in process inventory.

tlabel: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
doc: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Loans Payable to Bank, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Long-term Investments
doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
doc: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

tlabel: Other Loans Payable, Current
doc: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

tlabel: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
doc: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

tlabel: Conversion of Stock, Amount Converted
doc: The value of the stock converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Deposits Assets
doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment in the future.

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of an intangible asset (excluding goodwill) to fair value.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Amounts of Transaction
doc: Amount of transactions with related party during the financial reporting period.

tlabel: Consideration Received for Beneficial Interest Obtained for Transferring Financial Asset
doc: Amount of beneficial interest received as consideration for transferring noncash financial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, trade receivable in securitization transaction.

tlabel: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
doc: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Equity Method Investments
doc: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Liabilities Assumed
doc: The fair value of liabilities assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Long-term Line of Credit
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Current
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

tlabel: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference
doc: The aggregate liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Transfer to Investments
doc: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

tlabel: Debt, Current
doc: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Due from Other Related Parties
doc: Amount receivable from related parties classified as other.

tlabel: Due to Other Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount payable to related parties classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Additional Capital
doc: Amount of additional paid-in capital (APIC) classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Equity
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

tlabel: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Short-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
doc: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Investments in debt and equity securities which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading and which are intended to be sold or mature more than one year from the balance sheet date or operating cycle, if longer. Such securities are reported at fair value; unrealized gains (losses) related to Available-for-sale Securities are excluded from earnings and reported in a separate component of shareholders' equity (other comprehensive income), unless the Available-for-sale security is designated as a hedge or is determined to have had an other than temporary decline in fair value below its amortized cost basis. All or a portion of the unrealized holding gain (loss) of an Available-for-sale security that is designated as being hedged in a fair value hedge is recognized in earnings during the period of the hedge, as are other than temporary declines in fair value below the cost basis for investments in equity securities and debt securities that an entity intends to sell or it is more likely than not that it will be required to sell before the recovery of its amortized cost basis. Other than temporary declines in fair value below the cost basis for debt securities categorized as Available-for-sale that an entity does not intend to sell and for which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before the recovery of its amortized cost basis are bifurcated into credit losses and losses related to all other factors. Other than temporary declines in fair value below cost basis related to credit losses are recognized in earnings, and losses related to all other factors are recognized in other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Cost-method Investments, Other than Temporary Impairment
doc: This item represents an other than temporary decline in value that has been recognized against an investment accounted for under the cost method of accounting. The excess of the carrying amount over the fair value of the investment represents the amount of the write down which is or was reflected in earnings. The written down value is a new cost basis with the adjusted value of the investment becoming its new carrying value. Evidence of a loss in value might include, but would not necessarily be limited to, absence of an ability to recover the carrying amount of the investment or inability of the investee to sustain an earnings capacity which would justify the carrying amount of the investment.

tlabel: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, before Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the cumulative effect on retained earnings before related income tax effect.

tlabel: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expenses, Other
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
doc: Amount of increase in assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with an indefinite life, from an acquisition.

tlabel: Marketing and Advertising Expense
doc: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Other Noninterest Expense
doc: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Construction in Process
doc: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

tlabel: Payments of Financing Costs
doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Projects
doc: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

tlabel: Sales Commissions and Fees
doc: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

tlabel: Self Insurance Reserve, Current
doc: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Note, Subscriptions Receivable
doc: Note received instead of cash as contribution to equity. The transaction may be a sale of capital stock or a contribution to paid-in capital.

tlabel: Billings in Excess of Cost
doc: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
doc: The carrying amount of capitalized computer software costs net of accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Common Stock Reserved for Future Issuance
doc: Number of common shares reserved for future issuance related to deferred compensation arrangements with individuals.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cost in Excess of Billing on Uncompleted Contract
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

tlabel: Payments to Develop Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
doc: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

tlabel: Royalty Expense
doc: Amount of expense related to royalty payments under a contractual arrangement such as payment for mineral and drilling rights and use of technology or intellectual property.

tlabel: Accretion Expense
doc: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all assets and liabilities used in operating activities.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

tlabel: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating, Net
doc: The net amount of nonoperating interest income (expense).

tlabel: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Repayments of Secured Debt
doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Short-term Bank Loans and Notes Payable
doc: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Subordinated Debt, Current
doc: The portion of the carrying value of subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle, if longer. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

tlabel: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosures
doc: Fair value portion of borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Current
doc: Amount of debt discount to be amortized within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Operating Income
doc: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
doc: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

tlabel: Customer Deposits, Current
doc: The current portion of money or property received from customers which is either to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or applied to customer receivables in accordance with the terms of the contract or the understandings.

tlabel: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Warrants or Options Issued
doc: The number of warrants issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Security Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in security deposits.

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Warrants Issued
doc: The number of warrants issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
doc: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment
doc: The amount of a reclassification adjustment made to prior period financial statement amounts.

tlabel: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
doc: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation
doc: Number of shares of common stock subject to repurchase or cancellation determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Common stock subject to repurchase are outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall).

tlabel: Accelerated Share Repurchase Program, Adjustment
doc: The amount needed to adjust previously recorded stockholders' equity balances to the actual aggregate amounts paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.

tlabel: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Settlement (Payment) or Receipt
doc: Amount of cash receipt from (payment to) bank; or stock received from (issuance to) bank in the settlement of the accelerated share repurchase agreement.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of trade and related party payables and accrued expenses.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of liabilities incurred for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business and related party payables.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
doc: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of accounts payable to related parties, due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Trade
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Underwriters, Promoters, and Employees, Current
doc: Amount of obligation to underwriters, promoters, and employees excluding salaries, wages and amount to related party, classified as current.

tlabel: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage
doc: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs but not paid. Excludes amounts due that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable from Securitization
doc: The amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amount of receivables arising from transactions with related parties.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of receivables arising from transactions with related parties, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
doc: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Accretion Expense, Including Asset Retirement Obligations
doc: Amount of accretion expense, which includes, but is not limited to, accretion expense from asset retirement obligations, environmental remediation obligations, and other contingencies.

tlabel: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies
doc: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

tlabel: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes.

tlabel: Accrued Advertising, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for advertising of the entity's goods and services. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Bonuses, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for incentive compensation awarded to employees and directors or earned by them based on the terms of one or more relevant arrangements. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs
doc: The amount of estimated costs accrued as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility (such as a landfill or waste treatment facility). Represents the portion that will be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs, Noncurrent
doc: The estimated amount of costs required as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility, which will be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Accrued Employee Benefits, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Employee Benefits
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them.

tlabel: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Current
doc: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable in twelve months or in the next operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable after twelve months or beyond the next operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Accrued Fees and Other Revenue Receivable
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, the amount of fees and other revenue, excluding investment income receivable, earned but not yet received, which were recognized in conformity with revenue recognition criteria based on estimates or specific contractual terms.

tlabel: Accrued Income Taxes
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due. This amount is the total of current and noncurrent accrued income taxes.

tlabel: Accrued Income Taxes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due beyond one year or the operating cycle, whichever is longer. Alternate captions include income taxes payable, noncurrent.

tlabel: Accrued Insurance, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Insurance
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees.

tlabel: Accrued Insurance, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due beyond one year (or beyond one operating cycle if longer) to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverages to employees.

tlabel: Accrued Investment Income Receivable
doc: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

tlabel: Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of accrued expenses.

tlabel: Gift Card Liability, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability for outstanding gift cards. Retail customers purchase gift cards or gift certificates that can be redeemed at a later date for merchandise or services; those unredeemed represent a liability of the entity because the revenue is being deferred.

tlabel: Accrued Marketing Costs, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for the marketing, trade and selling of the entity's goods and services. Marketing costs would include expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services; costs of public relations and corporate promotions; and obligations incurred and payable for sales discounts, rebates, price protection programs, etc. offered to customers and under government programs. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Participation Liabilities, Due in Next Operating Cycle
doc: The amount of accrued participation liabilities that it expects to pay during the upcoming operating cycle.

tlabel: Accrued Professional Fees
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received.

tlabel: Accrued Reclamation Costs, Current
doc: Current portion of reclamation reserve to restore a mining or drilling site to the condition agreed upon within the mining or drilling contract.

tlabel: Accrued Rent, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for contractual rent under lease arrangements. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Rent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for contractual rent under lease arrangements.

tlabel: Accrued Rent, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for contractual rent under lease arrangements.

tlabel: Accrued Royalties, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for royalties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Salaries
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations incurred through that date and payable for employees' services provided.

tlabel: Accrued Sales Commission
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for sales commissions.

tlabel: Accrued Vacation
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees.

tlabel: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

tlabel: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Accumulated Deferred Investment Tax Credit
doc: The noncurrent portion of the reserve for accumulated deferred investment tax credits as of the balance sheet date. This is the remaining investment credit, which will reduce the cost of services collected from ratepayers by a ratable portion over the investment's regulatory life.

tlabel: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
doc: Cumulative amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization (related to property, plant and equipment, but not including land or leased assets).

tlabel: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment
doc: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization as a result of sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment.

tlabel: Accumulated Distributions in Excess of Net Income
doc: The amount as of the balance sheet date by which cumulative distributions to shareholders (or partners) exceed retained earnings (or accumulated earnings).

tlabel: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
doc: Amount, before Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessment, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
doc: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Available-for-sale, Debt Securities
doc: Accumulated other comprehensive loss related to portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized as available-for-sale that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Debt Securities
doc: Total of accumulated other comprehensive loss related to that portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized either as available-for-sale or held-to-maturity that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

tlabel: Acquisition Costs, Cumulative
doc: The capitalized costs incurred (excluded from amortization), as of the date of the balance sheet, to purchase, lease or otherwise acquire an unproved property, including costs of lease bonuses and options to purchase or lease properties, the portion of costs applicable to minerals when land including mineral rights is purchased in fee, brokers' fees, recording fees, legal costs, and other costs incurred in acquiring properties.

tlabel: Additions to Contract Holders Funds
doc: The cash inflow from a segregated fund account during the period.

tlabel: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Gross of Tax
doc: Current period adjustment resulting from gains and losses on intercompany foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, that is, settlement is not planned or anticipated in the foreseeable future. Resulting from the entities to the transaction being consolidated, combined, or accounted for by the equity method in the reporting entity's financial statements.

tlabel: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Net of Tax
doc: Current period adjustment resulting from gains and losses on intercompany foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature because settlement is not planned or anticipated in the foreseeable future. Resulting from the entities to the transaction being consolidated, combined, or accounted for by the equity method in the reporting entity's financial statements.

tlabel: Adjustment of Warrants Granted for Services
doc: Adjustment for noncash service expenses paid for by granting of warrants.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
doc: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
doc: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt, Subsequent Adjustments
doc: The amount of subsequent adjustments to additional paid in capital for convertible financial instruments where a component of equity and a component of debt are recognized.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-based Compensation
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax deficiency associated with a share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit associated with share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes, but is not limited to, excess tax benefit.

tlabel: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-based Compensation, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit (deficiency) associated with an share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Administrative Fees Expense
doc: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

tlabel: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
doc: Carrying amount of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency or vendor on behalf of the borrower.

tlabel: Advance Rent
doc: Amount at the balance sheet date that has been received by the entity that represents rents paid in advance.

tlabel: Advance Royalties, Current
doc: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable. This amount is expected to be consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Advance Royalties, Noncurrent
doc: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable. This amount is expected to be consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Advances, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances carried under the fair value option.

tlabel: Advances from Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of borrowings as of the balance sheet date from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and liquidity shortages.

tlabel: Advances on Inventory Purchases
doc: Carrying value of capitalized payments made in advance for inventory that is expected to be received within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Affiliate Costs
doc: Costs associated with revenues arising from an entity that is an affiliate of the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Program Assessments
doc: Amount of expense for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments required by the Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Program Obligation
doc: Amount of obligation related to Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments required by the Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Program Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of obligation related to Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments required by the Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

tlabel: Affordable Housing Project Investment, Write-down, Amount
doc: Amount of write-down from impairment of an investment in a qualified affordable housing project.

tlabel: Agricultural Related Inventory
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or supplies held which are related to plants and animals.

tlabel: Aircraft Maintenance, Materials, and Repairs
doc: Maintenance costs incurred and directly related to services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. Includes the cost of inspections and repairs, materials and routine maintenance costs for all aircraft and engines.

tlabel: Aircraft Rental
doc: Expenses incurred related to the lease of aircraft from outside third parties that are used in the entity's business operations.

tlabel: Airline, Capacity Purchase Arrangements
doc: Costs incurred related to air services provided by third-party transportation companies, including regional affiliates.

tlabel: Airline Related Inventory, Gross
doc: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies to be used in air transport of passengers and freight.

tlabel: Airline Related Inventory, Aircraft Fuel, Gross
doc: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of fuel used in air transportation.

tlabel: Airline Related Inventory, Aircraft Parts, Gross
doc: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of plant or equipment components to be used for the primary purpose of air transportation.

tlabel: Airline Related Inventory, Net
doc: Net carrying amount, as of the balance sheet date, of expendable merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies to be used primarily in air transport of passengers and freight.

tlabel: Airline Related Inventory, Valuation Reserves
doc: The amount of the valuation account as of the balance sheet date which reduces the carrying amount of airline related inventory (including expendable merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies to be used primarily in air transport of passengers or freight) to net realizable value; takes into consideration such factors as market value, excessive quantities based on expected sales, technological obsolescence, and shrinkage.

tlabel: Air Traffic Liability, Current
