doc: The value of air transportation services sold but as yet unused by the passenger, including sales for air transportation to be provided by the reporting air carrier and air transportation to be provided by another air carrier for whom sales were made. Used to reflect the current portion of the liability (within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
doc: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, from recovery.

tlabel: Allowance for Doubtful Other Receivables, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable, classified as other and current.

tlabel: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
doc: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Adjustments, Other
doc: Amount of other addition (reduction) in allowance reserve for credit loss.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Foreign Currency Translation
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from converting allowance reserve for credit loss to currency of reporting entity from amount denominated or measured in a different currency, which decreases (increases) the allowance for loan and lease losses.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
doc: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Write-offs
doc: Amount of loans and leases that have been written off from both loan receivables and allowance reserve for credit loss.

tlabel: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses Write-offs, Net
doc: Amount, after recoveries, of loans and leases that have been written-off.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Allowance for Uncollectible Customer's Liability for Acceptances
doc: Represents the reserve against amounts due from customers which are uncollectible or questionable as to collection and which specifically relate to short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known banker's acceptances).

tlabel: Alternative Investment
doc: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

tlabel: Amortization and Depreciation of Decontaminating and Decommissioning Assets
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale to allocate or recognize the cost of the assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Amortization Method Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments
doc: Amount of investment in qualified affordable housing projects.

tlabel: Amortization Method Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization expense of investment in qualified affordable housing projects.

tlabel: Amortization of above and below Market Leases
doc: Amount of non-cash amortization of intangible asset (liability) for above and below market leases.

tlabel: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amortization of Advance Royalty
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of the advance royalties. These royalties are paid in one accounting period, but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization. For example, royalties that are required to be paid in advance of production from a mineral, oil, or gas property and amortized over the period of right to produce these items.

tlabel: Amortization of Below Market Lease
doc: Amount of amortization of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Charges
doc: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
doc: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees
doc: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction.

tlabel: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Amortization of Leased Asset
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

tlabel: Amortization of Lease Incentives
doc: Amount of amortization of lease incentive costs incurred by the lessor for the benefit of the lessee.

tlabel: Amortization of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
doc: The periodic amortization (in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss) of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amortization of Nuclear Fuel Lease
doc: Amount of amortization of nuclear fuel.

tlabel: Amortization of Power Contracts Emission Credits
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized costs related to purchasing power, fuel, or emission credits. These items may be purchased in one accounting period but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization.

tlabel: Amortization of Value of Business Acquired (VOBA)
doc: The adjustment that represents the periodic charge against earnings to reduce the value of business acquired (VOBA) over the expected life of the underlying insurance contracts. VOBA reflects the estimated fair value of a life insurance business in force and represents the portion of the cost to acquire the business that is allocated to the value of the right to receive future cash flows from insurance contracts existing at the date of acquisition. Such value is the present value of the actuarially determined projected cash flows for the acquired policies. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Amount of Deferred Costs Related to Long-term Contracts
doc: Amount of deferred costs for long-term contracts and programs. Includes, but is not limited to, initial tooling costs and deferred production costs.

tlabel: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Options and Restrictive Stock Units
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of stock options or restrictive stock units (RSUs).

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
doc: Amount recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) and other comprehensive (income) loss.

tlabel: Ancillary Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
doc: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset, excluding contractually specified servicing fees and late fees.

tlabel: AOCI, Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge.

tlabel: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income.

tlabel: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: AOCI Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

tlabel: Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Assumptions
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the assumptions or model used to calculate the fair value of a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
doc: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Legally Restricted Assets, Fair Value
doc: Carrying amount of an asset that is legally restricted for purposes of settling an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Fixed Maturities, Held-to-maturity, at Amortized Cost
doc: Carrying amount of investments in debt securities that are deemed to be held to maturity that are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

tlabel: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the disposal of an asset through means other than sale, for example, but not limited to, abandonment, spin-off, and expropriation.

tlabel: Assets, Fair Value Adjustment
doc: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

tlabel: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

tlabel: Assets Held-for-sale, Long Lived, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of assets classified as held for sale.

tlabel: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current, Other
doc: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other
doc: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

tlabel: Assets Held-in-trust
doc: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

tlabel: Assets Held-in-trust, Current
doc: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate within one year of the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

tlabel: Assets Held-in-trust, Noncurrent
doc: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate more than one year from the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

tlabel: Assets, Noncurrent, Other than Noncurrent Investments and Property, Plant and Equipment
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets, excluding property, plant, and equipment and other property and investments, that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Charges and Other Assets.

tlabel: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Repurchase Liability
doc: Amount to be repaid to the counterparty to the repurchase agreement when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under the repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

tlabel: Assumed Premiums Earned
doc: Amount of earned premiums assumed from other entities.

tlabel: Assumed Premiums Written
doc: Amount of written premiums assumed from other entities.

tlabel: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Liquidation Value
doc: The amount of the liquidation value for auction market preferred securities.

tlabel: Auction Rate Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of securities that are debt instruments (corporate or municipal bonds) that typically have long-term nominal maturities for which the interest rate is reset through an auction process.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost
doc: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain
doc: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
doc: This item represents the cost of equity securities, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading, net of adjustments for other-than-temporary impairments recognized in earnings (less any cumulative-effect adjustments recognized, as defined), and fair value hedge accounting adjustments, if any.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
doc: Amount of unrealized gain before deducting unrealized loss on investments in equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized loss before deducting unrealized gain on investments in available-for-sale equity securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of unrealized gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investments in debt and equity securities classified as available-for-sale.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities and Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of debt and equity financial instruments classified as either held-to-maturity or available-for-sale.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Change in Net Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
doc: The change in unrealized holding gain (loss), net of tax, on available-for-sale securities included in a separate component of shareholders' equity during the period.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Current
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Equity Securities
doc: Amount of equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor as trading.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Equity Securities, Current
doc: Amount of investments in equity securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests classified as available-for-sale, expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Equity Securities, Noncurrent
doc: Equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading which are intended be sold more than one year from the balance sheet date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
doc: This item represents the difference between the gross realized gains and losses realized on the sale of debt or equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gains
doc: This item represents the gross profit realized on the sale of debt or equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Realized Losses, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
doc: Amount of loss realized on the sale of debt or equity securities classified as available-for-sale. Excludes other than temporary impairments (OTTI).

tlabel: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other, Third Party Guarantees, Amount
doc: Amount of third party guarantees against loss of value in the underlying assets related to available-for-sale security in an unrealized loss position and for which other-than-temporary impairments (OTTI) have not been recognized.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Restricted
doc: The carrying amount of securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading which serve as security for borrowings or other arrangements.

tlabel: Available-for-sale Securities, Transfers to Trading, Gross Gains
doc: Amount of gain included in earnings for reclassification of securities from available-for-sale into trading.

tlabel: Bank Acceptances Executed and Outstanding
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of drafts and bills of exchange that have been accepted by the reporting bank, or by others for its own account, as its liability to holders of the drafts.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Bank Loan, Short-term
doc: Amount of short-term bank loan secured by broker-dealer customer's security.

tlabel: Bank Owned Life Insurance
doc: The carrying amount of a life insurance policy on an officer, executive or employee for which the reporting entity (a bank) is entitled to proceeds from the policy upon death of the insured or surrender of the insurance policy.

tlabel: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
doc: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

tlabel: Basic Earnings Per Share, Pro Forma
doc: Pro forma basic earnings per share or earnings per unit, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

tlabel: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Below Market Lease, Net
doc: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

tlabel: Beneficial Interest Liability
doc: Obligation reflecting another party's right to economic interests in another entity or trust under a contractual right. For example, an investor may purchase a beneficial interest in a securitization transaction.

tlabel: Benefits, Losses and Expenses
doc: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

tlabel: Billed Contracts Receivable
doc: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Billings in Excess of Cost, Noncurrent
doc: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized more than one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

tlabel: Borrowings under Guaranteed Investment Agreements
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the obligations to contract holders to provide to them an agreed upon rate of return pursuant to the terms of the underlying contract. These contracts represent lending by the contract holders to the entity in return for a guaranteed (primarily fixed) interest rate until maturity, unless called earlier if the contracts provide that option to the contract holders (usually institutions). There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

tlabel: Bridge Loan
doc: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

tlabel: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
doc: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Goodwill, Expected Tax Deductible Amount
doc: The amount of goodwill arising from a business combination that is expected to be deductible for tax purposes.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Share Price
doc: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks paid or offered to be paid in a business combination.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
doc: The pro forma net Income or Loss for the period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

tlabel: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Revenue
doc: The pro forma revenue for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of the period.

tlabel: Business Acquisitions, Purchase Price Allocation, Year of Acquisition, Net Effect on Income
doc: The net effect on income before taxes of the amortization and accretion of premiums, discounts and intangible assets in the year of acquisition, when the assets of the acquired institution exceed 10 percent of the consolidated assets at the end of the most recent period.

tlabel: Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Fair Value
doc: This element represents the fair value of the noncontrolling interest in the acquiree at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Acquisition Related Costs
doc: This element represents acquisition-related costs incurred to effect a business combination which costs have been expensed during the period. Such costs include finder's fees; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional or consulting fees; general administrative costs, including the costs of maintaining an internal acquisitions department; and may include costs of registering and issuing debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
doc: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

tlabel: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred
doc: Amount of consideration transferred, consisting of acquisition-date fair value of assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interest issued by the acquirer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable
doc: Amount of equity interests of the acquirer, including instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination
doc: Fair value at acquisition-date of the assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interests issued by the acquirer, including but not limited to, instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Liabilities Incurred
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred by the acquirer as part of consideration transferred in a business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the value of right to a contingent consideration asset.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Value, Low
doc: This element represents the amount of any change recognized during the period in the low-end of the estimated range of outcomes (undiscounted) of a liability assumed in a business combination arising from an item of contingent consideration.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
doc: Costs incurred to effect a business combination which have been expensed during the period. Such costs could include business integration costs, systems integration and conversion costs, and severance and other employee-related costs.

tlabel: Business Combination, Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized
doc: The amount, measured at acquisition-date fair value, of all liabilities assumed that arise from contingencies and were recognized by the entity.

tlabel: Business Combination, Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized, Other than at Fair Value
doc: The amount, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value, of all the liabilities assumed that arise from contingencies and were recognized by the entity, if the acquisition-date fair value cannot be determined and other criteria (as defined) related to the contingencies have been met.

tlabel: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Consideration Transferred
doc: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to items of consideration transferred in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

tlabel: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Assets
doc: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial assets acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

tlabel: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Inventory
doc: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to inventory acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Buildings
doc: Amount of facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Asset Acquired and Liability Assumed, Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of lease obligation assumed in business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Cash and Equivalents
doc: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, acquired at the acquisition date. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets
doc: Amount of assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of investments in debt and equity securities, including, but not limited to, held-to-maturity, trading and available-for-sale expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Other
doc: Amount of other assets expected to be realized or consumed before one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Receivables
doc: Amount due from customers or clients for goods or services, including trade receivables, that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business, and amounts due from others, including related parties expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable
doc: Amount of liabilities incurred for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business and related party payables, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of long-term debt due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Other
doc: Amount of other liabilities due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets
doc: Amount of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Liabilities
doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Equipment
doc: Amount of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Financial Liabilities
doc: The amount of financial liabilities assumed (as defined) which have been recognized as of the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets
doc: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Intangible Assets, Other than Goodwill
doc: Amount of intangible assets, excluding goodwill, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Finite-Lived Intangibles
doc: The amount of identifiable intangible assets recognized as of the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Land
doc: Amount of real estate acquired, at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Net
doc: Amount recognized as of the acquisition date for the identifiable assets acquired in excess of (less than) the aggregate liabilities assumed.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of long-term debt due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Other
doc: Amount of other liabilities due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, assumed at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Other Noncurrent Assets
doc: Amount of other assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, acquired at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The amount of property, plant, and equipment recognized as of the acquisition date.

tlabel: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Less Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount recognized as of the acquisition date for the assets, including goodwill, in excess of (less than) the aggregate liabilities assumed, less the noncontrolling interest in the acquiree.

tlabel: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Additional Disclosures, Acquisition Cost Expensed
doc: For transactions that are recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination, such as related to pre-existing relationships with the acquiree, this element represents the disclosure of the amount of acquisition related costs which have been expensed.

tlabel: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Expenses and Losses Recognized
doc: The expenses and losses recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Net Gains and Losses
doc: The net gains or losses recognized for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Fair Value
doc: Fair value at acquisition-date of the equity interest in the acquiree held by the acquirer, immediately before the acquisition date for businesses combined in stages.

tlabel: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain
doc: In a business combination achieved in stages, this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity as a result of remeasuring to fair value the equity interest in the acquiree it held before the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain (Loss), Net
doc: In a business combination achieved in stages, this element represents the amount of net gain (loss) recognized by the entity as a result of remeasuring to fair value the equity interest in the acquiree it held before the business combination.

tlabel: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Loss
doc: In a business combination achieved in stages, this element represents the amount of loss recognized by the entity as a result of remeasuring to fair value the equity interest in the acquiree it held before the business combination.

tlabel: Business Development
doc: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business development involves evaluating a business and then realizing its full potential, using such tools as marketing, sales, information management and customer service.

tlabel: Business Exit Costs
doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Banking Regulation, Total Capital, Actual
doc: Amount of total capital as defined by regulatory framework.

tlabel: Capital Accumulation Plans
doc: Value of stock in an investment or savings plan established by the entity for the benefit of its employees that permits the employees to make investment decisions.

tlabel: Capital Expenditure, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

tlabel: Capitalization, Long-term Debt and Equity
doc: This element represents the total consolidated (as applicable) capitalization of the entity which is comprised of its long-term debt and equity instruments. The table may be detailed by subsidiary (legal entity) and include information by type of debt or equity detailed by instrument.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Additions
doc: Additions made to capitalized computer software costs during the period.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
doc: Amount of impairment loss from capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized computer software costs.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated amortization of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Current
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as current.

tlabel: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Mineral Interests in Proved Properties
doc: Capitalized costs of proved properties that include fee ownership or a lease, concession, or other interest representing the right to extract oil or gas subject to such terms as may be imposed by the conveyance of that interest.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Mineral Interests in Unproved Properties
doc: Capitalized costs of unproven properties that include fee ownership or a lease, concession, or other interest representing the right to extract oil or gas subject to such terms as may be imposed by the conveyance of that interest.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Support Equipment and Facilities
doc: Capitalized costs incurred for support equipment and facilities used in oil and gas producing activities (such as seismic equipment, drilling equipment, construction and grading equipment, vehicles, repair shops, warehouses, supply points, camps, and division, district, or field offices).

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Uncompleted Wells, Equipment and Facilities
doc: Capitalized costs of which include those incurred to (1) drill and equip wells that are not yet completed (2) acquire or construct equipment and facilities that are not yet installed.

tlabel: Capitalized Costs, Wells and Related Equipment and Facilities
doc: Capitalized costs which include those incurred to (1) to drill and equip those exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells that have found proved reserves and (2) obtain access to proved reserves and provide facilities for extracting, treating, gathering, storing the oil and gas, including the drilling and equipping of development wells and development-type stratigraphic wells and service wells.

tlabel: Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Charged to Expense
doc: Amount of expense for capitalized exploratory well costs for which proved reserves were not found at the exploratory well.

tlabel: Capitalized Software Development Costs for Software Sold to Customers
doc: Unamortized costs incurred for development of computer software, which is to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed, after establishing technological feasibility through to the general release of the software products. Excludes capitalized costs of developing software for internal use.

tlabel: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations
doc: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
doc: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Net
doc: The total gross amount less the charge for the use of the long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Contingent Rental Payments Received
doc: For sales-type and direct financing leases, total contingent rentals received during the period.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Amortization Expense
doc: The charge for the use of long-lived depreciable capital leased assets for the period.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Direct Financing Lease Revenue
doc: Revenue realized in the period on direct financing leases.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
doc: Total amount of lease revenue realized in the period on leasing arrangements.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Current
doc: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Current
doc: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs, less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Noncurrent
doc: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Current
doc: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Noncurrent
doc: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases, and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases
doc: The lessor's asset under sales type and direct financing leases. The net investment in direct financing and sales-type leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) estimated executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases
doc: The net investment in direct financing leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases
doc: The net investment in sales type leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Capital Units, Value
doc: Value of capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

tlabel: Capital Units, Authorized
doc: Number of authorized capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

tlabel: Capital Units, Net Amount
doc: Net amount applicable to investors of capital units or shares.

tlabel: Capital Units, Outstanding
doc: Number of capital units or capital shares outstanding. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

tlabel: Carrying Costs, Property and Exploration Rights
doc: The costs incurred to retain exploration and property rights after acquisition but before production has occurred. Costs include legal costs for title defense, ad valorem taxes on nonproducing mineral properties, shut-in royalties, and delay rentals.

tlabel: Carrying Value of Federal Funds Purchased, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, and Deposits Received for Securities Loaned
doc: Carrying value of federal funds purchased and securities sold under repurchase agreements and deposits received for securities loaned.

tlabel: Carrying Value of Federal Funds Sold, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, and Deposits Paid for Securities Borrowed
doc: Carrying value of federal funds sold, securities purchased under agreements to resell, and deposits paid for securities borrowed.

tlabel: Cash Acquired in Excess of Payments to Acquire Business
doc: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of a business when the cash held by the acquired business exceeds the cash payments to acquire the business.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: For the entity and the disposal group, cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the Entity may deposit additional funds at any time and also effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Compensating balance arrangements that do not legally restrict the withdrawal or usage of cash amounts may be reported as Cash and Cash Equivalents, while legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or company statements of intention with regard to particular deposits are not generally reported as cash and cash equivalents.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash and Due from Banks
doc: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

tlabel: Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations
doc: Amount of cash subject to withdrawal restrictions, restricted deposits held as compensating balances, and cash and securities segregated in compliance with regulations (such as cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers).

tlabel: Cash and Securities Segregated under Securities Exchange Commission Regulation
doc: Cash and securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Federal Funds Sold
doc: The sum of cash and cash equivalents plus Federal Funds Sold. Cash and cash equivalents consist of short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and are so near their maturity that they present negligible risk of changes in value due to changes in interest rates -- usually with an original maturity less than 90 days.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Short-term Investments
doc: Cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the customer may deposit additional funds at any time and effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid Investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Short-term investments, exclusive of cash equivalents, generally consist of marketable securities intended to be sold within one year (or the normal operating cycle if longer) and may include trading securities, available-for-sale securities, or held-to-maturity securities (if maturing within one year), as applicable.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; excluding effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of cash collateral held for borrowed securities, for which the cash is restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

tlabel: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
doc: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Subsidiaries and Equity Method Investees
doc: This element represents disclosure of the total aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries, by unconsolidated subsidiaries, and by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, 50 Percent or Less Owned Persons
doc: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Consolidated Subsidiaries
doc: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
doc: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by unconsolidated subsidiaries.

tlabel: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified within Twelve Months
doc: The estimated net amount of existing gains or losses on cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

tlabel: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Servicing Fees
doc: Cash Flows between a transferee and a transferor attributable to servicing fees related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

tlabel: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Beneficial Interest
doc: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in payment of the transferor's beneficial interest related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction.

tlabel: Cash, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash. Cash is the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes effect from exchange rate changes.

tlabel: Cash Reserve Deposit Required and Made
doc: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

tlabel: Cash Segregated under Commodity Exchange Act Regulation
doc: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Cash Segregated under Other Regulations
doc: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Cash Surrender Value, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the entity, commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

tlabel: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

tlabel: Ceded Premiums Earned
doc: Amount of earned premiums ceded to other entities.

tlabel: Ceded Premiums Payable
doc: The consideration due to the assuming enterprise as of the balance sheet date under the terms of the reinsurance contract in exchange for the right to receive reimbursement from such entity for covered claims and expenses.

tlabel: Ceded Premiums Written
doc: Amount of written premiums ceded to other entities.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Accretion
doc: Current period recognition due to accretion of the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in the loan for loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Accretion
doc: Amount of accretion recognized for the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value at acquisition of acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Allowance for Loan Losses
doc: Reserve for loans impairments recorded after acquisition as a result of current information and events which result in it being probable that estimated cash flows will be less than previously expected or because actual cash flows are less than cash flows previously expected. This relates to loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Allowance for Loan Losses, Decreases
doc: Amount of reduction in the reserve for loans impairments as a result of current information and events which result in it being probable that estimated cash flows will be significantly higher than previously expected or because actual cash flows are significantly greater than cash flows previously expected for loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

tlabel: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Carrying Amount, Net
doc: The recorded balance, net of any applicable reductions (for example, unamortized accretable yield and allowance for loan losses). This relates to loans not accounted for debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

tlabel: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
doc: A savings certificate entitling the Entity (that is, bearer) to receive interest at an established maturity date, based upon a fixed interest rate. A certificate of deposit may be issued in any denomination. Certificates of deposit are generally issued by commercial banks and, therefore, insured by the FDIC (up to the prescribed limit). Certificates of deposit generally restrict holders from withdrawing funds on demand without the incurrence of penalties. Generally, only certificates of deposit with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. As a related example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

tlabel: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments which were recognized in earnings, net of offsets by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

tlabel: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge
doc: Amount of the increase (decrease) in fair value of the hedged item in a fair value hedge recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Each Warrant or Right
doc: Number of securities into which each warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, each warrant may be converted into two shares.

tlabel: Clearance Fees
doc: The amount of expense in the period for clearance fees.

tlabel: Closed Block Dividend Obligation
doc: The liability as of the balance sheet date for the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the cumulative expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings (each) for the period from the actuarial calculation date to the date of measurement. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block. The policyholder dividend obligation, which may not have a negative balance, recognizes that a portion of earnings in certain cases will not inure to the stockholders of the insurance entity.

tlabel: Closed Block Operations, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a disposal group, which is allocated to the operations of the closed block.

tlabel: Collateralized Financings
doc: The value of the collateral (typically cash) that the entity receives in a financing transaction in exchange for securities lent. This item represents a liability in the financial statements of the lender of the securities.

tlabel: Commercial Paper
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

tlabel: Long-term Commercial Paper, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Commissions and Floor Brokerage Receivables
doc: Amount receivable from broker-dealers from commissions for executing orders on the floor of an exchange.

tlabel: Commissions Payable to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount payable to broker-dealers or clearing organizations for executing or clearing trades or orders.

tlabel: Commodity Contract Asset, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Commodity Contract Asset, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
doc: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock Dividends, Shares
doc: Number of shares of common stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

tlabel: Common Stock Held by Subsidiary
doc: Value of entity shares held by subsidiary, which are purchased for the purpose of granting the shares to senior employees as part of an employee stock option plan approved by the Entity's Board of Directors. Presented as a reduction of shareholders' equity at their cost to the subsidiary.

tlabel: Common Stock Held in Trust
doc: Value of common stock held in trust.

tlabel: Common Stock Issued, Employee Stock Trust
doc: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, a 'rabbi trust') set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees. This trust does not allow employees to immediately or after a holding period diversify into nonemployer securities. The deferred compensation plan for which this trust is set up must be settled by the delivery of a fixed number of shares of employer stock.

tlabel: Common Stock Issued, Employee Trust, Deferred
doc: Aggregate value of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

tlabel: Common Stock, Other Shares, Outstanding
doc: Total number of shares of other common stock instruments held by shareholders, such as exchangeable shares. May be all or portion of the number of common shares authorized.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust
doc: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, but not limited to, rabbi trust) set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust, Shares
doc: Number of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
doc: Amount of common stock allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of common stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

tlabel: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

tlabel: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
doc: Amount after discount on shares of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock held by shareholders. Includes common stock repurchased and held as treasury stock.

tlabel: Common Unit, Authorized
doc: Maximum number of common units of ownership permitted to be issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Common Unit, Issuance Value
