doc: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

tlabel: Derivative Asset
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
doc: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

tlabel: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
doc: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

tlabel: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
doc: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

tlabel: Derivative, Cost of Hedge
doc: The premium (cost) of a hedge, expensed during the period.

tlabel: Derivative, Cost of Hedge Net of Cash Received
doc: The premium (cost) of a hedge, net of any cash received on settlement during the period.

tlabel: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

tlabel: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain, Recognized in Earnings
doc: Amount of gain from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

tlabel: Derivative, Fair Value Hedge, Included in Effectiveness, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as fair value hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
doc: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
doc: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Derivative, Floor Interest Rate
doc: Floor rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate floor or collar. If market rates falls below the floor rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

tlabel: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
doc: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net
doc: The effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing, Net
doc: The portion of gains and losses (net) on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Gain Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
doc: The effective portion of gain reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
doc: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
doc: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Liability, Notional Amount
doc: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

tlabel: Derivative, Net Hedge Ineffectiveness Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the ineffectiveness of the hedge.

tlabel: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
doc: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

tlabel: Derivative, Notional Amount
doc: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

tlabel: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from transactions on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

tlabel: Development Costs, Period Cost
doc: The capitalized costs incurred during the period (excluded from amortization) to obtain access to proved reserves and to provide facilities for extracting, treating, gathering and storing the oil and gas.

tlabel: Development in Process
doc: The current amount of expenditures for a real estate project that has not yet been completed.

tlabel: Diluted Earnings Per Share Pro Forma
doc: Pro forma diluted earnings per share, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings.

tlabel: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise stock options, restrictive stock units (RSUs), convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), and other dilutive convertible securities.

tlabel: Direct Communications and Utilities Costs
doc: The aggregate costs of direct communications and utilities incurred during the reporting period.

tlabel: Direct Costs of Leased and Rented Property or Equipment
doc: Amount of expense incurred and directly related to generating revenue by lessor from operating lease of rented property and equipment.

tlabel: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

tlabel: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Income
doc: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income on direct financing lease and after offset of loss recognized at commencement.

tlabel: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

tlabel: Direct Operating Communications Costs
doc: Communications costs incurred and are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

tlabel: Direct Operating Costs
doc: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

tlabel: Direct Operating Maintenance Supplies Costs
doc: Costs of maintenance supplies used that are directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

tlabel: Direct Premiums Earned
doc: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

tlabel: Direct Premiums Written
doc: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

tlabel: Cost, Direct Tax and License
doc: Amount of tax incurred and cost of license directly related to good produced or service rendered.

tlabel: Direct-to-television Film Costs
doc: The amount of direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a direct-to-television film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: Per basic and diluted share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations, when the per share amount is the same.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Discontinued Operation, Tax (Expense) Benefit from Provision for (Gain) Loss on Disposal
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit on (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable, Current
doc: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Liabilities
doc: Amount classified as accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
doc: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets
doc: Amount classified as deferred tax assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Foreign Currency Translation Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) in the disposal group, including discontinued operation, recognized in the statement of income as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
doc: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities
doc: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current
doc: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
doc: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Distributed Earnings
doc: The total amount of dividends declared in the period for each class of stock and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends). Dividends declared in the current period do not include dividends declared in respect of prior-period unpaid cumulative dividends. Preferred dividends that are cumulative only if earned are deducted only to the extent that they are earned.

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Declared
doc: Amount of equity impact of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid
doc: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Declared
doc: Amount of equity impact of cash distribution declared to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Unit Distribution
doc: Number of units distributed for payment of a unit distribution to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Unit Distribution, Dilution Per Unit
doc: Per unit of ownership amount of dilution resulting from the issuance of additional unit for payment of unit distribution to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Distributions on Mandatorily Redeemable Securities
doc: Amount of distributions during the period on mandatorily redeemable securities.

tlabel: Distributions Payable to Real Estate Partnerships
doc: The cash outflow or inflow increase (decrease) in distribution due to real estate partnership based upon payments and accruals.

tlabel: Distributions Per General Partnership Unit Outstanding
doc: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding general partnership unit during the reporting period.

tlabel: Distributions Per Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Outstanding, Basic
doc: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit during the reporting period.

tlabel: Distributions Per Limited Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic
doc: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding limited partnership unit during the reporting period.

tlabel: Dividend Income, Equity Securities, Operating
doc: Amount of dividend income on investment in equity security, classified as operating.

tlabel: Dividend Income, Operating
doc: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

tlabel: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
doc: Amount of operating dividend income on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
doc: Amount of operating dividend income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Dividends and Interest Paid
doc: The contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the current period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends).

tlabel: Dividends, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Paid-in-kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

tlabel: Dividends, Paid-in-kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends (PIK) declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Dividends Payable, Amount Per Share
doc: The per share amount of a dividend declared, but not paid, as of the financial reporting date.

tlabel: Dividends Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

tlabel: Dividends Receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but not received.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Paid-in-Kind
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Dividends, Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Draft Payable
doc: Amount of draft payable by broker-dealer.

tlabel: Due from Affiliate, Current
doc: Amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Affiliates
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Due from Banks
doc: A bank's noninterest bearing demand deposits in other banks (such as correspondents).

tlabel: Due from Correspondent Brokers
doc: Amount receivable from correspondent broker-dealer.

tlabel: Due from Customer Acceptances
doc: Amounts receivable from customers on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by the institution (also known as banker's acceptance transactions) that are outstanding on the reporting date.

tlabel: Due from Employees
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from an Entity employee, not to include stockholders or officers.

tlabel: Due from Employees, Current
doc: Amounts due from an Entity employee, not to include stockholders or officers, which are usually due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Employees, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due from an Entity employee, not to include stockholders or officers, which are usually due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Joint Ventures
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from an entity in which the reporting entity shares joint control with another party or group.

tlabel: Due from Joint Ventures, Current
doc: Amounts due from an entity in which the reporting entity shares joint control with another party or group, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Joint Ventures, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due from an entity in which the reporting entity shares joint control with another party or group, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Officers or Stockholders
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company.

tlabel: Due from Officers or Stockholders, Current
doc: Amounts due from owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company, which are usually due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Officers or Stockholders, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due from owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company, which are usually due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Due from Other Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount receivable from related parties classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Due from Other Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amount receivable from related parties classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Due from Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregate amount of receivables to be collected from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth, at the financial statement date, which are usually due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Due to Affiliate, Current
doc: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Due to Affiliate
doc: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Due to Affiliate, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of receivables owed to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, which are usually due after one year (or one business cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Due to Correspondent Brokers
doc: Amount payable to correspondent broker-dealer.

tlabel: Due to Employees, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due to Employee, not to include stockholders or officers, which are due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Due to Officers or Stockholders, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due to recorded owners or owners with a beneficial interest of more than 10 percent of the voting interests or officers of the company, which are due after one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Due to Other Related Parties
doc: Amount payable to related parties classified as other.

tlabel: Due to Other Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amount payable from related parties classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
doc: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

tlabel: Early Repayment of Subordinated Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets before its maturity.

tlabel: Earnest Money Deposits
doc: A deposit made by a purchaser of real estate to evidence good faith. It is customary for a buyer to give the seller earnest money at the time a sales contract is signed. The earnest money generally is credited to the down payment at closing, which is applied at closing as a component of payment against the purchase price.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Distributed
doc: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Undistributed
doc: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Undistributed
doc: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security, after giving effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax on Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Amount
doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash
doc: Amount of effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances held in foreign currencies. Excludes cash equivalents.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Continuing Operations
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in continuing operations held in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Discontinued Operations
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in discontinuing operations held in foreign currencies.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies. Excludes amounts for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in continuing operations held in foreign currencies. Excludes cash equivalents.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances in discontinued operations held in foreign currencies. Excludes cash equivalents.

tlabel: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

tlabel: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
doc: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

tlabel: Embedded Derivative, Gain on Embedded Derivative
doc: Increase in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

tlabel: Embedded Derivative, No Longer Bifurcated, Amount Reclassified to Stockholders' Equity
doc: The amount of the liability for the conversion option reclassified to stockholders' equity when the embedded option no longer required separation from the host instrument.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount Capitalized
doc: Amount of cost capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash Used to Settle Award
doc: Aggregate cash paid by the entity during the period to settle equity instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
doc: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
doc: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Cash Contributions to ESOP
doc: This item represents the amount of cash contributions during the period made by the entity to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
doc: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares
doc: Represents the carrying amount of shares held by the ESOP as of the balance sheet date in which no ESOP participant has a vested interest and no lender has a claim.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of unearned shares held by the employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Dividends Paid to ESOP
doc: Dividends paid on stock held by an employee stock ownership plan.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Gain (Loss) on Transactions in Deferred Shares
doc: The difference between cost and fair value added or subtracted from paid-in capital, arising from contribution of shares to an ESOP or commitments-to-release ESOP shares.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Allocated Shares
doc: The shares or units in an ESOP trust that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula. IRS rules require allocations to be nondiscriminatory generally based on compensation, length of service, or a combination of both. For any particular participant such shares or units may be vested, unvested, or partially vested.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Committed-to-be-Released Shares
doc: The shares that, although not legally released, will be released by a future scheduled and committed debt service payment and will be allocated to employees for service rendered in the current accounting period. The ESOP documents typically define the period of service to which the shares relate. ESOP shares are released to compensate employees directly, to settle employer liabilities for other employee benefits, and to replace dividends on allocated shares that are used for debt service.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
doc: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares Contributed to ESOP
doc: This item represents the number of shares provided to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) during the period.

tlabel: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Weighted Average Purchase Price of Shares Purchased
doc: Weighted average purchase price of capital shares purchased through an employee stock ownership plan.

tlabel: Energy Marketing Accounts Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for energy purchases, typically by a utility or an entity engaged in selling energy contracts.

tlabel: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Current
doc: Current liabilities attributable to energy marketing activities (trading activities). Current energy marketing (trading activities) are when entities engage in both financial and physical trading to increase profits, manage their commodity price risk and enhance system reliability. They may trade electricity, coal, natural gas and oil. These entities typically use a variety of financial instruments, including forward contracts, options and swaps.

tlabel: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value of liability arising from energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

tlabel: Energy Marketing Contracts Assets, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from energy trading activities that involves the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts that include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Energy Marketing Contracts Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from energy trading activities that involves the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts that include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies relating to a source of usable power held for future sale or future use in manufacturing or production process.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Chemicals
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of solvents or substances produced by or used in a process to change the shape, form or composition of some related matter.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Coal
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of coal, which is a combustible rock or minerals which are extracted from the ground and used as fuel.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Gas Stored Underground
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas stored underground in depleted gas reservoirs, aquifers, or salt caverns to meet seasonal and peak load demands, and also as insurance against unforeseen supply disruptions, and deemed to be a current asset because it is expected to be used within twelve months or in the normal operating cycle.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Natural Gas in Storage
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas in storage, which is a mixture of gases (liquefied or otherwise), used for fuel and manufacturing purposes, which is ready for sale.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Other Fossil Fuel
doc: Amount of fossil fuel included in inventory classified as other.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Petroleum
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of petroleum or crude oil.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Propane Gas
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of product derived from petroleum during the processing of oil or natural gas which is then used as a heat source or fuel.

tlabel: Environmental Expense and Liabilities
doc: The adjustment to exclude the noncash portion of, and include cash payments for environmental costs when calculating operating cash flows under the indirect method. The adjustment can include the increase (decrease) during an accounting period in total estimated obligations recorded for probable future loss attributable to environmental contamination issues.

tlabel: Environmental Remediation Expense
doc: Amount, before recovery, of expense for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

tlabel: Equipment Expense
doc: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

tlabel: Equity, Fair Value Adjustment
doc: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

tlabel: Equity, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of the entity's equity.

tlabel: Equity Issued in Business Combination, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of equity issued in a business combination.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Aggregate Cost
doc: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Deferred Gain on Sale
doc: This element represents disclosure of the amount of gain which has been deferred as the result of the sale of a business or operating assets to a highly leveraged entity which deferred gain has been reflected in the accompanying statement of financial position as reduction from the related asset.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
doc: Difference between amount at which an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting is carried (reported) on the balance sheet and amount of underlying equity in net assets the reporting Entity has in the investee.

tlabel: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
doc: This item represents an other than temporary decline in value that has been recognized against an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting. The excess of the carrying amount over the fair value of the investment represents the amount of the write down which is or was reflected in earnings. The written down value is a new cost basis with the adjusted value of the investment becoming its new carrying value subject to the equity accounting method. Evidence of a loss in value might include, but would not necessarily be limited to, absence of an ability to recover the carrying amount of the investment or inability of the investee to sustain an earnings capacity which would justify the carrying amount of the investment.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

tlabel: Equity Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the equity method.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations reported by an equity method investee.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: The amount of net income (loss) reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

tlabel: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Revenue (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of revenue from sale of product and rendering of service reported by equity method investee.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as current.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI and without Readily Determinable Fair Value
doc: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
doc: Cost of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain
doc: Amount of realized gain from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Loss
doc: Amount of realized loss from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Restricted
doc: Amount of restricted investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
doc: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
doc: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Annual Amount
doc: Amount of impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
doc: Amount of gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

tlabel: Escrow Deposit
doc: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

tlabel: Escrow Deposits Related to Property Sales
doc: Escrow deposits related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Estimated Insurance Recoveries
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts expected to be recovered under the terms of insurance contracts.

tlabel: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
doc: Amount of total risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Authorized
doc: Maximum number of excess stock shares permitted to be issued.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Issued
doc: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

tlabel: Excess Stock, Shares Outstanding
doc: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

tlabel: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

tlabel: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

tlabel: Exchange Fees
doc: The amount of expense in the period for fees charged by securities exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on that exchange. Some fees vary with the related volume, while others are fixed.

tlabel: Excise and Sales Taxes
doc: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

tlabel: Excise Taxes Collected
doc: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

tlabel: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
doc: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

tlabel: Exploration Costs, Period Cost
doc: The capitalized costs incurred during the period (excluded from amortization) in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. Exploration costs also include costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, the maintenance of land and lease records, dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions, costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells and costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

tlabel: Exploration Expense
doc: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

tlabel: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Current
doc: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year of the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

tlabel: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes standard product warranties.

tlabel: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Per Share, Net of Tax
doc: Per share impact of the gain (loss) on the extinguishment of debt, net of applicable taxes.

tlabel: Facility Costs
doc: Facility expenses incurred related to gas and oil produced and sold during the reporting period.

tlabel: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

tlabel: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

tlabel: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Accounts Receivable
doc: This item represents disclosure of all significant concentrations of credit risk or market risk arising from the subject financial instrument (as defined), whether from an individual counterparty or groups of counterparties.

tlabel: Fair Value Hedge Liabilities
doc: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

tlabel: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

tlabel: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

tlabel: Fair Value, Net Asset (Liability)
doc: Fair value of asset after deduction of liability.

tlabel: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

tlabel: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
doc: For each line item in the statement of financial position, the amounts of gains and losses from fair value changes included in earnings.

tlabel: FDIC Indemnification Asset
doc: Carrying amount of receivable assets originating from the indemnification agreement with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), in which the FDIC is to partially cover losses.

tlabel: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Accretion of Discount
doc: Increases to the indemnification asset due to accretion of the loan discount relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

tlabel: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Acquisitions
doc: Amount of increases to the indemnification asset due to acquisitions of assets relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

tlabel: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Cash Payments Received
doc: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to cash payments received relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

tlabel: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Change in carrying amount of the indemnification asset relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). The change includes for example, but is not limited to, acquisitions, additional estimated losses, disposals, cash payments, accretion of discount and write-offs, net of recoveries.

tlabel: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense
doc: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.

tlabel: Federal Funds Purchased
doc: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

tlabel: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Federal Funds Sold
doc: The amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements.

tlabel: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of federal funds sold and securities borrowed or purchased under agreements to resell.

tlabel: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Amount of Advances
doc: Amount of advances from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

tlabel: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Current
doc: The current portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Repayment and Penalties
doc: Amount of repayments and penalties incurred in the satisfaction or roll-over of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advance.

tlabel: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
doc: Including both current and noncurrent portions, Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year One
doc: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations
doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of consolidated obligation bonds and discount notes issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations, Bonds
doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of bonds issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations, Discount Notes
doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of discount notes issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

tlabel: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock and Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) and Federal Reserve Bank stock.

tlabel: Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Federal Reserve Bank stock represents an equity interest in the Federal Reserve Bank. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

tlabel: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking and Servicing
doc: Income from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions) and servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others net of any related impairment of capitalized service costs. Also includes any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans.

tlabel: FIFO Inventory Amount
doc: The amount of FIFO (first in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

tlabel: Film, Capitalized Cost
doc: Amount of capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized on its own and films predominantly monetized with other films and license agreements as group.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
doc: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
doc: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Accelerated Premium Revenue, Amount
doc: This element represents the amount of premium revenue on financial guarantee insurance contracts recognized during the period that was accelerated for revenue recognition purposes.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned and Not Pledged, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Excludes financial instruments and other positions owned and pledged as collateral to counterparties.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Amount Eligible to be Repledged by Counterparty
doc: Fair value of financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value and pledged to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions where counterparty has the right to re-pledge such.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned and Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity and pledged to counterparties as collateral, including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
doc: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-backed and Asset-backed Securities, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card receivables), either fixed or revolving, that by their terms convert into cash within a finite time period. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, Principal Investments, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in private equity, mezzanine, venture capital, merchant banking, real estate and special situations investments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, US Government and Agency Obligations
doc: Fair value of obligations arising from US treasury and other US government and agency debt obligations sold short.

tlabel: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Par Value Per Share
doc: Par value per share of mandatory redeemable financial instrument classified as liability.

tlabel: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of financial obligations, including, but not limited to, debt instruments, derivative liabilities, federal funds purchased and sold under agreements to repurchase, securities loaned or sold under agreements to repurchase, financial instruments sold not yet purchased, guarantees, line of credit, loans and notes payable, servicing liability, and trading liabilities.

tlabel: Financial Services Liabilities
doc: For entities that provide full or partial financing and servicing for customers supplementary to its major operations (such as a manufacturer or a homebuilder providing and servicing loans to buyers), represents the liabilities associated with such activities, including accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

tlabel: Financing Interest Expense
doc: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
doc: Amount of valuation allowance for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible that were individually evaluated for impairment.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
doc: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Sale
doc: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Core Deposits, Gross
doc: Bank deposits belonging to an acquired bank that can be counted on as a stable source of lending funds. These deposits have the following attributes: predictable costs and low sensitivity to interest rates. This intangible asset is usually amortized over its estimated useful life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Customer Relationships, Gross
doc: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date to an asset acquired in a business combination representing a favorable existing relationship with customers having a finite beneficial life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Acquired-in-Place Leases
doc: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to existing tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Off-market Lease, Favorable, Gross
doc: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease at the acquisition date.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Cost Incurred to Renew or Extend
doc: The amount of capitalized costs incurred in the period to renew or extend the term of a recognized finite-lived (amortizing and amortizable) intangible asset.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in carrying value of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life for purchase accounting adjustments.

tlabel: Finite-Lived License Agreements, Gross
doc: Gross carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of certain rights acquired to exercise a certain privilege or pursue a particular business or occupation and which is deemed to have a finite economic life.

tlabel: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
doc: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

tlabel: Fixtures and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of fixtures and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, machinery, equipment, and engines.

tlabel: Flight Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Flight Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Flight Equipment, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Floor Brokerage
doc: Broker-dealers often use other brokers to execute trades on their behalf. The trading broker-dealer becomes a customer of the executing broker-dealer and pays a floor brokerage fee. Such fees are paid periodically either directly to the executing broker-dealer or through a clearing house.

tlabel: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
doc: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

tlabel: Repossessed Assets
