doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance; includes real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts.

tlabel: Foreclosed Real Estate Expense
doc: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
doc: The amount of net gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized gain recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Realized
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Unrealized
doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Foreign Currency Transaction Loss, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized loss recognized in the income statement.

tlabel: Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Franchisor Costs
doc: Aggregate costs incurred that are directly related to activities, including but not limited to, generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets and franchised outlets.

tlabel: Frequent Flier Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Value of revenue deferred or cost to provide future products or services, primarily air transportation, associated with programs used by airlines to encourage passenger loyalty by providing rewards geared to the frequency of travel on the sponsoring airline, typically in the form of frequent flyer miles, points, or segments that can be accumulated and converted into free or discounted travel or other redemption options. Used to reflect the noncurrent portion of the liability.

tlabel: Fuel Costs
doc: Fuel costs incurred that are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

tlabel: Fuel Costs, Gross of Hedging
doc: The cost for fuel, incurred during the period, before considering the impacts of any related hedging activities.

tlabel: Funds Held for Clients
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

tlabel: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset
doc: Amount of the reinsurer's funds held on its behalf by the ceding insurer, including funds held in trust, under reinsurance treaties or contracts with the assuming insurer as security for the payment of the obligations thereunder.

tlabel: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability
doc: Amount of funds held as security for payments to be received under reinsurance contracts.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net
doc: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
doc: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
doc: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
doc: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
doc: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
doc: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
doc: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Real Estate, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of difference between the carrying amount and the sales price of real estate properties sold as part of discontinued operations.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings
doc: Total amount of gain (loss) derived from fair value hedges recognized in earnings in the period.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives Recorded in Earnings, Net
doc: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. Includes impact of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness and the ineffectiveness of fair value hedging derivatives and full change in fair value of the foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
doc: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on interest rate fair value hedges.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
doc: This item represents the net total realized and unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period as a result of selling or holding marketable securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, including the unrealized holding gain (loss) of held-to-maturity securities transferred to the trading security category and the cumulative unrealized gain (loss) which was included in other comprehensive income (a separate component of shareholders' equity) for available-for-sale securities transferred to trading securities during the period. Additionally, this item would include any gains (losses) realized during the period from the sale of investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Non-Recourse Debt
doc: Amount represents the difference between the cash acquisition price of the debt and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its extinguishment (or deconsolidation of in-substance real estate when an entity defaults on its debt obligations).

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
doc: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
doc: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Capital Leases, Net
doc: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's transactions involving the sale, transfer, or termination of financing agreements classified as capital leases.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Commodity Contracts
doc: The difference between the book value and the sale price of agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Debt Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of debt securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
doc: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of equity securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading or available-for-sale. This element includes investments in which the entity holds a small ownership stake (generally, less than 20 percent of the shares outstanding) and cannot exert significant influence.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Insurance Block
doc: Excess (deficiency) of net proceeds received over the net carrying value of a certain, bundled grouping of insurance policies.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
doc: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
doc: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of financing receivable.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
doc: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Project
doc: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of a project.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: This element represents the applicable amount of income taxes or benefit realized on the gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, before Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period gross of the applicable income taxes realized.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Net of Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period net of the applicable income taxes realized.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
doc: Gain (loss) related to the sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
doc: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
doc: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
doc: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

tlabel: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
doc: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

tlabel: Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
doc: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

tlabel: Gain on Sale of Investments
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Equity Investee
doc: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
doc: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
doc: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
doc: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

tlabel: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

tlabel: Gas Balancing Asset (Liability)
doc: The value of gas balancing asset or liability as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Gas Balancing Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to an underproduced working interest owner when an overproduced working interest owner has sold gas in excess of the party's ownership percentage. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Gas Purchase Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for purchases of natural gas. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: General Insurance Expense
doc: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Period Distribution Amount
doc: The total amount of distributions to the general partner during the period.

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Authorized
doc: The number of general partner units authorized to be issued.

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
doc: The number of general partner units issued.

tlabel: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
doc: The number of general partner units outstanding.

tlabel: General Partners' Contributed Capital
doc: The amount of capital contributed by the general partner.

tlabel: General Partners' Cumulative Cash Distributions
doc: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the general partner.

tlabel: General Partners' Cumulative Earnings
doc: Aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the general partner based on the sharing of income or losses between general and limited partners as specified in the partnership agreement, excluding any priority income allocations resulting from incentive distributions or any special earnings allocations.

tlabel: Good Faith and Margin Deposits with Broker-Dealers
doc: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

tlabel: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
doc: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

tlabel: Goodwill, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) an asset representing future economic benefits from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from adjustments after acquisition date under purchase accounting of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Subsequent Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset
doc: Amount of (increase) decrease to an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from the subsequent recognition of deferred tax assets.

tlabel: Goodwill, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation adjustments and purchase accounting adjustments of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Goodwill, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
doc: Amount of divestiture of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Grants Receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

tlabel: Grants Receivable, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Grants Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

tlabel: Gross Investment Income, Operating
doc: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

tlabel: Ground Leases, Accumulated Amortization
doc: Accumulated amortization on long-term land leases capitalized as part of real property.

tlabel: Ground Leases, Gross
doc: Gross long-term land leases capitalized as part of real property.

tlabel: Ground Leases, Net
doc: Net long-term land leases which are capitalized as part of real property.

tlabel: Guaranteed Interest Contracts
doc: The amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date pertaining to the guarantee given by the insurance entity to contract holders of a specified rate of return (a guaranteed yield) on their investments for a specified period.

tlabel: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
doc: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

tlabel: Health Care Organization, Expenses, Net
doc: Total costs of health care costs, net of recoveries of stop-loss insurance. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

tlabel: Health Care Organization, Patient Service Revenue Less Provision for Bad Debts
doc: Amount of patient service revenue, net of contractual allowances and discounts, less the related provision for bad debts.

tlabel: Health Care Organization, Patient Service Revenue Provision for Bad Debts
doc: Amount of the provision for bad debts related to patient service revenue.

tlabel: Health Care Organization, Revenue Net of Patient Service Revenue Provisions
doc: Amount of patient service revenue recognized, net of contractual allowances and discounts, less the provision for bad debts related to patient service revenue plus all other revenue.

tlabel: Hedging Assets, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Hedging Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to hedge price changes in underlying assets, and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Hedging Liabilities, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Hedging Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value of liability arising from a financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Restricted
doc: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Includes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) previously recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

tlabel: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Amount of Impairment Loss
doc: Loss recognized as a result of the initial and subsequent write-down of a long-lived asset's carrying amount to fair value.

tlabel: Impairment Charge on Reclassified Assets
doc: For the asset that is reclassified back to held and used from held-for-sale, the amount of impairment charge that is recognized on the reclassification date.

tlabel: Impairment Losses Related to Real Estate Partnerships
doc: Impairment losses measured as the amount by which the carrying amount of the business or real estate partnerships exceeds the fair value of the business or partnership.

tlabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
doc: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Impairment of Leasehold
doc: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

tlabel: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

tlabel: Impairment of Ongoing Project
doc: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

tlabel: Impairment of Real Estate
doc: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

tlabel: Impairment of Retained Interest
doc: The charge against earnings to reduce the carrying value of an interest continued to be held by the transferor in a securitized financial instrument.

tlabel: Incentive Distribution, Distribution Per Unit
doc: Per-share or per-unit amount of incentive dividend declared and paid to managing member or general partner.

tlabel: Incentive Distribution, Distribution
doc: Amount of incentive obligation paid in cash or stock during the period to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner.

tlabel: Incentive Fee Expense
doc: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

tlabel: Incentive from Lessor
doc: Amount of incentive received by lessee from lessor.

tlabel: Incentive to Lessee
doc: Amount of incentive granted by lessor to lessee.

tlabel: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Income (Loss) before Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of income (loss) before gain (loss) on sale of properties of Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Affordable Housing Projects, Equity Method Investments
doc: Amount of investment income (loss) of qualified affordable housing project investments accounted for using the equity method.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit ownership amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, after tax, available to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
doc: Per basic and diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation, when the per share amount is the same.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic
doc: The amount of income (loss) from disposition of discontinued operations available to each limited partnership and general partnership unit during the reporting period, net of tax.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted
doc: The amount of income (loss) derived from discontinued operations during the period, net of related tax effect, per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of gain (loss) on disposal of discontinued operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of gain (loss) on disposal of discontinued operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for all dilutive potential units outstanding.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
doc: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Parent, before Income Tax
doc: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale attributable to parent. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
doc: The amount of net income (loss) before extraordinary items per each basic and diluted share of common stock or unit when the per share amount is the same for both basic and diluted shares.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) on income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

tlabel: Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Income Tax Credits and Adjustments
doc: A credit or adjustment for government or taxing authority authorized decrease in taxes owed as a result of meeting certain tax policy conditions.

tlabel: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle
doc: Amount of cumulative tax effect on beginning retained earnings from change in accounting principle.

tlabel: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Employee Stock Options
doc: The tax effects of employee stock option transactions that are recognized differently for financial reporting and tax purposes, occurring during the period and charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

tlabel: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Equity Transactions
doc: The tax effect of an increase or decrease in contributed capital (for example, deductible expenditures reported as a reduction of the proceeds from issuing capital stock) during the period charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

tlabel: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Other
doc: The tax effect of items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to components of shareholders' equity and are not otherwise defined.

tlabel: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

tlabel: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
doc: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

tlabel: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Expense
doc: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

tlabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

tlabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

tlabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

tlabel: Income Taxes Receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax exempt income, equity in earnings (loss) of an unconsolidated subsidiary, minority noncontrolling interest income (loss), tax holiday, disposition of a business, disposition of an asset, repatriation of foreign earnings, repatriation of foreign earnings jobs creation act of 2004, increase (decrease) in enacted tax rate, prior year income taxes, increase (decrease) in deferred tax asset valuation allowance, and other adjustments.

tlabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) Due from Officers and Stockholders
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) Due from Other Related Parties
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables due from related parties classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Cost of Oil and Gas Reclamation
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in accrued costs that represent future cash outlays for restoration and reclamation of oil and gas producing properties.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepayments received from borrowers for taxes and insurance remitted to the appropriate tax authority or insurer on behalf of the borrower.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Air Traffic Liability
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of unearned revenue related to tickets sold but not yet recognized as revenue.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Allowance for Equity Funds Used During Construction
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the capitalized cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and / or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments. As a result of this capitalization, net income is increased. This element pertains to certain regulated industries, such as public utilities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Assets Held-for-sale
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Balancing Account, Utility
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the asset created by the regulatory convention in which costs and revenues associated with certain utility expenses (such as fuel) are accumulated but on which no return is earned.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is pledged as security when borrowing securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Coal Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of coal held in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Collateral Held under Securities Lending
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of assets, which may include but are not limited to cash and investments, received as collateral pertaining to securities loaned to a counterparty to the transaction. Includes the change during the period in any unrealized gain or loss on such investments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Construction Payables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of obligations, not classified as trade payables, incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies, and services pertaining to construction projects.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Air Traffic Revenue
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of unearned revenue related to tickets sold but not yet recognized as revenue and the estimated incremental cost for points or miles outstanding and awards that expect to be redeemed through customer loyalty programs.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges, Investing
doc: The increase (decrease) in noncurrent deferred charges, classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Gas Cost
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized gas costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of an acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, (c) the increase (decrease) during the reporting period, excluding the portion taken into income, in the liability reflecting services yet to be performed by the reporting entity for which cash or other forms of consideration was received or recorded as a receivable, or (d) some combination of (a), (b), and (c).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Dividends Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Employee, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from employees for floats, allowances and loans (generally evidenced by promissory notes).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Officers and Stockholders, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Other Related Parties, Current
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party receivables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current
doc: The aggregate increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates
doc: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Employees, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in obligations due within one year (or one business cycle) to employees other than officers.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Earnest Money Deposits Outstanding
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of deposits given by the reporting entity to a seller which shows that the prospective buyer is serious about purchasing a property.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Energy Trading Activity
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of long term assets generated by energy trading activities, which involve the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts which include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Sold
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Film Costs
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film. Examples include, but are not limited to, costs of story and scenario, compensation, set construction and postproduction costs.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased. Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the broker-dealer for trading or investment purposes are included in "Securities Owned and Securities Sold, Not Yet Purchased." Although proprietary trading is frequently thought of as purchasing securities for sale to others, trading securities for the broker-dealer's own account sometimes leads to a liability for the fair value of securities sold but not yet purchased, that is, sold short. The broker-dealer is then obliged to purchase the securities at a future date at the then-current market price.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Fossil Fuel Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel held in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements
doc: The change in funds held under reinsurance agreements or treaty (contract between the reinsurer and the ceding entity stipulating the manner in which insurance written on various risks is to be shared).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves
doc: The change in the future policy benefit reserve balance on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves and Other Insurance Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in estimated future policy benefit obligations under insurance contracts, and obligations under insurance contracts classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Gas Balancing Receivable
doc: Change in the balance of the gas balancing receivable account. Gas imbalances occur when the entity sells more or less than its entitled ownership percentage of total gas production. If the entity receives less than it is entitled, the underproduction is recorded as a receivable.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Gift Card Liability
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation for outstanding gift cards. Retail customers purchase gift cards or gift certificates that can be redeemed at a later date for merchandise or services; those unredeemed represent a liability of the entity because the revenue is being deferred.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Health Care Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period in insurance industry assets which are classified as cash flows from operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Settlements Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of inventory pertaining to construction, development, or other contracts or programs that initially were expected to take more than one year or the normal operating cycle to complete.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Lease Acquisition Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Leasing Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from lessees arising from lease agreements.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Life Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in life insurance liability balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans, Deferred Income
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in net unamortized loan origination fees and other fees that are collected at origination but recorded as income over the life of the loan.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of loans or securitized loans that are held with the intention to sell in the near future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Long-term Receivables, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Margin Deposits Outstanding
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in money or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivative position.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Marketable Securities, Restricted
doc: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in total debt and equity financial instruments including: (1) securities held-to-maturity, (2) trading securities, and (3) securities available-for-sale that are pledged to one or more secured parties who have the right to buy, sell, or re-pledge the collateral.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of mortgage loans that are held with the intention to sell or be securitized in the near future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion (due within one year or one business cycle, whichever is longer) of the amount owed by the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from note holders for outstanding loans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entry (during the current year or operating cycle) in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Insurance Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in insurance liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Loans
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Policyholder Funds
doc: The change in other policyholder funds recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
doc: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
doc: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in over Energy Recovery
doc: The change during the reporting period in the value of the asset created by an over recovery. An over recovery means that the basic energy product price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less than the basic fuel price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in over (under) Energy Recovery
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the asset or liability created by an over or under recovery. An over under-recovery means that the basic energy price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less (over) or more (under) than the basic energy price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Participation Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of participation liabilities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
doc: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal officers, directors and stockholders may be combined in the customer captions if they are not material and the combination is disclosed in the oath that is required to accompany the annual audited FOCUS Report.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Postemployment Obligations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Premiums Receivable
doc: The change in the premium receivable balance on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Advertising
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Interest
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
doc: The change in prepaid reinsurance premiums recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Royalties
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Supplies
