doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits in future periods.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Casualty Insurance Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) in property and casualty insurance liabilities balances during the period.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Other Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of cash payments due to taxing authorities for non-income-related taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Raw Materials, Packaging Materials and Supplies Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of raw materials, packaging materials and supplies held in inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables under Repurchase Agreements
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity under agreements to sell and repurchase securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Property Damage Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the public utility damage costs that will be permitted by regulatory agencies to be recovered from rate payers.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Refundable Gas Costs
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the asset or liability created by a public utility's ability to recover gas costs that are higher or lower than the basic cost included in rate payer calculations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs (revenues) to the balance sheet. This element is a the increase (decrease) of regulatory assets and liabilities combined.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Clause Revenue
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in unrecovered fuel costs for a regulated utility company.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Payables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to other insurance companies when the reporting entity has assumed a portion of the cedant's insurance risk which has resulted in insurance losses.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Reserve for Commissions, Expense and Taxes
doc: The change in the reserve for commissions, expenses and taxes recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash and Investments
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow during the period for the aggregate increase (decrease) associated with funds and investments that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as assets held in escrow or contractually limited as to use or disposition) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in marketable securities and investments pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities. This may include cash restricted for regulatory purposes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Retail Related Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Retainage Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in retainage obligations due by the reporting entity that are payable within one year (or one business cycle).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Risk Management Assets and Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of financial instruments other than those that are purchased and held principally for the purpose of hedging or mitigating market risk, credit risk, legal risk, operational risk and other types of risk.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Royalties Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for compensation payments related to the use of copyrights, patents, trade names, licenses, technology. Royalty payments are also paid by the lease holders for oil, gas, and mineral extraction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Savings Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all savings account deposits, which may include passbook, statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs), classified as cash flows from financing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Borrowed
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity arising from securities borrowed transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Lending Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of the liability pertaining to obligations to return collateral that the entity received when it loaned securities to the counterparty to the transaction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Loaned Transactions
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
doc: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in under Energy Recovery
doc: The change during the reporting period in the value of the liability created by an under-recovery. An under-recovery means that the basic energy product price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is more than the basic fuel price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Undisbursed Loan Funds
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in undistributed cash for loans that have been granted but not entirely funded.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

tlabel: (Increase) Decrease in Unearned Premiums, Net
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Unproved Oil and Gas Property
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of property designated for oil and gas production that has not been found (through exploratory drilling) to have extractible reserves of oil and gas.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Workers' Compensation Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due for insurance (or actual expenses) to cover the medical expenses and lost income for employees that are injured during the course of doing work-related activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

tlabel: Increase in Restricted Cash
doc: Amount of cash outflow associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Participating Nonvested Shares with Non-forfeitable Dividend Rights
doc: This element represents nonvested share-based payment awards that contain non-forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents (whether paid or unpaid). Basic and dilutive earnings per share are generally disclosed for such shares using the two-class method.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Financial Guarantee
doc: Amount, after policies assumed or ceded, of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for financial guarantee insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Property, Casualty and Liability
doc: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for property and casualty insurance contracts.

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived Contractual Rights
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date of rights with an indefinite period of benefit that arose from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived Franchise Rights
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through a franchise arrangement having an indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit, from foreign currency translation and purchase accounting adjustments.

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived Trade Names
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
doc: Consideration given by issuer of convertible debt to provide an incentive for debt holders to convert the debt to equity securities. The expense is equal to the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in the transaction in excess of the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms.

tlabel: Information Technology and Data Processing
doc: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

tlabel: Initial Franchise Fees
doc: The amount of initial franchise fees.

tlabel: Insurance Agency Management Fee
doc: Fees earned during the period for providing management services.

tlabel: Insurance Commissions
doc: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

tlabel: Insurance Commissions and Fees
doc: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

tlabel: Insurance Investment Income
doc: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

tlabel: Insurance Recoveries
doc: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

tlabel: Insurance Settlements Receivable
doc: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

tlabel: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Current
doc: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

tlabel: Insurance Tax
doc: Represents total insurance tax expense reflected in the income statement for each period presented.

tlabel: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Gross (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of intangible assets, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
doc: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating
doc: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
doc: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Trading or Measured at Fair Value
doc: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on trading securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests.

tlabel: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Interest and Dividends Payable
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity).

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases
doc: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
doc: The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-in-portfolio
doc: Interest and fee income generated by loans the Entity intends and has the ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (1) industrial and agricultural; (2) real estate; and (3) real estate construction loans; (4) trade financing; (5) lease financing; (6) home equity lines-of-credit; (7) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (8) credit card and other revolving-type loans. Also includes interest income for leases held by the Entity.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
doc: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial and Residential, Real Estate
doc: Interest and fee income from commercial and residential real estate loans.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Industrial, and Agricultural Loans
doc: Interest and fee income generated from all commercial, industrial, and agricultural loans.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Real Estate
doc: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by commercial properties. Examples of properties commonly securing commercial real estate loans may include office buildings, apartment buildings, shopping centers, industrial property, and hotels.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
doc: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Home Equity
doc: Interest and fee income from home equity lines-of-credit extended to individuals (borrowers). Such loans are generally secured by the borrower's equity in her or his home.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Automobiles, Marine, and Other Vehicles
doc: Interest and fee income generated by automobile, marine, and other vehicle loans made to individuals.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Credit Card
doc: Interest and fee income from credit card balances due from individuals. Such loans are considered revolving credit arrangements.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Real Estate
doc: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by one- to four-family residential properties. This item excludes home equity lines-of-credit.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans Held-for-sale, Mortgages
doc: Interest and fee income from mortgage loans considered to be held-for-sale.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Lease Financing
doc: Interest and fee income generated by direct lease financing which consists of an institution owning and leasing personal property for the use of its customers at the customers' specific request.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Other Consumer
doc: Interest and fee income from other loans extended to individual consumers.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Real Estate Construction
doc: Interest and fee income from loans used for real estate development and construction costs. Such loans are referred to as "Construction" loans or mortgages.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Nonmortgage Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
doc: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
doc: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.

tlabel: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans Held-for-sale
doc: Amount of interest and fee income from loans held-for-sale and classified as other.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
doc: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Total amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include brokered, retail, demand, checking, notice of withdrawal, money market and other interest-bearing deposits.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
doc: Amount of foreign interest-bearing deposits held by the entity.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
doc: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic certificate of deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
doc: Amount of money in interest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Money Market
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) demand deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Other
doc: Amount of other interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Other Time Deposit
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities classified as other. Excludes certificates of deposit.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Savings
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities. Saving deposits bear interest and have no stated maturity.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits
doc: Amount of interest-bearing domestic time deposits. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

tlabel: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Time Deposits
doc: Amount of interest-bearing time deposits in foreign banking offices. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

tlabel: Interest Costs Incurred
doc: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

tlabel: Capitalized Interest Costs, Including Allowance for Funds Used During Construction
doc: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

tlabel: Policyholder Account Balance, Interest Expense
doc: Amount of interest expense for allocation to policyholder account balance.

tlabel: Interest Credited to Policy Owner Account
doc: Amount of expense for unpaid portion of interest credited to policy owner account.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Beneficial Interests Issued by Consolidated Variable Interest Entities
doc: Interest expense on beneficial interests issued by consolidated variable interest entities.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Borrowings
doc: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Customer Deposits
doc: The interest expense recognized during the period on customer deposits or security deposits held in interest bearing accounts.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Demand Deposit Accounts
doc: Interest expense incurred on demand deposit accounts that represent borrowings rather than outstanding drafts.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Deposits
doc: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of interest expense on interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities
doc: Aggregate amount of all interest expense on domestic deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Brokered
doc: Amount of interest expense on domestic brokered deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Certificates of Deposit
doc: Amount of interest expense on domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Checking
doc: Amount of interest expense on domestic checking deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Savings
doc: Amount of interest expense on domestic savings deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Domestic Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on all domestic deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
doc: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Long-term
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on long-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Short-term
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on short-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Foreign Deposits
doc: Interest expense on all foreign deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Lessee, Assets under Capital Lease
doc: The amount, during the lease term, of each minimum [capital] lease payment allocated to interest expense so as to produce a constant periodic rate of interest on the remaining balance of the capital lease obligation.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of interest expense on loans received from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

tlabel: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
doc: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
doc: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Medium-term Notes
doc: Interest expense on medium-Term notes.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Money Market Deposits
doc: Interest expense incurred on all money market deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) Deposits
doc: Interest expense incurred on the amount of Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW). Interest-bearing transaction account that combines the payable on demand feature of checks and investment feature of savings accounts. A NOW account is functionally an interest paying checking account.

tlabel: Interest Expense, NOW Accounts, Money Market Accounts, and Savings Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on the following for deposits in domestic offices: (1) transaction accounts (NOW, and telephone and preauthorized transfer accounts), (2) money market deposits and (3) savings deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other Domestic Deposits
doc: Interest expense incurred on other deposits in domestic offices.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Other Short-term Borrowings
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on other short-term borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
doc: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Gross expenses on securities sold coupled with an agreement to repurchase the same from the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price within a fixed or variable time period.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings Excluding Federal Funds and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances and other short term borrowings.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
doc: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
doc: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
doc: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, of $100,000 or more in domestic offices.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
doc: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, less than $100,000 in domestic offices.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Trading Liabilities
doc: Interest expense incurred on short positions arising from sales of securities and other assets, which the entity does not own, to other parties. Trading liabilities includes the fair value of derivative contracts held for trading that are in loss positions.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

tlabel: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
doc: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Operating
doc: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale); classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Operating
doc: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
doc: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
doc: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of interest income from interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold
doc: Interest income on federal funds sold. Federal funds sold represent the excess federal funds held by one commercial bank which it lends to another commercial bank, usually at an agreed-upon (federal funds) rate of interest. Such loans generally are of short-duration (overnight).

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

tlabel: Interest Income, Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
doc: Amount of interest income from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

tlabel: Interest Income, Foreign Deposits
doc: Interest income generated from amounts on deposit with foreign entities located outside the United States of America.

tlabel: Interest Income, Loans to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of interest income from loans to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Interest Income, Money Market Deposits
doc: Interest earned on funds deposited in US domestic money market accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Other Domestic Deposits
doc: Amount of interest earned on US domestic deposits classified as other. Excludes money market accounts.

tlabel: Interest Income, Purchased Receivables
doc: Interest earned from receivables purchased; for instance, receivables purchased through a factoring arrangement.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Corporate Debt, Operating
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on corporate debt securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Mortgage Backed
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securitized, pass-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Other US Government
doc: Interest income on securities issued by US government agencies not including US Treasury Securities.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Interest income derived from securities purchased under agreements to resell. The difference in the price at which the institution buys the securities and resells the securities represents interest for the use of the funds by the other party. Most repurchase and sale agreements involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances and negotiable certificates of deposits are sometimes used in such transactions.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, State and Municipal
doc: Interest income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, derived from debt securities issued by municipal governments, local taxing districts and US state government agencies.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury
doc: Interest income on US treasury securities. US treasury securities are negotiable debt obligations of the US government, secured by its full faith and credit and issued at various schedules and maturities. The income from treasury securities is exempt from state and local, but not federal, taxes. There are three types of securities issued by the US treasury (bonds, bills, and notes), which are distinguished by the amount of time from the initial sale of the bond to maturity.

tlabel: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury and Other US Government
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on U.S. Treasury securities and other U.S. government securities.

tlabel: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

tlabel: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
doc: The amount of net gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

tlabel: Interest Rate Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets.

tlabel: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Interest Rate Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities.

tlabel: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, net of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

tlabel: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
doc: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

tlabel: Interest Receivable and Other Assets
doc: Amount of interest receivable and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Interest Receivable, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of current interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Interest Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of noncurrent interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

tlabel: Interest Revenue (Expense), Net
doc: Amount of interest revenue (income derived from investments in debt securities and on cash and cash equivalents) net of interest expense (cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest).

tlabel: Inventory Adjustments
doc: Amount of inventory reserves for last-in first-out (LIFO) and other inventory valuation methods.

tlabel: Energy Related Inventory, Crude Oil, Products and Merchandise
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of finished goods inventories for petroleum products, crude oil, petrochemical products, and other oil and gas inventories.

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation reserves of merchandise or goods held by the entity that are readily available for sale and items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for sale.

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves
doc: The aggregated amount of merchandise or goods held by the entity and readily available for future sale plus items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for future sale. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Homes
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of homes that have been finished and are ready for sale, net of valuation allowance and impairment loss.

tlabel: Inventory, Firm Purchase Commitment, Loss
doc: Amount of loss recognized on firm purchase commitment for inventory.

tlabel: Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves, and progress payments, of inventory associated with long-term contracts, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Inventory, Gas in Storage Underground, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas stored underground in depleted gas reservoirs, aquifers, or salt caverns to meet future seasonal and peak load demands and also as insurance against unforeseen supply disruptions, and deemed to be a noncurrent asset because it is not expected to be used within 12 months or in the normal operating cycle.

tlabel: Inventory, Homes under Construction
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized construction costs of homes for future sale.

tlabel: Inventory, Land Held for Development and Sale
doc: Carrying amount net of impairment reserves as of the balance sheet date primarily consisting of deposits for land purchases (including option payments), related acquisition costs, and land which is not expected to be developed in the next two years.

tlabel: Inventory, Land Held-for-sale
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of parcels of land held for sale, and on which the entity has no intention or no further intention to perform construction activities.

tlabel: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Effect on Income, Net
doc: The difference between the change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods and any LIFO decrement which have been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

tlabel: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Period Charge
doc: The change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods, which change has been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

tlabel: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings
doc: Amount, after deduction of valuation reserves, other allowances, and customer advances received on long-term contracts or programs, of inventory expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

tlabel: Inventory, Noncurrent
doc: Inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

tlabel: Inventory, Operative Builders
doc: The net carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the various components of an operative builder's inventory, including finished homes. Operative builders primarily consist of entities that develop land, construct residential homes and commercial and industrial buildings thereon, and sell them to home buyers and operators of the commercial and industrial properties.

tlabel: Inventory, Ore Stockpiles on Leach Pads, Gross
doc: Amount before last-in first-out (LIFO) and valuation reserves of ore stockpile material contained on a leach pad, for example, but not limited to, copper or gold ore.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials and Purchased Parts, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items purchased for use as components of a finished product or pieces of machinery and equipment plus any items in their natural and unrefined state. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines raw materials and purchased parts into an aggregate amount.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
doc: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate
doc: Total of (1) improvements, (2) held-for-sale, (3) land and land under development, (4) construction-in-process, (5) mortgage loans held-in-inventory, and (6) other real estate investments which are considered inventory due to being held for sale or disposition.

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate, Construction in Process
doc: Cost of real estate projects incurred for projects for eventual sale or transfer (condominium or time share projects, vacation clubs).

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate, Held-for-sale
doc: Represents properties which were acquired directly or through foreclosure for which a committed plan to sell exists and an active program to market such properties has been initiated.

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate, Improvements
doc: Represents improvements to real estate during development for ultimate sale to third parties. Improvements may consist of project infrastructure and other expenditures necessary to completion of the development project which is generally of a long-term nature.

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate, Land and Land Development Costs
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of valuation allowances and impairment losses, of costs of land expected to be developed in the near term plus capitalized costs of development, for purposes of selling completed units to home buyers or commercial or industrial entities..

tlabel: Inventory, Real Estate, Mortgage Loans Held in Inventory
doc: Represents mortgage loans held in inventory primarily for sale to others (third parties, businesses, legal entities) in the ordinary course of business.

tlabel: Inventory, Supplies, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
doc: The aggregate carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

tlabel: Inventory Write-down
doc: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

tlabel: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
doc: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

tlabel: Investment Banking Revenue
doc: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

tlabel: Investment Company, Committed Capital
doc: Amount of funds committed to investment company from investors.

tlabel: Investment Company, Contractual Fee Waived
doc: Amount of fee contractually waived by investment company.

tlabel: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed tax basis earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Capital Loss Carryforward
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed deficit from capital loss carryforward of investment company.

tlabel: Investment Company, Distribution to Shareholders, Per Share
doc: Per share or unit amount of distribution to shareholders. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

tlabel: Investment Company, Expense Offset Arrangement
doc: Amount of expense reduction under arrangement in which third party explicitly reduces its fee by specified amount for service provided in exchange for use of investment company's assets.

tlabel: Investment Company, General Partner Advisory Service
doc: Amount of expense for advisory service from general partner.

tlabel: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) from Operations, Per Share
doc: Per share or unit amount of investment income (loss) and realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share
doc: Per share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss).

tlabel: Investment Company, Net Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in net assets of investment company.

tlabel: Investment Company, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investment and Foreign Currency
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating, and foreign currency transaction. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

tlabel: Investment Company, Voluntary Fee Waived
doc: Amount of fee voluntarily waived by investment company.

tlabel: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
doc: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
doc: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Dividend
doc: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Investment Expense
doc: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

tlabel: Investment Income, Net
doc: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investment Income, Nonoperating
doc: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

tlabel: Investment in Physical Commodities
doc: Investments held in physical commodities, such as gold, silver, platinum, crude oil, coal, sugar, rice, wheat.

tlabel: Investment in Physical Commodities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of investment held in physical commodities, for example, but not limited to, gold, silver, platinum, crude oil, coal, sugar, rice, wheat.

tlabel: Investment Interest Rate
doc: Rate of interest on investment.

tlabel: Investment Owned, at Cost
doc: Cost of the investment.

tlabel: Investment Owned, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in security owned.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Balance, Contracts
doc: Balance held at close of period in number of contracts.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Balance, Other Measure
doc: Quantity of the investment. Indicate the measure in the unit of measure. This is commonly used for investments other than securities. For example, if the investment is gold, the balance would be the number of ounces and the unit of measure would indicate "ounces".

tlabel: Investment Owned, Balance, Principal Amount
doc: Amount of principal of investment owned.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Balance, Shares
doc: Number of shares of investment owned.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Percent of Net Assets
doc: Percentage of investment owned to net assets.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Restricted, Cost
doc: The cost of the restricted investment.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Face Amount
doc: Nominal or face amount on the investment owned.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation
doc: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net
doc: This element represents the net excess or deficiency of the fair value of an investment (security, contract) over or under its cost (face amount, notional amount), respectively, which excess value or deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

tlabel: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Depreciation
doc: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

tlabel: Investment-related Liabilities
doc: The aggregate amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date for obligations incurred in connection with the entity's investments.

tlabel: Investments
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

tlabel: Investments and Cash
doc: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Investments in Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of investments in an entity not consolidated. Includes, but is not limited to, investments in an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group, an entity which the company has significant influence, but does not have control and subsidiaries that are not required to be consolidated and are accounted for using the equity or cost method.

tlabel: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value
doc: Value of the investment at close of period. For investment in and advances to affiliates, if operations of any controlled companies are different in character from those of the company, group such affiliates within divisions and by type of activities.

tlabel: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the investments in and advances to affiliates.

tlabel: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Balance, Shares
doc: Number of shares of affiliates held for management investment companies.

tlabel: Investments in Power and Distribution Projects
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of investments in power and distribution projects that are expected to be realized after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Balance, Principal Amount
doc: For investments which are quantified by principal amount, principal balance held at close of period.

tlabel: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Balance, Shares
doc: Number of securities sold short (the short position) as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Percent of Net Assets
doc: For schedules of investments sold, not yet purchased (short sales) that are categorized, each category would be expected to have a percent of net assets for the aggregated value of the investments sold short in the category.

tlabel: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Sale Proceeds
doc: The amount of proceeds received resulting from the short sale of a security.

tlabel: Investment Tax Credit
doc: The amount deducted from an entities' taxes, reflecting a percentage of an amount invested in certain assets spread over the useful life of those assets; includes deferred investment tax credits.

tlabel: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Current
doc: The current portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Junior Subordinated Notes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments, excluding current portion.

tlabel: Junior Subordinated Notes
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments.

tlabel: Land Available for Development
doc: Carrying amount of land available for development.

tlabel: Land Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of investment in land held for sale.

tlabel: Land Improvements
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use. Examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots.

tlabel: Landing Fees and Other Rentals
doc: Direct costs incurred at airports in which the entity conducts flight operations. The costs primarily consist of fees paid to the airport authority for takeoff and landing, gate space and facilities, allocations of common space such as security and other terminal costs and fuel storage facilities.

tlabel: Late Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
doc: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset as a result of the debt holder not meeting the monthly payment terms.

tlabel: Lease, Cost
doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

tlabel: Lease Deposit Liability
doc: Amount of liability for lease payments received, including variable lease payments, when collectability is not probable at commencement date for sales-type lease.

tlabel: Lease Incentive, Payable, Current
doc: This item represents an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Lease Incentive, Payable
doc: This item represents an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

tlabel: Lease Incentive Receivable
doc: This item represents a receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

tlabel: Lease Incentive Receivable, Current
doc: This item represents the current receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease. The receivable is due within one year. For classified balance sheets, this element represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Lease Incentive Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Noncurrent portion of receivables for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

tlabel: Lease Income
doc: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

tlabel: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

tlabel: Lessor, Direct Financing Lease, Assumptions and Judgments, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
doc: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of direct financing lease term.

tlabel: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received
doc: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor for operating lease.

tlabel: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
doc: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria to be classified as leveraged.

tlabel: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
doc: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

tlabel: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment Tax Credit Receivable
doc: This element represents the receivable for the amount of the investment tax credit to be realized on the leveraged lease transaction.

tlabel: Liabilities, Fair Value Adjustment
doc: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which a liability could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

tlabel: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Current
doc: The current carrying amount, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations or liabilities.

tlabel: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion, due in greater than one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations, or liabilities.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Incurred Loss
doc: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Disability, Accident and Health
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to disability, accident and health insurance insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date) and the amount needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost required to investigate and settle claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date), whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Property Casualty Liability
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to casualty insurance insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date) and the amount needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost required to investigate and settle claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date), whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, after Reinsurance
doc: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of liability for future policy benefit.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
doc: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
doc: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Disability and Accident Benefits
doc: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under disability and accident insurance contracts.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Individual and Group Annuities and Supplementary Contracts
doc: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under individual and group annuities and supplementary insurance contracts.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Life
doc: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under long-term life insurance contracts.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Contracts
doc: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under other insurance contracts.

tlabel: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Expense (Income)
doc: Amount of expense (income) recognized due to changes in the accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events.

tlabel: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling asserted and unasserted claims estimated to have been incurred by the insureds on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to the existence of a lien, encumbrance, defect or other matter purportedly affecting the title to the interest as insured.

tlabel: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
doc: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

tlabel: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
doc: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims
doc: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

tlabel: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Net
doc: Liability as of the balance sheet date for amounts representing estimated cost of settling unpaid claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies, less estimated reinsurance recoveries on such claims. This includes an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported. Claim adjustment expenses represent the costs estimated to be incurred in the settlement of unpaid claims.

tlabel: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts
doc: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to financial default insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date) and the amount needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost required to investigate and settle claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date), whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

tlabel: Licenses Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
doc: Revenue earned during the period relating to consideration received from another party for the right to use, but not own, certain of the entity's intangible assets. Licensing arrangements include, but are not limited to, rights to use a patent, copyright, technology, manufacturing process, software or trademark. Licensing fees are generally, but not always, fixed as to amount and not dependent upon the revenue generated by the licensing party. An entity may receive licensing fees for licenses that also generate royalty payments to the entity.

tlabel: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Amount
doc: This item represents the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Entity as of the date of the statement of financial position. Such Entity-owned life insurance policies are commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

tlabel: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
doc: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

tlabel: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value
doc: Fair value amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

tlabel: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of investments in life settlement contracts held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

tlabel: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Carrying Amount
doc: Carrying amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

tlabel: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Unit-based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in members' equity for unit-based payment arrangement issued by limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Limited Liability Company (LLC) or Limited Partnership (LP), Managing Member or General Partner, Ownership Interest
