doc: Percentage investment held by the managing member or general partner of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Members or Limited Partners, Ownership Interest
doc: Percentage investment held by members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

tlabel: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Issuance Value
doc: Stated value of preferred units of ownership issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Outstanding
doc: Number of preferred units of ownership outstanding of a limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Amount
doc: The total amount of distributions to limited partners.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Authorized
doc: The number of limited partner units authorized to be issued.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
doc: The number of limited partner units issued.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
doc: The number of limited partner units outstanding.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Contributed Capital
doc: The amount of capital contributed by the limited partners.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Cumulative Cash Distributions
doc: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the limited partners.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Cumulative Earnings
doc: Aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the limited partners based on the sharing of income or losses between general and limited partners as specified in the partnership agreement, excluding any priority income allocations resulting from incentive distributions or special earnings allocations.

tlabel: Limited Partners' Offering Costs
doc: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the limited partners.

tlabel: Line of Credit Assumed
doc: The fair value of line of credit assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
doc: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
doc: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

tlabel: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of the credit facility.

tlabel: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Costs to Dispose of Assets and Liabilities
doc: Amount of estimated accrued costs to dispose of assets or other items expected to be sold in liquidation.

tlabel: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss) on Accrued Costs to Dispose of Assets and Liabilities
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of estimated accrued costs to dispose of assets or other items expected to be sold in liquidation.

tlabel: Estimated Litigation Liability
doc: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

tlabel: Estimated Litigation Liability, Current
doc: Carrying amount of reserve for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid within one year of the date of the statement of financial position.

tlabel: Estimated Litigation Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded from Other Party
doc: Amount awarded from other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

tlabel: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded to Other Party
doc: Amount awarded to other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

tlabel: Litigation Settlement Interest
doc: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

tlabel: Loan Portfolio Expense
doc: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

tlabel: Loan Processing Fee
doc: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
doc: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, before Fees, Gross
doc: Amount, before allowance and fees, of loans and leases receivable. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income
doc: Amount of deferred interest and fee income, unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sales, Net
doc: Reflects the net positive or negative amount derived from subtracting from net proceeds of sale and the carrying amounts, net of allocated reserves, of financial assets transferred to third parties in transactions that qualify for sales treatment.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Covered
doc: Aggregate gross carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
doc: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income
doc: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered
doc: Net carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered
doc: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, reflects the carrying amount of unpaid loan amounts due from related parties at the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Additions
doc: Reflects the amount of new advances made to related parties in the form of loan and lease receivables.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans and leases receivable due from related parties.

tlabel: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Proceeds
doc: Amount of cash inflow from related parties which reduce the amount of loans and leases receivable due from related parties.

tlabel: Loans Assumed
doc: The fair value of loans assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans from another FHLBank.

tlabel: Loans Held-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of loans held-for-sale including, but not limited to, mortgage loans and finance receivables.

tlabel: Loans, Gross, Insurance Policy
doc: Amount before allowance of loans made to policy and contract holders using their life insurance contracts' cash value or separate accounts as collateral. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

tlabel: Loans Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Loans Payable to Bank
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Loans Pledged as Collateral
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of loans that have been pledged as collateral for borrowings. If the secured party has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge the collateral, then the debtor reclassifies that asset and report that asset in its statement of financial position separately from other assets not so encumbered.

tlabel: Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
doc: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on loan receivable.

tlabel: Loans Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of loan receivable, including, but not limited to, mortgage loans held for investment, finance receivables held for investment, policy loans on insurance contracts.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale
doc: Amount, before valuation allowance, of financing receivable classified as held-for-sale.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

tlabel: Loans to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Long-term Construction Loan, Current
doc: This element represents the current portion of a long-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project (generally one to seven years), usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property.

tlabel: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

tlabel: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Repayments of Principal in Next Twelve Months
doc: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

tlabel: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Long-term Investments and Receivables, Net
doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

tlabel: Long-term Line of Credit, Noncurrent
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

tlabel: Loans Payable, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

tlabel: Long-term Pollution Control Bond
doc: Represents the current and noncurrent portions of a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

tlabel: Loss Contingency Accrual
doc: Amount of loss contingency liability.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Current
doc: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

tlabel: Loss Contingency Accrual, Provision
doc: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period
doc: The amount of loss pertaining to the specified contingency that was charged against earnings in the period, including the effects of revisions in previously reported estimates.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Receivable
doc: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Current
doc: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

tlabel: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Proceeds
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables related to a loss contingency.

tlabel: Loss from Catastrophes
doc: The charge against earnings in the period for the uninsured portion of a loss from a fire, explosion, or natural disaster (hurricane, earthquake).

tlabel: Loss on Contracts
doc: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

tlabel: Loss on Contract Termination
doc: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

tlabel: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of the noncurrent portion of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

tlabel: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Premium Costs
doc: Amount of costs incurred that are associated with obtaining malpractice insurance and other risk transferring arrangements during an accounting period.

tlabel: Management Fee Payable
doc: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.

tlabel: Margin Deposit Assets
doc: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

tlabel: Materials, Supplies, and Other
doc: The carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, and other assets, which are not included in inventory but used in production.

tlabel: Maturities of Senior Debt
doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

tlabel: Medium-term Notes
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value at the balance sheet date of a financial instrument used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with original maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Medium-term Notes, Current
doc: Carrying value at the balance sheet date of the current portion of a financial instrument used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with original maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Medium-term Notes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value at the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of a financial instrument used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with original maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Members' Capital
doc: Amount of member capital in limited liability company (LLC).

tlabel: Members' Equity
doc: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.

tlabel: Members' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Memberships in Exchanges Owned
doc: Amount of capitalized cost for obtaining membership with right to do business on trading exchange.

tlabel: Mineral Properties, Accumulated Depletion
doc: The accumulated decrease in the carrying value of the mineral properties as a result of mine or mineral production.

tlabel: Mineral Properties, Accumulated Impairment
doc: The accumulated decrease in the carrying value of the mineral properties as a result of adjustments in estimates of future income generating potential of the mineral property.

tlabel: Mineral Properties, Gross
doc: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral properties, gross of adjustments.

tlabel: Mineral Properties, Net
doc: Mineral properties, net of adjustments.

tlabel: Mineral Rights
doc: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral rights, or rights to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment in the form of a royalty for the extraction of minerals, net of amortization.

tlabel: Mine Reclamation and Closing Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of a reclamation and mine closing liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of a mine including the removal of buildings, equipment, machinery and other physical remnants of mining, closure of tailings impoundments, leach pads and other mine features, and contouring, covering and revegetation of waste rock piles and other disturbed areas.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock
doc: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
doc: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Joint Ventures
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in joint ventures included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Limited Partnerships
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners of a limited partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Operating Partnerships
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners in an operating partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Preferred Unit Holders
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling preferred unit holders in an entity included in the reporting entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
doc: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Parent
doc: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

tlabel: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value
doc: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

tlabel: Mortgage-backed Securities Available-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as available-for-sale.

tlabel: Mortgage-backed Securities Held-to-maturity, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as held-to-maturity.

tlabel: Mortgage Loan Related to Property Sales
doc: Mortgage loan related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

tlabel: Mortgage Loans in Process of Foreclosure, Amount
doc: Recorded investment of consumer mortgage loan receivables secured by residential real estate properties for which formal foreclosure proceedings are in process.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
doc: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Amortization of Premium
doc: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from amortization of premium.

tlabel: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
doc: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Interest Rate
doc: Interest rate of mortgage loan within investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, New Mortgage Loan
doc: Amount of increase in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from new investment.

tlabel: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)
doc: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Mortgages Held-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of mortgage loans held-for-sale.

tlabel: Multiemployer Plans, Withdrawal Obligation
doc: Amount of the obligation recognized by withdrawing from a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.

tlabel: Net Asset Value Per Share
doc: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

tlabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

tlabel: Net Change Annuities and Investment Certificates
doc: The cash inflow or outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

tlabel: Net Change Contract Holders Funds
doc: The cash inflow or outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

tlabel: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
doc: The increase (decrease) in domestic interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

tlabel: Net Change Interest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
doc: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.

tlabel: Net Change Noninterest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
doc: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Diluted
doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent, and includes adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive convertible securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Net of Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
doc: Amount of profit (loss) after Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership
doc: Amount of net income (loss) recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
doc: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
doc: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each limited partnership and general partnership unit in instances when basic and diluted earnings per unit are the same amount and aggregated on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per unit is the amount of net income or loss for the period per unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per unit includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each limited and general partnership unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Net Investment Income
doc: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

tlabel: Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases
doc: The net amount due as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
doc: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, charged against allowance for credit loss.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

tlabel: Net Investment in Lease, Noncurrent
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

tlabel: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Shares
doc: Net number of shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

tlabel: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Value
doc: Value of net shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of cumulative effect of the change in accounting principle or new accounting pronouncement on retained earnings or other components of equity or net assets in the statement of financial position as of the beginning of the earliest period presented.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Adoption, Quantification (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Represents the quantification of the effect of adopting the new accounting standard or change in accounting principle expected by the entity to have a significant effect on the entity's financial statements.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Income (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the effect of a change in accounting principle on net income.

tlabel: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Operating Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of the effect of a change in accounting principle on operating profit or loss.

tlabel: Noncash Contribution Expense
doc: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.

tlabel: Noncash Merger Related Costs
doc: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Accounts Receivable Acquired
doc: The amount of accounts receivable that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
doc: The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired
doc: The amount of fixed assets that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
doc: The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Inventory Acquired
doc: The amount of inventory that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
doc: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)
doc: The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued
doc: The number of shares issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired
doc: Amount of assets, classified as other, acquired in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed
doc: Amount of liabilities, classified as other, assumed in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed
doc: The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
doc: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed
doc: The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash Project Abandonment Costs
doc: The expense charged against earnings to eliminate the capitalized costs of projects that have been terminated during the reporting period, which is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by (used in) operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
doc: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other nonredeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other redeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

tlabel: Long-Lived Assets
doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

tlabel: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

tlabel: Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
doc: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
doc: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
doc: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

tlabel: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
doc: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense
doc: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
doc: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Investment Advisory Fees
doc: This represents the company's cost incurred during an accounting period for managing the money in a fund, which will be billed back to the client and is a component of noninterest expenses.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Offering Cost
doc: Includes offering costs of open-end investment companies, and closed-end funds with a continuous offering period.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment
doc: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
doc: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

tlabel: Noninterest Income
doc: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other
doc: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
doc: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

tlabel: Non Investment Assets Less Non Investment Liabilities
doc: The net of non investment assets and liabilities. This amount represents the difference between the aggregate value of the investments, including long and short positions, and net assets.

tlabel: Non Investment Assets Less Non Investment Liabilities, Percent of Net Assets
doc: The percent of net assets of non investment assets and liabilities. This represents the percentage difference between the investments, including long and short positions, and net assets.

tlabel: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer
doc: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).

tlabel: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gross Operating Revenue Recognized
doc: The amount of gross operating revenue recognized in a nonmonetary transaction.

tlabel: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
doc: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

tlabel: Non-Recourse Debt
doc: Amount of debt for which creditor does not have general recourse to the debtor but rather has recourse only to the property used for collateral in the transaction or other specific property.

tlabel: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

tlabel: Nontrade Receivables
doc: Carrying amounts due as of the balance sheet date of the sum of amounts receivable other than from customers.

tlabel: Nontrade Receivables, Current
doc: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Notes Assumed
doc: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

tlabel: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of notes payable.

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable to banks, excluding mortgage notes, initially due beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
doc: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

tlabel: Notes Receivable by Owner to Limited Liability Company (LLC)
doc: Amount of an agreement for an unconditional promise by an owner to pay limited liability company (LLC) a definite sum of money at a future date.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties
doc: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay.

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
doc: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Noncurrent
doc: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

tlabel: Notes Reduction
doc: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

tlabel: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

tlabel: Number of Businesses Acquired
doc: The number of businesses acquired by the entity during the period.

tlabel: Number of Real Estate Properties
doc: The number of real estate properties owned as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
doc: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

tlabel: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Receivable
doc: Amount of receivable from other entities recognized in the balance sheet resulting from the joint and several liability arrangement.

tlabel: Occupancy, Net
doc: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

tlabel: OCI, before Reclassifications, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

tlabel: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

tlabel: Offering Costs, Partnership Interests
doc: Costs incurred in connection with the offering and selling of additional partner interest.

tlabel: Office of Finance, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
doc: Amount of a Federal Home Loan Bank's (FHLBank) proportionate share of the costs of operating the Office of Finance.

tlabel: Off-market Lease, Unfavorable
doc: This element represents a liability associated with the acquisition of an off-market lease when the terms of the lease are unfavorable to the market terms for the lease at the date of acquisition.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Joint Interest Billing Receivables
doc: Portion of accounts receivable attributable to joint interest partners in oil and gas properties. These are billings to the non-operators associated with the operation of wells and are based on those owners' working interests in the wells.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Joint Interest Billing Receivables, Current
doc: Current portion of accounts receivable attributable to joint interest partners in oil and gas properties. These are billings to the non-operators associated with the operation of wells and are based on those owners' working interests in the wells. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Joint Interest Billing Receivables, Noncurrent
doc: Noncurrent portion of accounts receivable attributable to joint interest partners in oil and gas properties. These are billings to the non-operators associated with the operation of wells and are based on those owners' working interests in the wells.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion Amortization and Impairment
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment of oil and gas property carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of oil and gas property carried under the successful effort method. Oil and gas property include, but not limited to, the entity's wells and related equipment and facilities.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Gross
doc: Oil and Gas properties, gross, carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method, Net
doc: Oil and gas properties net of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, impairment, and abandonment, carried under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Reclamation Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of a reclamation liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of oil and gas properties.

tlabel: Oil and Gas Sales Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to third parties for oil and gas that has been sold but not delivered. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Open Option Contracts Written, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value of the open option contracts written for the investment.

tlabel: Open Option Contracts Written, Premiums
doc: Amount of premium received on derivative.

tlabel: Operating Insurance and Claims Costs, Production
doc: Insurance and claims costs directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Cost
doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
doc: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, over Term
doc: Amount of operating lease initial direct cost recognized as expense over lease term.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Payments, Use
doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Remainder of Fiscal Year
doc: Amount of required minimum rental payments receivable in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
doc: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Initial Direct Costs
doc: Amount of incremental cost of lease that would not have been incurred if lease had not been obtained.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
doc: The total amount of revenue recognized for the period from operating leases, including minimum lease revenue, contingent revenue, percentage revenue and sublease revenue.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Minimum Lease Revenue
doc: The total amount of lease revenue recognized for the period for which the lessee was obligated under leasing arrangements regardless of any other events or conditions. This amount excludes contingent revenue and sublease revenue.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Sublease Revenue
doc: The amount of revenue recognized for the period under subleasing arrangements.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Contingent Rentals
doc: The increases or decreases in lease payments that result from changes occurring after the inception of the lease in the factors (other than the passage of time) on which lease payments are based, except that any escalation of minimum lease payments relating to increases in construction or acquisition cost of the leased property or for increases in some measure of cost or value during the construction or preconstruction period, are excluded from contingent rentals. Contingent rentals also may include amounts for which the triggering events have not yet occurred or the specified targets for which have not yet been achieved (such as sales based percentage rent), but which events are considered probable of occurring or which specified targets are considered probable of being achieved.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
doc: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

tlabel: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
doc: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

tlabel: Origination of Loan to Purchase Common Stock
doc: Cash outflow for origination of loan for purchasing common stock.

tlabel: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
doc: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

tlabel: Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.

tlabel: Other Adjustments to Income, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

tlabel: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of other assets.

tlabel: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Current
doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Borrowings
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.

tlabel: Other Commitment
doc: Minimum amount of other commitment not otherwise specified in the taxonomy. Excludes commitments explicitly modeled in the taxonomy, including but not limited to, long-term and short-term purchase commitments, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, supply commitments, registration payment arrangements, leases, debt, product warranties, guarantees, environmental remediation obligations, and pensions.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, Tax
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net period benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Adjustment from AOCI for Accretion of Noncredit Portion of OTTI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for accretion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Adjustment from AOCI for Accretion of Noncredit Portion of OTTI, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for accretion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Adjustments, Tax
doc: Amount, after adjustments, of tax (expense) benefit for increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Tax and Adjustments
doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Tax and Adjustments, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, before Tax, after Adjustments
doc: Amount, before tax, after adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, before Tax, after Adjustments, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, before tax, after adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, Additional Credit Loss, after Tax
