doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized from additional credit loss for investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, Sale, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized upon sale of investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
doc: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

tlabel: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current
doc: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
doc: Amount of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements classified as other.

tlabel: Other Deferred Credits, Current
doc: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Deferred Credits, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Employee-related Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Expense from Real Estate Partnership Operations
doc: Amount of selling, general, and administrative expenses, and other expenses, related to investments in real estate partnerships.

tlabel: Other Increase (Decrease) in Environmental Liabilities
doc: Other increase (decrease) not attributable to current expense nor cash payments during an accounting period in estimated obligations recorded for probable future costs attributable to environmental contamination issues.

tlabel: Other Interest and Dividend Income
doc: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

tlabel: Other Interest Earning Assets
doc: Amount of interest earning assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Capitalized Costs, Gross
doc: Amount, before valuation and last-in first out (LIFO) reserves, of costs capitalized in inventory classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Net of Reserves
doc: Amount, after of valuation reserves and allowances, of inventory, classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Inventory, Purchased Goods, Gross
doc: Gross amount of components used by the entity which are bought from another entity rather than produced by the entity.

tlabel: Other Investment Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
doc: Value of the other investment not readily marketable determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques, that was used to record the investment for financial reporting purposes.

tlabel: Other Investments
doc: Amount of investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
doc: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

tlabel: Other Labor-related Expenses
doc: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

tlabel: Other Liabilities and Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
doc: Aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheet date, of noncurrent obligations and noncurrent portion of deferred revenue not separately disclosed in the balance sheet. Noncurrent liabilities are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Deferred revenue is a liability related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized, and is not expected to be recognized in the next twelve months.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

tlabel: Other Loans Payable
doc: Amount of long-term loans payable classified as other.

tlabel: Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Other Long-term Investments
doc: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Carrying amount of equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in one or more of the entities consolidated into the reporting entity's financial statements other than joint ventures, limited partnerships, operating partnerships or interests held by preferred unit holders.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income
doc: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income Tax Expense
doc: The portion of the noncash component of income tax expense for the period other than the portion from the net change in the entity's deferred tax assets and liabilities.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring Expense
doc: Amount of other expense that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring Gain
doc: Amount of gain that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Other Nonrecurring Income
doc: Amount of other income that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

tlabel: Other Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method
doc: Amount of oil and gas properties accounted for using the successful effort method, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
doc: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

tlabel: Other Ownership Interests, Capital Account
doc: Capital account balance of the other unit holders in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Other Ownership Interests, Units Issued
doc: The number of units of other ownership interests issued in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Other Ownership Interests, Units Outstanding
doc: The number of units of other ownership interests outstanding in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Other Ownership Interests, Contributed Capital
doc: The amount of capital contributed by other unit holders.

tlabel: Other Partners' Capital
doc: Amount of other partners' capital.

tlabel: Other Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

tlabel: Other Payments to Acquire Businesses
doc: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

tlabel: Other Policyholder Funds
doc: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

tlabel: Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

tlabel: Liability, Other Retirement Benefits, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, classified as noncurrent, for retirement benefits, classified as other.

tlabel: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

tlabel: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan. Excludes pension plan.

tlabel: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.

tlabel: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
doc: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Real Estate
doc: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Additions
doc: Additions of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

tlabel: Other Real Estate and Foreclosed Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Covered
doc: Carrying amount of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Covered, Valuation Adjustments
doc: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Change in carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

tlabel: Other Real Estate, Valuation Adjustments
doc: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

tlabel: Other Receivables from Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount of other receivables due from broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

tlabel: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
doc: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Recurring Income
doc: Amount of recurring income classified as other.

tlabel: Other Research and Development Expense
doc: Amount of other research and development expense.

tlabel: Other Restricted Assets
doc: Total assets that cannot be used for operating purposes because of contract or regulatory requirements that are in effect for a period that extends beyond one year.

tlabel: Other Restricted Assets, Current
doc: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Restricted Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of noncurrent assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Restructuring Costs
doc: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Other Revenue (Expense) from Real Estate Operations
doc: Amount of other revenue (expense) derived from real estate investments partnerships.

tlabel: Other Secured Financings
doc: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

tlabel: Other Selling and Marketing Expense
doc: Amount of selling and marketing expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
doc: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Short-term Borrowings
doc: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Short-term Investments
doc: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Sundry Liabilities, Current
doc: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are due within one year or operating cycle, if longer, from the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, No Previous Impairment
doc: This item represents an increase to the cumulative amount of credit losses recognized in earnings for an other than temporary impairment (OTTI) of a debt security held for which no such other than temporary impairment (OTTI) was previously recognized.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Reductions, Securities Sold
doc: This item represents reductions in the cumulative amount of credit losses recognized in earnings for an other than temporary impairment (OTTI) of a debt security because of the sale of impaired securities during the period.

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive loss (OCI).

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Recognized in Earnings
doc: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings
doc: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security, recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The amount by which the fair value of an investment in debt and equity securities categorized as Available-for-sale is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive income (OCI).

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Recognized in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent, Available-for-sale Securities
doc: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Attributable to Parent Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive income loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent, Available-for-sale Securities
doc: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent, Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount after tax of amount of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Income Loss, Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Available-for-sale Securities
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Attributable to Parent, Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to the parent entity.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net, Available-for-sale Securities
doc: The amount of other than temporary impairment losses on investments in debt and equity securities categorized as Available-for-sale which have been recognized in earnings during the period. Such impairment losses consist of other than temporary impairments (OTTI) on equity securities, credit losses on investments in debt securities, and when the entity intends to sell an impaired debt security or it is more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell the impaired debt security before recovery of its amortized cost basis.

tlabel: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Recognized in Earnings, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in earnings.

tlabel: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Reclassification Adjustment of Noncredit Portion Included in Net Income, Availabe-for-sale Securities, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) related to factors other than credit loss on a previously impaired investment in available-for-sale debt security.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

tlabel: Other Underwriting Expense
doc: Costs incurred during the period, such as those relating to general administration and policy maintenance that do not vary with and are not primarily related to the acquisition or renewal of insurance contracts.

tlabel: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Shares, Outstanding
doc: The number of shares outstanding as of the date of the statement of financial position in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

tlabel: Paid-in-Kind Interest
doc: Interest paid other than in cash for example by issuing additional debt securities. As a noncash item, it is added to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Participating Mortgage Loans, Extinguishment Gain (Loss)
doc: States the amount of gain (loss) resulting from a participating loan extinguished before its due date.

tlabel: Participating Mortgage Loans, Participation Liabilities, Amount
doc: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

tlabel: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

tlabel: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Diluted
doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Acquisitions
doc: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
doc: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Deferred Compensation
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to deferred compensation. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Per Unit of Limited Partner Interest
doc: The amount of the distribution per unit of limited partner interest.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
doc: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Option Exercise
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to option exercise. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Partners' Capital
doc: Changes in the ownership interest during the period of each class of partners. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Private Placement of Units
doc: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a private placement.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
doc: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units Net of Offering Costs
doc: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
doc: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Reissued
doc: Value of units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the monetary value of these units which were reissued during the period.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units
doc: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions
doc: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Contributed
doc: Units contributed by each class of partners during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Converted
doc: The number of units converted into shares of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
doc: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units
doc: Total units issued during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
doc: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
doc: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased
doc: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Number of Units
doc: Number of units issued for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of partners' capital after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

tlabel: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

tlabel: Partners' Capital, Other
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital classified as other.

tlabel: Patronage Refunds
doc: Amount of earnings distributed to patrons of the agricultural cooperative.

tlabel: Patronage Source Earnings
doc: Amount of revenue in excess of cost resulting from transactions for or with patrons.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Other Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
doc: Amount payable to other broker-dealer and clearing organization, including, but not limited to, security failed-to-receive, deposit received for security loaned, open transaction, and floor-brokerage payable.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Customer
doc: Amount payable to customer by broker-dealer.

tlabel: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

tlabel: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

tlabel: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

tlabel: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
doc: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

tlabel: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
doc: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

tlabel: Payments for Affordable Housing Programs
doc: Amount of cash outflow for payments made by the Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks) to the Affordable Housing Program (AHP).

tlabel: Payments for Bonds Transferred to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of cash outflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability of consolidated obligations to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Payments for Brokerage Fees
doc: The amount of cash paid for brokerage fees during the current period. This element is intended to represent the brokerage fees paid by and between financial industry participants.

tlabel: Payments for Capital Improvements
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

tlabel: Payments for Commissions
doc: The amount of cash paid for commissions during the current period.

tlabel: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
doc: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

tlabel: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
doc: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

tlabel: Payments for Deposits with Other Institutions
doc: Cash paid to make deposits at other institutions during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for Environmental Liabilities
doc: Cash outflows made during the period for environmental remediation activities.

tlabel: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Payments for Other Fees
doc: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Film Costs
doc: Cash payments related to direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

tlabel: Payments for Flight Equipment
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

tlabel: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

tlabel: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities
doc: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Payments for Lease Commissions
doc: Amount of cash outflow for lease commissions incurred.

tlabel: Payments for Leasing Costs
doc: Amount of cash outflow for costs that are essential to originate the lease and would not otherwise have been incurred without the lease agreement. Amount includes, but is not limited to, cash outflows to evaluate the lessee's credit condition, guarantees, and collateral and cash outflows for costs incurred in negotiating, processing, and executing the lease agreement.

tlabel: Payments for Leasing Costs, Commissions, and Tenant Improvements
doc: Net cash outflow for the allowance granted to lessee and/or direct costs incurred by lessor used to prepare the leased premises for tenant's occupancy; for costs that are essential to originating the lease and would not otherwise have been incurred without the lease agreement, including but not limited to, evaluating the lessee's credit condition, guarantees, and collateral and costs incurred in negotiating, processing, and executing the lease agreement; and for any commission(s) incurred.

tlabel: Payments for Legal Settlements
doc: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

tlabel: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
doc: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

tlabel: Payments for Merger Related Costs
doc: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

tlabel: Payments for Mortgage Deposits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for advance payment to show intention to complete mortgage financing.

tlabel: Payments for Nuclear Fuel
doc: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

tlabel: Payments for Operating Activities
doc: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

tlabel: Payments for Origination and Purchases of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

tlabel: Payments for Origination of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

tlabel: Payments for Other Deposits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Other Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for operating activities classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Other Taxes
doc: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Participation Liabilities
doc: Cash payments related to participation costs.

tlabel: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
doc: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

tlabel: Payments for Previous Acquisition
doc: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-sale Securities, Short-term
doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition or sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
doc: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Held-to-maturity Securities, Short-term
doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Limited Partnership
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-term Investments
doc: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Deposits
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Nuclear Fuel
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Policy Loans
doc: Net amount paid or received by the entity associated with issuance or collection of loans made to policy holders, principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-term Investments
doc: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

tlabel: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
doc: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

tlabel: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
doc: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

tlabel: Payments for Reinsurance
doc: Cash payments made for reinsurance during the current period.

tlabel: Payments for Removal Costs
doc: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Initial Public Offering
doc: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
doc: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Private Placement
doc: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
doc: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

tlabel: Payments for Restructuring
doc: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

tlabel: Payments for Tenant Improvements
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the allowance granted to lessee and/or direct costs incurred by lessor used to prepare the leased premises for tenant's occupancy.

tlabel: Payments for Underwriting Expense
doc: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

tlabel: Payments of Capital Distribution
doc: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

tlabel: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
doc: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

tlabel: Payments of Derivative Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of a derivative security.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments of Loan Costs
doc: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

tlabel: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

tlabel: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Buildings
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Business Three, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with a third acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
doc: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Held-for-sale Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development
doc: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
doc: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Land
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Land Held-for-use
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

tlabel: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
doc: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Long-term Investments
doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mining Assets
doc: The cash outflow from the purchase of mining and mining related assets during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-maturity
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable
doc: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
doc: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
doc: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
doc: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Partners Interest in Real Estate Partnership, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow from the purchase of ownership in a partnership, the purpose of which is to construct, sell, hold or invest in real estate.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
doc: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
doc: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Royalty Interests in Mining Properties
doc: The cash outflow from the purchase of royalty interests in mining properties is the amount of cash the mineral producer pays the owner of the mine or mineral resource.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Short-term Investments
doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Software
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Timberlands
doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of timber and timberlands during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Trading Securities Held-for-investment
doc: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Waste Water Systems
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities; and waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Water Systems
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

tlabel: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets
doc: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.

tlabel: Payments to Employees
doc: Payments of cash to employees, including wages and salaries, during the current period.

tlabel: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties
doc: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).

tlabel: Payments to Fund Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Payments to Fund Policy Loans
doc: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

tlabel: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Payments to Purchase Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Payments to Purchase Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash outflow used to purchase loans that are secured with real estate mortgage and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Payments to Purchase Other Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Payments to Suppliers
doc: Payments of cash to suppliers for goods and services during the current period.

tlabel: Payments to Suppliers and Employees
doc: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

tlabel: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

tlabel: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

tlabel: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Payment for Pension Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

tlabel: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

tlabel: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Percentage Revenue
doc: This element represents the rental revenue earned during the period from lessee-operators based on revenues generated in their operations, generally in excess of a base amount. Such rental revenue is generally stipulated in the lease agreement, usually will provide for a fixed percentage of revenue to be paid as additional (or possibly only) rent due the lessor, and may be based on gross revenues, net revenues, or multiple variations thereof. Percentage rent is often required under leases with retail outlets located on premises owned by hoteliers, cruise lines, others in the hospitality industry, and shopping mall operators, among others.

tlabel: Plant Held for Future Use Amount
doc: Discloses the period end amount of plants held for future use and whether such amount is included in the utility's rate base.

tlabel: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Finance Receivables
doc: The carrying amount, as of the date of the latest financial statement presented, of finance receivables which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, primarily a secured borrowing or repurchase agreement, and for which the transferee is not permitted to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Finance Receivables Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of finance receivables which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of loans which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation primarily arising from secured borrowings and repurchase agreements, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other Assets Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of other assets which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Real Estate Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The fair value, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of real estate which is owned but transferred to serve as collateral for the payment of the related debt obligation, and that is reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge it.

tlabel: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The sum of the fair values, as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, of securities that are restricted as collateral for the payment of related debt obligations, primarily secured borrowings and repurchase agreements, and that are reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position because the transferee has the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them.

tlabel: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
doc: The carrying amount as of the date of the latest financial statement presented of mortgage-related securities classified as available for sale or held for investment which are owned but transferred to another party to serve as collateral to partially or fully secure a debt obligation, repurchase agreement or other current or potential obligation, and for which the transferee does not have the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

tlabel: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Other Debt Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
doc: The carrying amount as of the date of the latest financial statement presented of other securities classified as available for sale or held for investment which are owned but transferred to another party to serve as collateral to partially or fully secure a debt obligation, repurchase agreement or other current or potential obligation, and for which the transferee does not have the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.

tlabel: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities for Repurchase Agreements
doc: The carrying amount as of the date of the latest financial statement presented of securities which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral for repurchase agreements, and for which the transferee does not have the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge them to an unrelated party.
