tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Direct
doc: Amount, before effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Health
doc: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for health insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Life and Annuity
doc: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for life and annuity insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Other
doc: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for benefits and costs incurred for other insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Contract Deposit
doc: Amount of liability due to policyholder for deposit held under long-duration contract issued by insurance entity.

tlabel: Policyholder Dividends, Expense
doc: Amount of expense for dividends to policyholders.

tlabel: Policyholder Dividends Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability for dividends that are payable to the policyholders based upon the terms of the underlying insurance contracts.

tlabel: Policyholder Account Balance
doc: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

tlabel: Policy Loans Receivable
doc: Carrying amount of loans made to policyholders against the cash surrender value (CSV) or other policyholder funds, and secured by the CSV, policyholder funds or the death benefit provided by the insurance contracts.

tlabel: Postage Expense
doc: Amount of expense associated with postage.

tlabel: Postconfirmation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents at the balance sheet date after fresh-start adjustments.

tlabel: Postconfirmation, Liabilities and Stockholders' Equity
doc: Total liabilities and stockholders' equity at the balance sheet date after fresh-start adjustments.

tlabel: Postconfirmation, Property and Equipment, Net
doc: Total property and equipment, net at the balance sheet date after fresh-start adjustments.

tlabel: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Current
doc: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable within one year of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent
doc: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Postemployment Benefits, Period Expense
doc: Period expense related to postemployment benefits.

tlabel: Preconfirmation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents at the balance sheet date before fresh-start adjustments.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
doc: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Conversions, Inducements
doc: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Per-Dollar-Amount
doc: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
doc: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
doc: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared
doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Dividends, Shares
doc: Number of shares of preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Aggregate issuance value of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
doc: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Per Share Amounts of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
doc: Per share amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount
doc: The redemption (or callable) amount of currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not currently declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount, Future Redeemable Securities
doc: The redemption (or callable) amount of redeemable preferred stock, excluding currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
doc: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share
doc: The price per share at which the preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity is redeemed or may be called at. The redemption features of this preferred stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
doc: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
doc: The number of nonredeemable preferred stock (shares) (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of preferred stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding
doc: Value of all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by shareholders, which is net of related treasury stock. May be all or a portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. These shares represent the ownership interest of the preferred shareholders.

tlabel: Preferred Units, Authorized
doc: The number of preferred units authorized to be issued.

tlabel: Preferred Units, Contributed Capital
doc: The amount of capital contributed by the preferred partners.

tlabel: Preferred Units, Issued
doc: The number of preferred units issued.

tlabel: Preferred Units, Outstanding
doc: The number of preferred units outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts
doc: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.

tlabel: Premiums and Other Receivables, Net
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, of all premiums and other types of receivables due from other persons or entities.

tlabel: Premiums Earned, Net, Accident and Health
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of accident and health premiums earned.

tlabel: Premiums Earned, Net, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of financial guarantee premiums earned.

tlabel: Premiums Earned, Net, Life
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of life premiums earned.

tlabel: Premiums Earned, Net, Property and Casualty
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of property and casualty premiums earned.

tlabel: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

tlabel: Premiums Receivable, Net
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.

tlabel: Premiums Receivable, Gross
doc: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, before deducting the allowance for doubtful accounts.

tlabel: Premiums Written, Gross
doc: Amount of direct and assumed premiums written.

tlabel: Premiums Written, Net
doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

tlabel: Pre-Opening Costs
doc: Expenditures associated with opening new locations which are noncapital in nature and expensed as incurred.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Prepaid Expense Other, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Prepaid Interest
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Prepaid Mineral Royalties, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized amounts paid for mineral royalties which will be charged against earnings after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
doc: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Prepaid Royalties
doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Prepayment Fees on Advances, Net
doc: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.

tlabel: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-term Supply Arrangements, Asset for Molds Dies and Tools Not Owned
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of molds, dies, and other tools that the entity does not own which are or will be used in producing goods under a long-term supply arrangement, and for which there is a noncancelable right of use during such arrangement.

tlabel: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense
doc: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

tlabel: Present Value of Future Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
doc: Present value of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

tlabel: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Held-for-sale or Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
doc: This is the principal amount outstanding for loans which are in the process of being securitized as of the date of the statement of financial position (across all types of loans).

tlabel: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
doc: This is the principal amount outstanding for securitized loans only (across all types of loans).

tlabel: Principal Investment Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

tlabel: Proceeds and Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
doc: The aggregate cash inflow comprised of the amount received from (a) employees to acquire the entity's shares under incentive awards, including stock option exercises and restricted stock arrangements, and (b) the excess tax benefit arising from such transactions.

tlabel: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
doc: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

tlabel: Proceeds from Advances for Construction
doc: The cash inflow from borrowing by the entity from developers, builders, government agencies and municipalities for construction that are repaid in cash, generally on a straight-line basis over periods ranging from five to forty years.

tlabel: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates
doc: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

tlabel: Proceeds from Bank Debt
doc: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

tlabel: Proceeds from Bonds Transferred from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
doc: Amount of cash inflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability for consolidated obligations of another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
doc: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Policy Loans
doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of policy loans receivable.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Commissions Received
doc: Cash received for commissions during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Construction Loans Payable
doc: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction
doc: The cash inflow from developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities that provide the entity with cash to extend its construction services to their properties.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
doc: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

tlabel: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
doc: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

tlabel: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

tlabel: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
doc: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
doc: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Distributions Received from Real Estate Partnerships
doc: The cash inflow from earnings received from real estate partnerships.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
doc: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

tlabel: Proceeds from Divestiture of Real Estate Partnership
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of interest in partnership during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Dividends Received
doc: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Fees Received
doc: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

tlabel: Proceeds from Financing Revenue Received under Leases
doc: Financing revenue received under leases during the current period by an entity that provides financial services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Grantors
doc: Cash received from grantors during the current period related to operating activities. This element represents receipts from a guarantor for the amount of guarantee provided.

tlabel: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
doc: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

tlabel: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
doc: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
doc: The amount of cash received during the period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

tlabel: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received
doc: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Interest Received
doc: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
doc: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
doc: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-term Notes
doc: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

tlabel: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

tlabel: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
doc: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
doc: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

tlabel: Proceeds from Loan Originations
doc: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

tlabel: Proceeds from Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
doc: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Repayments and Calls of Debt Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Proceeds from Mortgage Deposits
doc: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Deposits
doc: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Operating Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from operating activities classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
doc: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
doc: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-term Loans to Related Parties
doc: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-term
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Proceeds from Pollution Control Bond
doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
doc: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

tlabel: Proceeds from Principal Repayments on Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Proceeds from Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

tlabel: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written Off, Recovery
doc: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.

tlabel: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
doc: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

tlabel: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
doc: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
doc: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from cash and cash items that are not available for withdrawal or usage.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
doc: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities
doc: The cash inflow from issuance of trust preferred securities, net of the cash outflow for repurchasing trust preferred securities, by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

tlabel: Proceeds from Royalties Received
doc: Cash received for royalties during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
doc: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Flight Equipment
doc: Cash received from sales of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
doc: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Furniture and Fixtures
doc: The cash inflow from sale of furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-maturity Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
doc: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
doc: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-use
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Long-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
doc: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Property Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
doc: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate Held-for-investment
doc: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Short-term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
doc: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

tlabel: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

tlabel: Proceeds from Securitizations of Consumer Loans
doc: The cash inflow from the securitization of receivables for loans to consumers. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
doc: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Securitizations of Loans Held-for-investment
doc: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

tlabel: Proceeds from Securitizations of Loans Held-for-sale
doc: The cash inflow from securitizing loans held with the intention to resell in the near future.

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to capital lease obligation.

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

tlabel: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

tlabel: Proceeds from Stock Plans
doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

tlabel: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-term Debt
doc: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

tlabel: Proceeds from Time Deposits Accepted
doc: Cash received from customers who deposit money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

tlabel: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

tlabel: Proceeds from Unsecured Notes Payable
doc: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

tlabel: Proceeds of Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
doc: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

tlabel: Production and Distribution Costs
doc: Amount of expense related to the production and distribution of goods or services to customers and clients.

tlabel: Production Related Impairments or Charges
doc: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

tlabel: Production Tax Expense
doc: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

tlabel: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Present Value
doc: Present value of the accrual for product liability loss contingencies as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

tlabel: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

tlabel: Product Warranty Accrual, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

tlabel: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
doc: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

tlabel: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty liability.

tlabel: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.

tlabel: Product Warranty Expense
doc: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

tlabel: Profit (Loss) from Real Estate Operations
doc: The net cost of operation of other real estate (including provisions for real estate losses, rental income, and gains and losses on sales of real estate).

tlabel: Program Rights Obligations, Current
doc: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid within the next twelve months.

tlabel: Program Rights Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid after one year.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Disposals
doc: Amount of divestiture of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
doc: Gross amount of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
doc: Amount, net of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization, of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
doc: Amount after depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

tlabel: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Net
doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

tlabel: Proved Oil and Gas Property, Successful Effort Method
doc: Oil and Gas properties with proved reserves under the successful effort method.

tlabel: Provision for Loss on Contracts
doc: Cumulative provision for contract losses not offset against related costs accumulated on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Provision for Other Credit Losses
doc: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
doc: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
doc: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

tlabel: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest
doc: Amount capitalized of allowance for funds used during construction.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Inventory
doc: The period end amount for a type of inventory held by the utility in a schedule of inventories.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments
doc: Amount of acquisition adjustments included in property, plant and equipment (PPE) for utilities.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Construction Work in Process Included in Rate Base
doc: Discloses the amount of construction work in process that is included in the rate making process at period end.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Indirect Disallowance of Costs of Recently Completed Plants
doc: The amount of indirect disallowance of costs of a recently completed plant. When it becomes probable that part of the cost of a recently completed plant will be disallowed for rate-making purposes and a reasonable estimate of the amount of the disallowance can be made, the estimated amount of the probable disallowance is deducted from the reported cost of the plant and recognized as a loss. If part of the cost is explicitly, but indirectly, disallowed (for example, by an explicit disallowance of return on investment on a portion of the plant), an equivalent amount of cost is deducted from the reported cost of the plant and recognized as a loss.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Common
doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to regulated assets common to business units.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
doc: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment
doc: Period end book value of equipment owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel
doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation or Processing
doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to generation or processing owned by public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Land
doc: Period end book value of land owned by the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
doc: Period end amount of total net PPE.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
doc: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service
doc: Period end amount of total gross PPE.

tlabel: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission and Distribution
doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to transmission and distribution owned by public utility.

tlabel: Pump Taxes
doc: Pump tax, commonly known as a Replenishment assessment. A charge on each acre-foot of groundwater extracted from the basin. Income from the pump taxes finances the replenishment of the basin and projects for water recycling and water quality improvements.

tlabel: Purchase Obligation
doc: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

tlabel: Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments, Commitment
doc: Amount of commitment or contingent commitments to qualified affordable housing project investments.

tlabel: Quantifying Misstatement in Current Year Financial Statements, Amount
doc: Amount of each individual error being corrected in the correcting adjustment.

tlabel: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Affecting Comparability
doc: Amount of the item included in the interim period that affected period-to-period comparability (excluding restatement adjustments).

tlabel: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Reconciling to Previously Reported Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount by which previously reported quarterly results were revised (for example, to correct an error, or to give retrospective effect to a change in an accounting principle).

tlabel: Real Estate Acquired Through Foreclosure
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of land and buildings obtained through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Acquisition Through Foreclosure
doc: Amount of real estate investments acquired through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

tlabel: Real Estate Assets Held for Development and Sale
doc: For banks, the total amount of real estate assets held for development and sale.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Gross
doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

tlabel: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale
doc: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale by the consolidated entity.

tlabel: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale, Net
doc: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale, net of associated liabilities.

tlabel: Real Estate Held-for-sale
doc: Amount of investment in land and building held for sale. Excludes real estate considered inventory.

tlabel: Real Estate Insurance
doc: A contract to provide coverage or protection in exchange for a payment or "premium". Examples of insurance protection include liability and property insurance. The entity paying the premiums for the protection will have insurance expense and possibly an asset, Prepaid Insurance (if the premiums are paid in advance).

tlabel: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest costs that were capitalized to properties under development during the land development and construction period of a project, and which are included in inventory.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Partnership Cost of Sales
doc: Amount of cost of sales related to investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Partnership Revenue
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
doc: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Investment Property, Net
doc: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Net
doc: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Joint Ventures
doc: The book value of investments in real estate joint ventures including direct and indirect investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Other
doc: Amount of real estate owned for income production and capital accretion potential, not otherwise specified in the existing taxonomy. Such real estate excludes that which is occupied or used in the business, for entertainment purposes, or held in inventory for specific purposes.

tlabel: Real Estate Investments, Unconsolidated Real Estate and Other Joint Ventures
doc: The carrying amount of investments in unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented. This includes direct and indirect investments.

tlabel: Real Estate Liabilities Associated with Assets Held for Development and Sale
doc: For banks, amount of all liabilities for which a financial institution is required to include in its calculation of net investment in real estate assets held for development or sale.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation for real estate owned (REO).

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Amount of Loss at Acquisition
doc: Amount of reduction to fair value of loan related to real estate owned (REO) at time of acquisition.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance
doc: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Amounts Applied
doc: Amount of the valuation allowance for real estate owned that was applied in the period against the carrying amount of real estate owned that was sold, written down or written off.

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Provision
doc: Amount of expense recognized in the income statement for a decrease in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

tlabel: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Valuation Increase
doc: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an increase in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) before accumulated depreciation of real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

tlabel: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
doc: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

tlabel: Real Estate Tax Expense
doc: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

tlabel: Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
doc: This item represents the total realized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period as a result of selling marketable securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity and any gains or losses realized during the period from the sale of investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting and/or investments that are separately or otherwise not categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity. Additionally, this item would include any losses recognized for other than temporary impairments (OTTI) of the subject investments in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Recapitalization Costs
doc: Amount of recapitalization costs for professional fees associated with restructuring debt and equity mixture that do not qualify for capitalization.

tlabel: Receivable from Officers and Directors for Issuance of Capital Stock
doc: Amounts receivable from officers and directors resulting from the sale of stock to officers or directors before the cash payment is received.

tlabel: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.

tlabel: Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

tlabel: Receivables from Clearing Organizations
doc: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with clearing organizations. Clearing organizations perform post trade processing and trade comparisons among numerous broker-dealers and act as settlement agents between buying and selling broker-dealers.

tlabel: Receivables from Customers
doc: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale
doc: Amount, before valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale.

tlabel: Receivables, Net, Current
doc: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

tlabel: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
doc: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

tlabel: Recovery of Direct Costs
doc: Return of or reimbursements received in relation to direct costs and expenses previously paid or incurred.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Fair Value
doc: The fair value as of the reporting date of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Redemption Value
doc: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for common shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Fair Value
doc: The aggregate fair value as of the reporting date of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.
