tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Carrying Amount
doc: Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity and classified as other equity.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Redemption Value
doc: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for preferred shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Redemption Value
doc: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

tlabel: Redemption Premium
doc: The excess of the (1) fair value of consideration transferred to the holders of a security in excess of (2) the carrying amount of the security reported on the registrant's balance sheet, which will be deducted from net earnings to derive net earnings available to common shareholders. This amount is generally an adjustment considered in the computation of earnings per share.

tlabel: Refundable Gas Costs
doc: Gas costs of a regulated entity that are refundable through future rate adjustments. Such costs are a form of a regulatory liabilities and are expected to be refunded in less than one year through rate adjustments.

tlabel: Registration Payment Arrangement, Accrual Carrying Value
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability representing the obligation under the registration payment arrangement.

tlabel: Regulated and Unregulated Operating Revenue
doc: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Entity, Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue
doc: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Electric, Non-Nuclear
doc: The amount of regulated power revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Gas
doc: The amount of regulated gas operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Other
doc: The amount of regulated other operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Pipelines
doc: The amount of regulated pipeline operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulated Operating Revenue, Water
doc: The amount of regulated water operating revenues recognized during the period.

tlabel: Regulator Expenses, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
doc: Amount of fees or assessments to fund the operations of the regulator of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

tlabel: Regulatory Assets
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Regulatory Assets, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Such costs are capitalized if they meet both of the following criteria: a. It is probable that future revenue in an amount at least equal to the capitalized cost will result from inclusion of that cost in allowable costs for rate-making purposes. b. Based on available evidence, the future revenue will be provided to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost rather than to provide for expected levels of similar future costs. If the revenue will be provided through an automatic rate-adjustment clause, this criterion requires that the regulator's intent clearly be to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost.

tlabel: Regulatory Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are not expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle if longer.

tlabel: Regulatory Liabilities
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory liability as itemized in a table of regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Regulatory Liability, Current
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent
doc: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.

tlabel: Reimbursement from Limited Partnership Investment
doc: A payment from an investee, in which the investment basis has previously been reduced to zero. This amount reduces net cash used in operating activities.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed and Ceded
doc: Amount of recovery (expense) related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed and ceded.

tlabel: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Ceded
doc: Amount of reduction of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies ceded.

tlabel: Reinsurance, Loss on Uncollectible Accounts in Period, Amount
doc: Amount of the write-down or write-off of a receivable from a reinsurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Payable
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables, Incurred but Not Reported Claims
doc: Estimated amount after valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables, due from reinsurers for incurred claims not yet reported, and claims settlement expenses.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid and amounts expected for incurred losses and settlement expenses, which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable, Guarantee Benefit
doc: Sum of the amount of guaranteed minimum benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables, Including Reinsurance Premium Paid
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts including premium paid under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation allowance recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, policy benefits and policy reserves. Excludes premiums paid under reinsurance contracts.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid Claims and Claims Adjustments
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to and paid by the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

tlabel: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Gross
doc: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

tlabel: Reinsurance Retention Policy, Amount Retained
doc: Stated amount that is the upper retention limit per entity policy.

tlabel: Reinsurance Retention Policy, Excess Retention, Amount Reinsured
doc: Amount of risk reinsured in excess of stated retention per company policy.

tlabel: Related Parties Amount in Cost of Sales
doc: Amount included in cost of sales related to transactions with related parties incurred and recorded in the statement of operations for the period.

tlabel: Related Party Costs
doc: Direct costs arising from transactions with related parties who are not affiliates or joint Ventures. These costs are categorized as cost of goods sold.

tlabel: Related Party Deposit Liabilities
doc: Amount of deposits held by the entity for a related party (entity, shareholder, employee).

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Due from (to) Related Party, Current
doc: Receivables to be collected from (obligations owed to) related parties, net as of the balance sheet date within one year where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party
doc: Reflects the sum of all other revenue and income realized from sales and other transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party during the period.

tlabel: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
doc: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

tlabel: Rental Properties
doc: Carrying amount of income producing properties held for rental.

tlabel: Reorganization Items
doc: Total amount of reorganization items.

tlabel: Repayments of Accounts Receivable Securitization
doc: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

tlabel: Repayments of Advances for Construction
doc: The cash outflow for the payments made by the entity, generally on a straight-line basis over periods ranging from five to forty years to developers, builders, government agencies and municipalities for borrowings received in construction.

tlabel: Repayments of Annuities and Investment Certificates
doc: The cash outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

tlabel: Repayments of Assumed Debt
doc: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

tlabel: Repayments of Bank Debt
doc: The cash outflow to settle a bank borrowing during the year.

tlabel: Repayments of Construction Loans Payable
doc: The cash outflow from repayment of borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.

tlabel: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Repayments of First Mortgage Bond
doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument issued, secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
doc: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

tlabel: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
doc: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
doc: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Long-term Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Pollution Control Bond
doc: The cash outflow from settlement of a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

tlabel: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

tlabel: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

tlabel: Repayments of Subordinated Short-term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

tlabel: Replacement Reserve Escrow
doc: This element represents those amounts set aside for the repair and replacement of real or personal property in the foreseen future. Such amount may be funded from sales revenue (for example; timeshare sales) or operating revenues; in a lump sum or installments (such as monthly); as per internal policy (for example: hotel operators), as required by contractual agreement (for example: sales contract); or by the terms of debt agreements.

tlabel: Repurchase Agreements, Interest Expense Amount
doc: This is the amount of interest expense incurred during the reporting period as a result of repurchase agreements.

tlabel: Research and Development Arrangement, Contract to Perform for Others, Compensation Earned
doc: The amount of compensation earned (contract income) under a research and development arrangement accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.

tlabel: Research and Development Arrangement, Contract to Perform for Others, Costs Incurred, Gross
doc: The amount of costs incurred under a research and development arrangement accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.

tlabel: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Written-off
doc: The amount of the write-off for research and development assets that were acquired in a transaction other than a business combination.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
doc: The costs incurred in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, excluding in-process research and development acquired in a business combination consummated during the period. Excludes software research and development, which has a separate concept.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
doc: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

tlabel: Research and Development in Process
doc: The amount of purchased research and development assets that are acquired in a business combination have no alternative future use and are therefore written off in the period of acquisition.

tlabel: Restatement of Prior Year Income, Gross (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Resulting effect of restatement to correct an error, before tax effects, on the net income of prior periods for the year in which any adjustments are first made. In statements containing more than one period, discloses the effects for each period.

tlabel: Restricted Cash
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Investments
doc: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
doc: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

tlabel: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

tlabel: Restricted Cash Equivalents
doc: Amount of cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Current
doc: Amount of cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

tlabel: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

tlabel: Restricted Investments
doc: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

tlabel: Restricted Investments, at Fair Value
doc: The aggregate value of all restricted investments.

tlabel: Restricted Investments, Current
doc: This element represents the current portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Restricted Investments, Noncurrent
doc: This element represents the noncurrent portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
doc: The total value of forfeitures related to restricted stock awards forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures, Dividends
doc: The value of dividends forfeited related to restricted stock awards forfeited.

tlabel: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
doc: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings
doc: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

tlabel: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
doc: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost
doc: Amount expected to be recognized in earnings for the specified restructuring cost.

tlabel: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost
doc: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.

tlabel: Restructuring Charges
doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring Costs
doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve
doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan.

tlabel: Restructuring and Related Cost, Accelerated Depreciation
doc: Amount of accelerated depreciation charged against earnings associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring plan.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated obligations associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid in the next twelve months or in the normal operating cycle if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated costs associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the next operating cycle, if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash
doc: Amount of decrease in the reserve for full or partial settlement through consideration other than cash.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the restructuring reserve.

tlabel: Restructuring Reserve, Translation and Other Adjustment
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the restructuring reserve related to foreign currency translation (gain) loss and other increases (decreases).

tlabel: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
doc: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Accretion of Asset Retirement Obligations
doc: Accretion expense of asset retirement obligations related to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization and Accretion
doc: Depreciation, depletion, amortization, and accretion related to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, and Valuation Provisions
doc: Depreciation, depletion and amortization, and valuation provisions (impairments) related to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Dry Hole Costs
doc: Dry hole costs from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Expense from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: The amount of expenses related to oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Expense, Other
doc: Other costs for oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, General and Administrative Related to Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: General and administrative costs from oil & gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
doc: Costs related to the impairment of oil and gas properties.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Income before Income Taxes
doc: Income before income taxes for oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Oil and Gas Producing Activities Net Income (Excluding Corporate Overhead and Interest Costs)
doc: The results of operations for oil and gas producing activities, excluding corporate overhead and interest costs.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Production or Lifting Costs
doc: Production (lifting) costs from oil and gas producing activities, including but not limited to lease operating expense, production and ad valorem taxes, and transportation expense.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Revenue from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
doc: Total revenues from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Revenue, Other
doc: Other revenues from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Sales Revenue to Unaffiliated Enterprises
doc: Sales revenue to unaffiliated enterprises from oil and gas producing activities.

tlabel: Results of Operations, Transportation Costs
doc: Includes the cost to prepare and move liquid hydrocarbons and natural gas to their points of sale.

tlabel: Retail Related Inventory
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

tlabel: Retail Related Inventory, Merchandise
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise inventory purchased by a retailer, wholesaler or distributor and held for future sale.

tlabel: Retainage Deposit
doc: The amount of assets, typically cash, provided to suppliers of goods in advance of receipt and acceptance, or services (such as research facilities, lawyers or consultants), which is held by such parties until the entity either effects full payment (including applying the retainer) or obtains release from liability.

tlabel: Retained Earnings, Appropriated
doc: A segregation of retained earnings which is unavailable for dividend distribution. Includes also retained earnings appropriated for loss contingencies.

tlabel: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
doc: A segregation of retained earnings which is available for dividend distribution. Earnings not paid out as dividends but instead reinvested in the core business or used to pay off debt. Unappropriated profit is part of shareholder equity. Also called cumulative distributions or earned surplus or accumulated earnings or unappropriated profit.

tlabel: Retained Patronage Allocations
doc: Amount of patronage earnings retained within the agricultural cooperative.

tlabel: Revenue from Collaborative Arrangement, Excluding Revenue from Contract with Customer
doc: Amount of revenue from collaborative arrangement. Excludes revenue from contract with customer under Topic 606.

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

tlabel: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
doc: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

tlabel: Revenues, Excluding Interest and Dividends
doc: Revenues from operations, excluding interest and dividend income. Includes revenues from the following sources: investment banking (underwriting and financial advisory), principal transactions (sales and trading, and investment gains and losses), commissions, asset management, and investment advisory and other services.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

tlabel: Royalty Income, Nonoperating
doc: Ancillary revenue earned during the period from the consideration paid to the entity for the use of its rights and property by another party. Examples include licensing the use of copyrighted materials and leasing the extraction of natural resources.

tlabel: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Accumulated Depreciation
doc: The accumulated depreciation and amortization related to the asset(s) sold in connection with the property sold to another party and leased back to the seller.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Amount Due under Financing Arrangement
doc: The liability due as of the balance sheet date for leasebacks accounted for using the deposit method.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Current Period Gain Recognized
doc: The portion of the deferred gain that was recognized in the current period.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Net
doc: The portion of the gain that will be recorded as income or a reduction in rent expense in future periods less amounts recognized in the current period.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Book Value
doc: The net book value of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and lease back to the seller.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Quarterly Rental Payments
doc: The amount of the quarterly rental payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transactions involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

tlabel: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Transaction Costs, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for transaction costs in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, closing and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received on Transaction
doc: Cash received on stock transaction after deduction of issuance costs.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received Per Transaction
doc: Amount of consideration received by subsidiary or equity investee in exchange for shares of stock issued or sold. Includes amount of cash received, fair value of noncash assets received, and fair value of liabilities assumed by the investor.

tlabel: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
doc: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

tlabel: Sales and Excise Tax Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Sales and Excise Tax Payable
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax.

tlabel: Sales Revenue, Goods, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
doc: Aggregate revenue during the period from the sale of goods in the normal course of business, after deducting returns, allowances and discounts.

tlabel: Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
doc: Total revenue from sale of goods and services rendered during the reporting period, in the normal course of business, reduced by sales returns and allowances, and sales discounts.

tlabel: Sales Revenue, Services, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
doc: Aggregate revenue during the period from services rendered in the normal course of business, after deducting allowances and discounts.

tlabel: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Interest Income
doc: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

tlabel: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Profit (Loss)
doc: Amount of profit (loss) for sales-type lease and (loss) for direct financing lease recognized at commencement.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
doc: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Lease Receivable
doc: Amount of interest income from lease receivable of sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Lease Receivable
doc: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease
doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

tlabel: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)
doc: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.

tlabel: Salvage and Subrogation Recoveries, Value
doc: The estimated amount as of the balance sheet date to be received by an insurer from the sale of property (usually damaged) on which the insurer has paid a total claim to the insured and has obtained title to the property and the right of an insurer to pursue any course of recovery of damages, in its name or in the name of the policyholder, against a third party who is liable for costs relating to an insured event that have been paid by the insurer. Estimated salvage and subrogation is generally deducted from the liability for unpaid claims.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property, Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Current Year Claim and Claim Adjustment Expense
doc: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of expense for claim incurred in current reporting period and related claim settlement cost for property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property, Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Prior Year Claim and Claim Adjustment Expense
doc: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claim incurred in prior reporting period and related claim settlement cost for property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount
doc: Amount of write-down or reserve recognized in the income statement on real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

tlabel: Secured Debt, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, collateralized debt obligations due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer. Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

tlabel: Secured Debt, Other
doc: Amount of collateralized debt obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Secured Debt, Repurchase Agreements
doc: Carrying value, as of the balance sheet date, of securities sold under agreements to repurchase where the transferor maintains effective control over the assets, accounting for them as secured debt.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of securities borrowed from other entities.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value of Collateral
doc: Fair value of the securities received as collateral against securities borrowed.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed, Gross
doc: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Securities for Reverse Repurchase Agreements
doc: The carrying value of securities purchased to be resold in reverse repurchase transactions as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Securities Held as Collateral, at Fair Value
doc: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of securities held that had been pledged by counterparties under financing and lending arrangements, pursuant to which the entity has the right by agreement or custom to sell or re-pledge such securities.

tlabel: Securities Loaned
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Loaned, Gross
doc: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Liability
doc: Amount of liability associated with funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

tlabel: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
doc: Amount of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

tlabel: Securities Received as Collateral
doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

tlabel: Securities Reserve Deposit Required and Made
doc: Securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

tlabel: Securities Segregated under Other Regulations
doc: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

tlabel: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale
doc: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

tlabel: Continuing Involvement with Continued to be Recognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
doc: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position. Includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

tlabel: Securitized Regulatory Transition Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value of the regulatory asset that represents capitalized stranded costs that have been securitized (financed with debt) and are expected to be recoverable through a transition charge after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer). A transition charge is a charge approved by a regulator that allows deregulated utilities to recover investments in certain assets, such as power plants, over a transition period leading into a deregulated market.

tlabel: Security Deposit Liability
doc: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

tlabel: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value and pledged to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions.

tlabel: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Owned
doc: Fair value of financial instruments held by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes determined by management based upon quoted prices of a financial instrument with similar characteristics or on a valuation technique or model.

tlabel: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Sold, Not yet Purchased
doc: Fair value of financial instruments sold short by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes determined by management based upon quoted prices of a financial instrument with similar characteristics or on a valuation technique or model.

tlabel: Self Insurance Reserve
doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

tlabel: Self Insurance Reserve, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

tlabel: Separate Account Asset
doc: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

tlabel: Separate Account, Liability
doc: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

tlabel: Servicing Asset
doc: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost
doc: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Amortization
doc: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Amount
doc: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Increase (Decrease) for Valuation Allowance Adjustment
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the amortized amount from a decrease (increase) in the valuation allowance applied to the servicing asset for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Additions
doc: The value of new servicing assets, subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through purchases or from transfers of financial assets.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount
doc: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs used to calculate the fair value of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

tlabel: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) in the fair value of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value.

tlabel: Servicing Liability
doc: Aggregate amount of servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

tlabel: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Balance
doc: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

tlabel: Settlement Assets, Current
doc: Cash received or short term receivables for unsettled money transfers, money orders, consumer payments, or business to business payments. Settlement assets include clearing and settling customers payments due to and from financial institutions and may include cash and cash equivalents.

tlabel: Severance Costs
doc: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
doc: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount
doc: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid
doc: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
doc: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other
doc: Other increase (decrease) in number of shares reserved for issuance under non-option equity instrument agreements that is not separately disclosed.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase or decrease in number of shares reserved for issuance under stock option agreements awarded under the plan that validly exist and are outstanding, including vested options.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of options vested. Excludes equity instruments other than options, for example, but not limited to, share units, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Plan Modification, Incremental Cost
doc: An excess of the fair value of the modified award over the fair value of the award immediately before the modification.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Issued in Period
doc: Number of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Purchased for Award
doc: Number of shares purchased for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Quantity of Securities Issued
doc: The number of shares or units of entity securities issued in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

tlabel: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Stockholders' Equity
doc: The amount by which stockholders' equity was increased by the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

tlabel: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Allocated
doc: Number of allocated shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Allocated shares are shares that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula.

tlabel: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Committed-to-be-Released
doc: Number of committed-to-be-released shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Committed-to-be-released shares are shares that will be released in the future and will be allocated to employees for services rendered in an accounting period. These shares are legally released from suspense and from serving as collateral for ESOP debt as a result of payment of debt service.

tlabel: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Withheld for Tax Withholding Obligation
doc: Number of shares used to settle grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount
doc: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Current
doc: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable within one year of the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
doc: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Maximum Amount
doc: The maximum amount that the issuer could be required to pay to redeem the instrument by physical settlement, if applicable.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Number of Shares
doc: The number of shares that would be issued, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the settlement were to occur at the reporting date.

tlabel: Short-term Debt, Fair Value
doc: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Short-term Lease Commitment, Amount
doc: Amount of short-term lease commitment.

tlabel: Short-term Lease Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term lease payment excluded from lease liability.

tlabel: Special Assessment Bond, Noncurrent
doc: The noncurrent portion of the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of a type of municipal bond typically used to fund a development project. Also called special assessment limited liability bond, special district bond, special purpose bond, special tax bond and community development obligation. Interest owed to lenders is paid by taxes levied on the community benefiting from the particular bond-funded project. For example, if a bond of this sort was issued to pay for sidewalks to be repaved in a certain community, an additional tax would be levied on homeowners in the area benefiting from this project.

tlabel: Spent Nuclear Fuel Obligation, Noncurrent
doc: Provision for the disposal costs of spent nuclear fuel from generating stations.

tlabel: Sponsor Fees
doc: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.

tlabel: Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Accretion of Discount
doc: Amount of accretion of discount for the standardized measure of discounted future net cash flow related to proved oil and gas reserves.

tlabel: Standard Product Warranty Accrual
doc: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

tlabel: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Current
doc: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

tlabel: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
doc: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

tlabel: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

tlabel: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Amount Available for Dividend Payments with Regulatory Approval
doc: Amount of dividends that can be declared or paid with approval of regulatory agency.

tlabel: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Capital and Surplus, Balance
doc: The amount of statutory capital and surplus (stockholders' equity) as of the balance sheet date using prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practices (rather than GAAP, if different) of the state or country.

tlabel: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Net Income Amount
doc: Amount of net income for the period determined using accounting principles prescribed or permitted by insurance regulators.

tlabel: Stock Dividends, Shares
doc: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of stockholders' equity including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interests, after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
doc: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
doc: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
doc: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan
doc: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
doc: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
doc: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
doc: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
doc: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
doc: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
doc: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
doc: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

tlabel: Stock Issued, Value, Stock Options Exercised, Net of Tax Benefit (Expense)
doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options, after deduction of related income tax (expense) benefit.

tlabel: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, (Increase) Decrease in Equity, Amount
doc: Amount of (increase) decrease in equity for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes stock option granted for share-based compensation.

tlabel: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
doc: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

tlabel: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

tlabel: Stock Repurchase Program, Authorized Amount
doc: Amount of stock repurchase plan authorized.

tlabel: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount
doc: Amount remaining of a stock repurchase plan authorized.

tlabel: Storm Damage Provision
doc: A noncash adjustment to the provision established for storm damage by an oil, gas, or utility company.

tlabel: Straight Line Rent
doc: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

tlabel: Straight Line Rent Adjustments
doc: Amount of the adjustment to rental revenues to measure escalating leasing revenues on a straight line basis.

tlabel: Subadvisory Fees for Mutual Funds
doc: Subadvisory fees that the funds adviser pays for out of the management fee, which it receives from the fund.

tlabel: Sublease Income
doc: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

tlabel: Subordinated Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of collateralized/uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind the primary lender of the company.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-15, Insurance Companies, Summary of Investments, Other than Investments in Related Parties, Cost
doc: Cost of investment held by insurance company, excluding investment in related party.

tlabel: Supplemental Deferred Purchase Price
doc: A device of credit enhancement where a part of the purchase price for the receivable/ payable is retained to serve as a cash collateral.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
doc: Amount of amortization expense on deferred policy acquisition cost for property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
doc: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost related to property-casualty insurance policy written.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Earned Premium
doc: Amount of premium revenue earned by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Net Investment Income
doc: Amount of net investment income earned by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Paid Claim and Claim Adjustment Expense
doc: Amount of loss reported and paid for claim and claim adjustment expense by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Premium Written
doc: Amount of premium written by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Reserve for Unpaid Claim and Claim Adjustment Expense
doc: Amount of reserve, policy claim payable and loss expense incurred by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Unearned Premium
doc: Amount of premium written but not yet earned by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

tlabel: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Salary Continuation
doc: Liability for agreement to continue an employee's salary after termination of employment (but before retirement) including death, disability, or other event. For example, a company may agree to continue a disabled employee's salary for six months.

tlabel: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Severance Benefits
doc: Liability for amount due employees, in addition to wages and any other money that employers owe employees, when their employment ends through a layoff or other termination. For example, a company may provide involuntarily terminated employees with a lump sum payment equal to one week's salary for every year of employment.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Loss, Claim and Loss Expense
doc: Amount of reserve for future policy claim payable and loss expense to be incurred, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

tlabel: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Premium Revenue
doc: Amount of premium revenue earned, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

tlabel: Prepaid Supplies
doc: Amount of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Supplies and Postage Expense
doc: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

tlabel: Supplies Expense
doc: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

tlabel: Surplus Notes
doc: Financial instruments issued by insurance entities (surplus notes) that are includable in surplus for statutory accounting purposes as prescribed or permitted by state laws and regulations that are liabilities of the issuer.

tlabel: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges
doc: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

tlabel: Tax Basis of Investments, Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net
doc: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in investment from unrealized gain (loss) when value exceeds (is less than) cost for federal income tax purpose.

tlabel: Tax Credit Carryforward, Amount
doc: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Income Tax Expense
doc: Amount of income tax expense for remeasurement of deferred tax asset from change in tax rate pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for remeasurement of deferred tax from change in tax rate pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from effect of Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of reasonable estimate for income tax expense for which accounting for tax effect for remeasurement of deferred tax asset from change in tax rate is incomplete pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of reasonable estimate for income tax expense (benefit) for which accounting for tax effect for remeasurement of deferred tax from change in tax rate is incomplete pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of reasonable estimate for income tax expense (benefit) for which accounting for tax effect is incomplete pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of reasonable estimate for income tax expense for which accounting for tax effect from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated is incomplete pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Provisional Liability, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
doc: Amount of reasonable estimate for tax liability for which accounting for tax effect from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated is incomplete pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Measurement Period Adjustment, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for measurement period adjustment from accounting for tax effect pursuant to Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

tlabel: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Reclassification from AOCI to Retained Earnings, Tax Effect
