doc: Adjustments for income tax expense to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deferred income
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deferred income to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Deferred income; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deposits from banks
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deposits from banks to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Deposits from banks; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deposits from customers
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in deposits from customers to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Deposits from customers; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in derivative financial liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in derivative financial liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Derivative financial liabilities; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in employee benefit liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in employee benefit liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in financial liabilities held for trading
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in financial liabilities held for trading to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Financial liabilities; Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that meet definition of held for trading; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in insurance, reinsurance and investment contract liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in insurance, reinsurance and investment contract liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Investment contracts liabilities; Liabilities under insurance contracts and reinsurance contracts issued; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other current liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other current liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Other current liabilities; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other liabilities
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other liabilities to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Other liabilities; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other operating payables
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in other operating payables to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in repurchase agreements and cash collateral on securities lent
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in repurchase agreements and cash collateral on securities lent to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Repurchase agreements and cash collateral on securities lent; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade accounts payable
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade accounts payable to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade and other payables
doc: Adjustments for increase (decrease) in trade and other payables to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Trade and other payables; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for increase in other provisions arising from passage of time
doc: Adjustments for increases in other provisions arising from the passage of time to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss); Other provisions [member]]

tlabel: Adjustments for interest expense
doc: Adjustments for interest expense to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Interest expense; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for interest income
doc: Adjustments for interest income expense to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Interest income; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for losses (gains) on disposal of non-current assets
doc: Adjustments for losses (gains) on disposal of non-current assets to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Non-current assets; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for provisions
doc: Adjustments for provisions to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Provisions; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments to reconcile profit (loss)
doc: Adjustments to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for share-based payments
doc: Adjustments for share-based payments to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for undistributed profits of associates
doc: Adjustments for undistributed profits of associates to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Associates [member]; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for undistributed profits of investments accounted for using equity method
doc: Adjustments for undistributed profits of investments accounted for using the equity method to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Investments accounted for using equity method; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments for unrealised foreign exchange losses (gains)
doc: Adjustments for unrealised foreign exchange losses (gains) to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustments to reconcile profit (loss) other than changes in working capital
doc: Adjustments, other than changes in working capital, to reconcile profit (loss) to net cash flow from (used in) operating activities. [Refer: Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Adjustment to profit (loss) for preference share dividends
doc: Adjustment to profit (loss) for preference share dividends to calculate profit (loss) attributable to ordinary equity holders of the parent entity. [Refer: Preference shares [member]; Profit (loss)]

tlabel: Administrative expenses
doc: The amount of expenses that the entity classifies as being administrative.

tlabel: Advertising expense
doc: The amount of expense arising from advertising.

tlabel: Allowance account for credit losses of financial assets
doc: The amount of an allowance account used to record impairments to financial assets due to credit losses. [Refer: Financial assets]

tlabel: Amortisation expense
doc: The amount of amortisation expense. Amortisation is the systematic allocation of depreciable amounts of intangible assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Amortisation, intangible assets other than goodwill
doc: The amount of amortisation of intangible assets other than goodwill. [Refer: Depreciation and amortisation expense; Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Amount of reclassifications or changes in presentation
doc: The amount that is reclassified when the entity changes classification or presentation in its financial statements.

tlabel: Amount removed from reserve of cash flow hedges and included in initial cost or other carrying amount of non-financial asset (liability) or firm commitment for which fair value hedge accounting is applied
doc: The amount removed from reserve of cash flow hedges and included in the initial cost or other carrying amount of a non-financial asset (liability) or a firm commitment for which fair value hedge accounting is applied. [Refer: Reserve of cash flow hedges]

tlabel: Amount removed from reserve of change in value of foreign currency basis spreads and included in initial cost or other carrying amount of non-financial asset (liability) or firm commitment for which fair value hedge accounting is applied
doc: The amount removed from reserve of change in value of foreign currency basis spreads and included in the initial cost or other carrying amount of a non-financial asset (liability) or a firm commitment for which fair value hedge accounting is applied. [Refer: Reserve of change in value of foreign currency basis spreads]

tlabel: Amounts payable, related party transactions
doc: The amounts payable resulting from related party transactions. [Refer: Related parties [member]]

tlabel: Amounts receivable, related party transactions
doc: The amounts receivable resulting from related party transactions. [Refer: Related parties [member]]

tlabel: Amounts removed from equity and included in carrying amount of non-financial asset (liability) whose acquisition or incurrence was hedged highly probable forecast transaction, before tax
doc: The amounts removed from equity and included in the initial cost or other carrying amount of a non-financial asset (liability) whose acquisition or incurrence was a hedged, highly probable forecast transaction, before tax. [Refer: Carrying amount [member]]

tlabel: Assets
doc: Expiry date 2020-01-01: The amount of resources: (a) controlled by the entity as a result of past events; and (b) from which future economic benefits are expected to flow to the entity.Effective 2020-01-01: The amount of a present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events. Economic resource is a right that has the potential to produce economic benefits.

tlabel: Assets arising from exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources
doc: The amount of assets arising from the search for mineral resources, including minerals, oil, natural gas and similar non-regenerative resources after the entity has obtained legal rights to explore in a specific area, as well as the determination of the technical feasibility and commercial viability of extracting the mineral resource.

tlabel: Assets less current liabilities
doc: The amount of assets less the amount of current liabilities.

tlabel: Assets of benefit plan
doc: The amount of assets held by retirement benefit plans. [Refer: Defined benefit plans [member]]

tlabel: Assets under insurance contracts and reinsurance contracts issued
doc: The amount of assets under insurance contracts and reinsurance contracts issued. [Refer: Types of insurance contracts [member]]

tlabel: Assets under reinsurance ceded
doc: The amount of assets under reinsurance contracts in which the entity is the policyholder.

tlabel: Associated liabilities that entity continues to recognise
doc: The amount of liabilities associated with transferred financial assets that the entity continues to recognise in full. [Refer: Financial assets]

tlabel: Auditor's remuneration
doc: The amount of fees paid or payable to the entity's auditors.

tlabel: Auditor's remuneration for audit services
doc: The amount of fees paid or payable to the entity's auditors for auditing services.

tlabel: Average foreign exchange rate
doc: The average exchange rate used by the entity. Exchange rate is the ratio of exchange for two currencies.

tlabel: Balances with banks
doc: The amount of cash balances held at banks.

tlabel: Bank acceptance assets
doc: The amount of bank acceptances recognised as assets.

tlabel: Bank acceptance liabilities
doc: The amount of bank acceptances recognised as liabilities.

tlabel: Bank balances at central banks other than mandatory reserve deposits
doc: The amount of bank balances held at central banks other than mandatory reserve deposits. [Refer: Mandatory reserve deposits at central banks]

tlabel: Bank overdrafts
doc: The amount that has been withdrawn from an account in excess of existing cash balances. This is considered a short-term extension of credit by the bank. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share
doc: The amount of earnings per share when the basic and diluted measurements are equal. [Refer: Basic earnings (loss) per share; Diluted earnings (loss) per share]

tlabel: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations
doc: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations. [Refer: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share]

tlabel: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations
doc: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations. [Refer: Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share]

tlabel: Basic earnings (loss) per share
doc: The amount of profit (loss) attributable to ordinary equity holders of the parent entity (the numerator) divided by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the period (the denominator).

tlabel: Basic earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations
doc: Basic earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations. [Refer: Basic earnings (loss) per share; Continuing operations [member]]

tlabel: Basic earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations
doc: Basic earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations. [Refer: Basic earnings (loss) per share; Discontinued operations [member]]

tlabel: Biological assets
doc: The amount of living animals or plants recognised as assets.

tlabel: Borrowing costs capitalised
doc: The amount of interest and other costs that an entity incurs in connection with the borrowing of funds that are directly attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of a qualifying asset and which form part of the cost of that asset.

tlabel: Borrowing costs recognised as expense
doc: The amount of interest and other costs that an entity incurs in connection with the borrowing of funds that are recognised as an expense.

tlabel: Borrowings
doc: The amount of outstanding funds that the entity is obligated to repay.

tlabel: Borrowings, interest rate
doc: The interest rate on borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Brokerage fee expense
doc: The amount of expense recognised for brokerage fees charged to the entity.

tlabel: Brokerage fee income
doc: The amount of income recognised for brokerage fees charged by the entity.

tlabel: Cancellation of treasury shares
doc: The amount of treasury stock cancelled during the period. [Refer: Treasury shares]

tlabel: Capital commitments
doc: The amount of future capital expenditures that the entity is committed to make.

tlabel: Capital redemption reserve
doc: A component of equity representing the reserve for the redemption of the entity's own shares.

tlabel: Capital reserve
doc: A component of equity representing the capital reserves.

tlabel: Cash
doc: The amount of cash on hand and demand deposits. [Refer: Cash on hand]

tlabel: Cash advances and loans from related parties
doc: The cash inflow from advances and loans from related parties. [Refer: Related parties [member]; Advances received]

tlabel: Cash advances and loans made to other parties, classified as investing activities
doc: The amount of cash advances and loans made to other parties (other than advances and loans made by a financial institution), classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Cash advances and loans made to related parties
doc: The cash outflow for loans and advances made to related parties. [Refer: Related parties [member]]

tlabel: Cash and bank balances at central banks
doc: The amount of cash and bank balances held at central banks.

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents
doc: The amount of cash on hand and demand deposits, along with short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and that are subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value. [Refer: Cash; Cash equivalents]

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents classified as part of disposal group held for sale
doc: The amount of cash and cash equivalents that are classified as a part of a disposal group held for sale. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents; Disposal groups classified as held for sale [member]]

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents if different from statement of financial position
doc: The amount of cash and cash equivalents in the statement of cash flows when different from the amount of cash and cash equivalents in the statement of financial position. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents in subsidiary or businesses acquired or disposed
doc: The amount of cash and cash equivalents in subsidiaries or other businesses over which control is obtained or lost. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]; Cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents recognised as of acquisition date
doc: The amount recognised as of the acquisition date for cash and cash equivalents acquired in a business combination. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents; Business combinations [member]]

tlabel: Cash equivalents
doc: The amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and that are subject to an insignificant risk of changes in value.

tlabel: Cash flows from losing control of subsidiaries or other businesses, classified as investing activities
doc: The aggregate cash flows arising from losing control of subsidiaries or other businesses, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) decrease (increase) in restricted cash and cash equivalents
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) due to a decrease (increase) in restricted cash and cash equivalents. [Refer: Restricted cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) decrease (increase) in short-term deposits and investments
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) due to a decrease (increase) in short-term deposits and investments.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the search for mineral resources, including minerals, oil, natural gas and similar non-regenerative resources after the entity has obtained legal rights to explore in a specific area, as well as the determination of the technical feasibility and commercial viability of extracting the mineral resource, classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) financing activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) financing activities, which are activities that result in changes in the size and composition of the contributed equity and borrowings of the entity.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) financing activities, continuing operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's financing activities, related to continuing operations. [Refer: Continuing operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) financing activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) financing activities, discontinued operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's financing activities, related to discontinued operations. [Refer: Discontinued operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) financing activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) increase (decrease) in current borrowings
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) due to an increase (decrease) in current borrowings. [Refer: Current borrowings]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) investing activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) investing activities, which are the acquisition and disposal of long-term assets and other investments not included in cash equivalents.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) investing activities, continuing operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's investing activities, related to continuing operations. [Refer: Continuing operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) investing activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) investing activities, discontinued operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's investing activities, related to discontinued operations. [Refer: Discontinued operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) investing activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operating activities
doc: The cash flows from (used in) operating activities, which are the principal revenue-producing activities of the entity and other activities that are not investing or financing activities. [Refer: Revenue]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operating activities, continuing operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's operating activities, related to continuing operations. [Refer: Continuing operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) operating activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operating activities, discontinued operations
doc: The cash flows from (used in) the entity's operating activities, related to discontinued operations. [Refer: Discontinued operations [member]; Cash flows from (used in) operating activities]

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operations
doc: The cash from (used in) the entity's operations.

tlabel: Cash flows from (used in) operations before changes in working capital
doc: The cash inflow (outflow) from the entity's operations before changes in working capital.

tlabel: Cash flows used in exploration and development activities
doc: The cash outflow for exploration and development activities.

tlabel: Cash flows used in obtaining control of subsidiaries or other businesses, classified as investing activities
doc: The aggregate cash flows used in obtaining control of subsidiaries or other businesses, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Cash on hand
doc: The amount of cash held by the entity. This does not include demand deposits.

tlabel: Cash outflow for leases
doc: The cash outflow for leases.

tlabel: Cash payments for futures contracts, forward contracts, option contracts and swap contracts, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash outflow for futures contracts, forward contracts, option contracts and swap contracts except when the contracts are held for dealing or trading purposes or the payments are classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Cash receipts from futures contracts, forward contracts, option contracts and swap contracts, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from futures contracts, forward contracts, option contracts and swap contracts except when the contracts are held for dealing or trading purposes or the receipts are classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Cash receipts from repayment of advances and loans made to other parties, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from the repayment of advances and loans made to other parties (other than advances and loans of a financial institution), classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Cash receipts from repayment of advances and loans made to related parties
doc: The cash inflow from repayment to the entity of loans and advances made to related parties. [Refer: Related parties [member]]

tlabel: Cash repayments of advances and loans from related parties
doc: The cash outflow for repayments of advances and loans from related parties. [Refer: Related parties [member]; Advances received]

tlabel: Cash transferred
doc: The fair value, at acquisition date, of cash transferred as consideration in a business combination. [Refer: Business combinations [member]]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) in equity
doc: The increase (decrease) in equity. [Refer: Equity]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) in fair value of credit derivatives or similar instruments related to financial assets designated as measured at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The increase (decrease) in the fair value of credit derivatives or similar instruments related to financial assets designated as measured at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Derivatives [member]; Financial assets]

tlabel: Decrease (increase) in inventories of finished goods and work in progress
doc: The decrease (increase) in inventories of finished goods and work in progress. [Refer: Inventories; Current finished goods; Current work in progress]

tlabel: Increase (decrease) in other provisions
doc: The increase (decrease) in other provisions. [Refer: Other provisions]

tlabel: Claims and benefits paid, net of reinsurance recoveries
doc: The amount of claims and benefits paid to policyholders, net of reinsurance recoveries.

tlabel: Closing foreign exchange rate
doc: The spot exchange rate at the end of the reporting period. Exchange rate is the ratio of exchange for two currencies. Spot exchange rate is the exchange rate for immediate delivery.

tlabel: Communication expense
doc: The amount of expense arising from communication.

tlabel: Comprehensive income
doc: The amount of change in equity resulting from transactions and other events, other than those changes resulting from transactions with owners in their capacity as owners.

tlabel: Comprehensive income, attributable to non-controlling interests
doc: The amount of comprehensive income attributable to non-controlling interests. [Refer: Comprehensive income; Non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Comprehensive income, attributable to owners of parent
doc: The amount of comprehensive income attributable to owners of the parent. [Refer: Comprehensive income]

tlabel: Computer software
doc: The amount of intangible assets representing computer software. [Refer: Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Consideration paid (received)
doc: The amount of consideration paid or received in respect of both obtaining and losing control of subsidiaries or other businesses. [Refer: Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Construction in progress
doc: The amount of expenditure capitalised during the construction of non-current assets that are not yet available for use. [Refer: Non-current assets]

tlabel: Loans to consumers
doc: The amount of consumer loans made by the entity. [Refer: Loans to consumers [member]]

tlabel: Contingent liabilities recognised as of acquisition date
doc: The amount of contingent liabilities recognised as of the acquisition date in a business combination. [Refer: Contingent liabilities [member]; Business combinations [member]]

tlabel: Contingent liabilities recognised in business combination
doc: The amount of contingent liabilities recognised in a business combination. [Refer: Contingent liabilities [member]; Business combinations [member]]

tlabel: Contract assets
doc: The amount of an entitys right to consideration in exchange for goods or services that the entity has transferred to a customer, when that right is conditioned on something other than the passage of time (for example, the entitys future performance).

tlabel: Contract liabilities
doc: The amount of an entitys obligation to transfer goods or services to a customer for which the entity has received consideration (or the amount is due) from the customer.

tlabel: Contractual capital commitments
doc: The amount of capital commitments for which the entity has entered into a contract. [Refer: Capital commitments]

tlabel: Copyrights, patents and other industrial property rights, service and operating rights
doc: The amount of intangible assets representing copyrights, patents and other industrial property rights, service and operating rights. [Refer: Intangible assets other than goodwill]

tlabel: Loans to corporate entities
doc: The amount of corporate loans made by the entity. [Refer: Loans to corporate entities [member]]

tlabel: Cost of merchandise sold
doc: The amount of merchandise that was sold during the period and recognised as an expense.

tlabel: Cost of purchased energy sold
doc: The amount of purchased energy that was sold during the period and recognised as an expense.

tlabel: Cost of sales
doc: The amount of costs relating to expenses directly or indirectly attributed to the goods or services sold, which may include, but are not limited to, costs previously included in the measurement of inventory that has now been sold, unallocated production overheads and abnormal amounts of production costs of inventories.

tlabel: Credit-related fee and commission income
doc: The amount of income recognised from credit-related fees and commissions. [Refer: Fee and commission income]

tlabel: Current accrued expenses and other current liabilities
doc: The amount of current accrued expenses and other current liabilities. [Refer: Accruals; Other current liabilities]

tlabel: Current advances received
doc: The amount of current payments received for goods or services to be provided in the future. [Refer: Advances received]

tlabel: Current advances to suppliers
doc: The amount of current advances made to suppliers before goods or services are received.

tlabel: Current and deferred tax relating to items credited (charged) directly to equity
doc: The aggregate current and deferred tax relating to particular items that are charged or credited directly to equity, for example: (a) an adjustment to the opening balance of retained earnings resulting from either a change in accounting policy that is applied retrospectively or the correction of an error; and (b) amounts arising on initial recognition of the equity component of a compound financial instrument. [Refer: Deferred tax relating to items credited (charged) directly to equity; Retained earnings; Financial instruments, class [member]]

tlabel: Current assets
doc: The amount of assets that the entity (a) expects to realise or intends to sell or consume in its normal operating cycle; (b) holds primarily for the purpose of trading; (c) expects to realise within twelve months after the reporting period; or (d) classifies as cash or cash equivalents (as defined in IAS 7) unless the asset is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least twelve months after the reporting period. [Refer: Assets]

tlabel: Current assets (liabilities)
doc: The amount of current assets less the amount of current liabilities.

tlabel: Current assets other than non-current assets or disposal groups classified as held for sale or as held for distribution to owners
doc: The amount of current assets other than non-current assets or disposal groups classified as held for sale or as held for distribution to owners. [Refer: Current assets; Disposal groups classified as held for sale [member]; Non-current assets or disposal groups classified as held for sale; Non-current assets or disposal groups classified as held for distribution to owners]

tlabel: Current biological assets
doc: The amount of current biological assets. [Refer: Biological assets]

tlabel: Current bonds issued and current portion of non-current bonds issued
doc: The amount of current bonds issued and the current portion of non-current bonds issued. [Refer: Bonds issued]

tlabel: Current borrowings and current portion of non-current borrowings
doc: The amount of current borrowings and current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Current contract assets
doc: The amount of current contract assets. [Refer: Contract assets]

tlabel: Current contract liabilities
doc: The amount of current contract liabilities. [Refer: Contract liabilities]

tlabel: Current crude oil
doc: A classification of current inventory representing the amount of unrefined, unprocessed oil. [Refer: Inventories]

tlabel: Current debt instruments issued
doc: The amount of current debt instruments issued. [Refer: Debt instruments issued]

tlabel: Current deposits from customers
doc: The amount of current deposits from customers. [Refer: Deposits from customers]

tlabel: Current derivative financial assets
doc: The amount of current derivative financial assets. [Refer: Derivative financial assets]

tlabel: Current derivative financial liabilities
doc: The amount of current derivative financial liabilities. [Refer: Derivative financial liabilities]

tlabel: Current dividend payables
doc: The amount of current dividend payables. [Refer: Dividend payables]

tlabel: Current finance lease receivables
doc: The amount of current finance lease receivables. [Refer: Finance lease receivables]

tlabel: Current financial assets
doc: The amount of current financial assets. [Refer: Financial assets]

tlabel: Current financial assets at amortised cost
doc: The amount of current financial assets measured at amortised cost. [Refer: Financial assets at amortised cost]

tlabel: Current financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of current financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Current financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of current financial assets measured at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Current financial assets available-for-sale
doc: The amount of current financial assets available-for-sale. [Refer: Financial assets available-for-sale; Current financial assets]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities. [Refer: Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities at amortised cost
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities measured at amortised cost. [Refer: Financial liabilities at amortised cost]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities measured at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss, classified as held for trading
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that meet the definition of held for trading. [Refer: Current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Current financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently
doc: The amount of current financial liabilities measured at fair value through profit or loss that were designated as such upon initial recognition or subsequently. [Refer: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently]

tlabel: Current government grants
doc: The amount of current government grants recognised in the statement of financial position as deferred income. [Refer: Government [member]; Deferred income; Government grants]

tlabel: Current held-to-maturity investments
doc: The amount of current held-to-maturity investments. [Refer: Held-to-maturity investments]

tlabel: Current interest payable
doc: The amount of current interest payable. [Refer: Interest payable]

tlabel: Current investments
doc: The amount of current investments.

tlabel: Current lease liabilities
doc: The amount of current lease liabilities. [Refer: Lease liabilities]

tlabel: Current liabilities
doc: The amount of liabilities that: (a) the entity expects to settle in its normal operating cycle; (b) the entity holds primarily for the purpose of trading; (c) are due to be settled within twelve months after the reporting period; or (d) the entity does not have an unconditional right to defer settlement for at least twelve months after the reporting period.

tlabel: Current liabilities other than liabilities included in disposal groups classified as held for sale
doc: The amount of current liabilities other than liabilities included in disposal groups classified as held for sale. [Refer: Current liabilities; Disposal groups classified as held for sale [member]; Liabilities included in disposal groups classified as held for sale]

tlabel: Current loans and receivables
doc: The amount of current loans and receivables. [Refer: Loans and receivables]

tlabel: Current notes and debentures issued and current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued
doc: The amount of current notes and debentures issued and the current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued. [Refer: Notes and debentures issued]

tlabel: Current payables on social security and taxes other than income tax
doc: The amount of current payables on social security and taxes other than incomes tax. [Refer: Payables on social security and taxes other than income tax]

tlabel: Current portion of non-current borrowings
doc: The current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

tlabel: Current prepaid expenses
doc: The amount recognised as a current asset for expenditures made prior to the period when the economic benefit will be realised.

tlabel: Current prepayments
doc: The amount of current prepayments. [Refer: Prepayments]

tlabel: Current prepayments and current accrued income
doc: The amount of current prepayments and current accrued income. [Refer: Prepayments; Accrued income]

tlabel: Current prepayments and other current assets
doc: The amount of current prepayments and other current assets. [Refer: Other current assets; Current prepayments]

tlabel: Current provisions
doc: The amount of current provisions. [Refer: Provisions]

tlabel: Current provisions for employee benefits
doc: The amount of current provisions for employee benefits. [Refer: Provisions for employee benefits]

tlabel: Current receivables from taxes other than income tax
doc: The amount of current receivables from taxes other than income tax. [Refer: Receivables from taxes other than income tax]

tlabel: Current net defined benefit liability
doc: The amount of current net defined benefit liability. [Refer: Net defined benefit liability]

tlabel: Current restricted cash and cash equivalents
doc: The amount of current restricted cash and cash equivalents. [Refer: Restricted cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Current tax assets
doc: The excess of amount paid for current tax in respect of current and prior periods over the amount due for those periods. Current tax is the amount of income taxes payable (recoverable) in respect of the taxable profit (tax loss) for a period.

tlabel: Current tax assets, current
doc: The current amount of current tax assets. [Refer: Current tax assets]

tlabel: Current tax assets, non-current
doc: The non-current amount of current tax assets. [Refer: Current tax assets]

tlabel: Current tax expense (income)
doc: The amount of income taxes payable (recoverable) in respect of the taxable profit (tax loss) for a period.

tlabel: Current tax expense (income) and adjustments for current tax of prior periods
doc: The amount of current tax expense (income) and adjustments for the current tax of prior periods. [Refer: Current tax expense (income); Adjustments for current tax of prior periods]

tlabel: Current tax liabilities
doc: The amount of current tax for current and prior periods to the extent unpaid. Current tax is the amount of income taxes payable (recoverable) in respect of the taxable profit (tax loss) for a period.

tlabel: Current tax liabilities, current
doc: The current amount of current tax liabilities. [Refer: Current tax liabilities]

tlabel: Current tax liabilities, non-current
doc: The non-current amount of current tax liabilities. [Refer: Current tax liabilities]

tlabel: Current trade receivables
doc: The amount of current trade receivables. [Refer: Trade receivables]

tlabel: Current value added tax receivables
doc: The amount of current value added tax receivables. [Refer: Value added tax receivables]

tlabel: Debt instruments held
doc: The amount of instruments representing indebtedness held by the entity.

tlabel: Debt instruments issued
doc: The amount of instruments issued by the entity that represent indebtedness.

tlabel: Decrease (increase) through tax on share-based payment transactions, equity
doc: The decrease (increase) in equity resulting from tax on transactions in which the entity: (a) receives goods or services from the supplier of those goods or services (including an employee) in a share-based payment arrangement; or (b) incurs an obligation to settle the transaction with the supplier in a share-based payment arrangement when another group entity receives those goods or services. [Refer: Share-based payment arrangements [member]]

tlabel: Deferred acquisition costs arising from insurance contracts
doc: The amount of costs that an insurer incurs to sell, underwrite and initiate a new insurance contract whose recognition as an expense has been deferred. [Refer: Types of insurance contracts [member]]

tlabel: Deferred income
doc: The amount of liability representing income that has been received but is not yet earned. [Refer: Revenue]

tlabel: Deferred income classified as current
doc: The amount of deferred income classified as current. [Refer: Deferred income]

tlabel: Deferred income classified as non-current
doc: The amount of deferred income classified as non-current. [Refer: Deferred income]

tlabel: Deferred tax assets
doc: The amounts of income taxes recoverable in future periods in respect of: (a) deductible temporary differences; (b) the carryforward of unused tax losses; and (c) the carryforward of unused tax credits. [Refer: Temporary differences [member]; Unused tax credits [member]; Unused tax losses [member]]

tlabel: Deferred tax expense (income)
doc: The amount of tax expense (income) relating to changes in deferred tax liabilities and deferred tax assets. [Refer: Deferred tax assets; Deferred tax liabilities]

tlabel: Deferred tax expense (income) recognised in profit or loss
doc: The amount of tax expense or income relating to changes in deferred tax liabilities and deferred tax assets, recognised in profit or loss. [Refer: Deferred tax assets; Deferred tax expense (income); Deferred tax liabilities]

tlabel: Deferred tax expense (income) relating to origination and reversal of temporary differences
doc: The amount of deferred tax expense or income relating to the creation or reversal of temporary differences. [Refer: Temporary differences [member]; Deferred tax expense (income)]

tlabel: Deferred tax liabilities
doc: The amounts of income taxes payable in future periods in respect of taxable temporary differences. [Refer: Temporary differences [member]]

tlabel: Deferred tax liability (asset)
doc: The amount of deferred tax liabilities or assets. [Refer: Deferred tax liabilities; Deferred tax assets]

tlabel: Deferred tax relating to items credited (charged) directly to equity
doc: The amount of deferred tax related to items credited (charged) directly to equity. [Refer: Deferred tax expense (income)]

tlabel: Deposits from banks
doc: The amount of deposit liabilities from banks held by the entity.

tlabel: Deposits from customers
doc: The amount of deposit liabilities from customers held by the entity.

tlabel: Depreciation, amortisation and impairment loss (reversal of impairment loss) recognised in profit or loss
doc: The amount of depreciation expense, amortisation expense and impairment loss (reversal of impairment loss) recognised in profit or loss. [Refer: Depreciation and amortisation expense; Impairment loss (reversal of impairment loss) recognised in profit or loss]

tlabel: Depreciation and amortisation expense
doc: The amount of depreciation and amortisation expense. Depreciation and amortisation are the systematic allocations of depreciable amounts of assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Depreciation expense
doc: The amount of depreciation expense. Depreciation is the systematic allocation of depreciable amounts of tangible assets over their useful lives.

tlabel: Depreciation, property, plant and equipment
doc: The amount of depreciation of property, plant and equipment. [Refer: Depreciation and amortisation expense; Property, plant and equipment]

tlabel: Depreciation, right-of-use assets
doc: The amount of depreciation of right-of-use assets. [Refer: Depreciation and amortisation expense; Right-of-use assets]

tlabel: Derivative financial assets
doc: The amount of financial assets classified as derivative instruments. [Refer: Financial assets; Derivatives [member]]

tlabel: Derivative financial assets held for hedging
doc: The amount of derivative financial assets held for hedging. [Refer: Derivative financial assets]

tlabel: Derivative financial assets held for trading
doc: The amount of derivative financial assets held for trading. [Refer: Derivative financial assets; Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, classified as held for trading]

tlabel: Derivative financial liabilities
doc: The amount of financial liabilities classified as derivative instruments. [Refer: Financial assets; Derivatives [member]]

tlabel: Derivative financial liabilities held for hedging
doc: The amount of derivative financial liabilities held for hedging. [Refer: Derivative financial liabilities]

tlabel: Derivative financial liabilities held for trading
doc: The amount of derivative financial liabilities held for trading. [Refer: Derivative financial liabilities; Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that meet definition of held for trading]

tlabel: Diluted earnings (loss) per share
doc: The amount of profit (loss) attributable to ordinary equity holders of the parent entity (the numerator), divided by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the period (the denominator), both adjusted for the effects of all dilutive potential ordinary shares. [Refer: Ordinary shares [member]; Weighted average [member]]

tlabel: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations
doc: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations. [Refer: Continuing operations [member]; Diluted earnings (loss) per share]

tlabel: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations, including net movement in regulatory deferral account balances and net movement in related deferred tax
doc: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from continuing operations that include the net movement in regulatory deferral account balances and the net movement in related deferred tax. [Refer: Diluted earnings (loss) per share; Net movement in regulatory deferral account balances related to profit or loss and net movement in related deferred tax; Continuing operations [member]]

tlabel: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations
doc: Diluted earnings (loss) per share from discontinued operations. [Refer: Diluted earnings (loss) per share; Discontinued operations [member]]

tlabel: Dilutive effect of convertible instruments on number of ordinary shares
doc: The number of dilutive potential ordinary shares that relate to the assumed conversion of the entity's convertible instruments.

tlabel: Dilutive effect of share options on number of ordinary shares
doc: The number of dilutive potential ordinary shares that relate to the assumed exercise of the entity's share options.

tlabel: Direct operating expense from investment property
doc: The amount of direct operating expenses (including repairs and maintenance) arising from investment property. [Refer: Investment property]

tlabel: Direct operating expense from investment property generating rental income
doc: The amount of direct operating expenses (including repairs and maintenance) arising from investment property that generated rental income during the period recognised in profit or loss. [Refer: Investment property]

tlabel: Directors' remuneration expense
doc: The amount of remuneration paid or payable to the entity's directors.

tlabel: Distribution costs
doc: The amount of costs relating to the distribution of goods and services.

tlabel: Dividend payables
doc: The amount of dividends that the company has declared but not yet paid.

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners
doc: The amount of dividends recognised as distributions to owners.

tlabel: Dividends paid, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for dividends paid by the entity, classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Dividends paid, classified as operating activities
doc: The cash outflow for dividends paid by the entity, classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Dividends paid, ordinary shares
doc: The amount of dividends paid by the entity on ordinary shares. [Refer: Ordinary shares [member]]

tlabel: Dividends paid, ordinary shares per share
doc: The amount of dividends paid per ordinary share.

tlabel: Dividends paid, other shares
doc: The amount of dividends paid by the entity on shares other than ordinary shares. [Refer: Ordinary shares [member]]

tlabel: Dividends paid to equity holders of parent, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for dividends paid to equity holders of the parent, classified as financing activities.

tlabel: Dividends paid to non-controlling interests
doc: The amount of dividends paid to non-controlling interests. [Refer: Non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Dividends paid to non-controlling interests, classified as financing activities
doc: The cash outflow for dividends paid to non-controlling interests, classified as financing activities. [Refer: Non-controlling interests; Dividends paid to non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Dividends payable, non-cash assets distributions
doc: The amount of dividends payable by means of the distribution of non-cash assets to owners.

tlabel: Dividends proposed or declared before financial statements authorised for issue but not recognised as distribution to owners per share
doc: The amount, per share, of dividends proposed or declared before financial statements were authorised for issue but not recognised as distribution to owners.

tlabel: Dividends received, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow from dividends received, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends received, classified as operating activities
doc: The cash inflow from dividends received, classified as operating activities. [Refer: Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends received from associates, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow representing dividends received from associates, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Associates [member]; Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends received from investments accounted for using equity method, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow representing dividends received from investments that are accounted for using the equity method, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Investments accounted for using equity method; Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends received from joint ventures, classified as investing activities
doc: The cash inflow representing dividends received from joint ventures, classified as investing activities. [Refer: Joint ventures [member]; Dividends received]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to non-controlling interests
doc: The amount of dividends recognised as distributions to non-controlling interests. [Refer: Non-controlling interests]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners of parent
doc: The amount of dividends recognised as distributions to owners of the parent. [Refer: Parent [member]]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners of parent, relating to current year
doc: The amount of dividends relating to the current year, recognised as distributions to owners of the parent. [Refer: Parent [member]]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners of parent, relating to prior years
doc: The amount of dividends relating to prior years, recognised as distributions to owners of the parent. [Refer: Parent [member]]

tlabel: Dividends recognised as distributions to owners per share
doc: The amount, per share, of dividends recognised as distributions to owners.

tlabel: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents
doc: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents held or due in a foreign currency. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents]

tlabel: Employee benefits expense
doc: The expense of all forms of consideration given by an entity in exchange for a service rendered by employees or for the termination of employment.

tlabel: Employer contributions
doc: The amount of employer contributions to retirement benefit plans.

tlabel: Equity
doc: The amount of residual interest in the assets of the entity after deducting all its liabilities.

tlabel: Equity and liabilities
doc: The amount of the entity's equity and liabilities. [Refer: Equity; Liabilities]

tlabel: Equity attributable to owners of parent
doc: The amount of equity attributable to the owners of the parent. This specifically excludes non-controlling interest.

tlabel: Equity instruments held
doc: The amount of instruments held by the entity that provide evidence of a residual interest in the assets of another entity after deducting all of its liabilities.

tlabel: Equity interests of acquirer
doc: The fair value, at the acquisition date, of equity interests of the acquirer transferred as consideration in a business combination. [Refer: Business combinations [member]]

tlabel: Equity reclassified into financial liabilities
doc: The amount of equity reclassified into financial liabilities. [Refer: Equity; Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Estimated financial effect of contingent liabilities
doc: The amount of the estimated financial effect of contingent liabilities. [Refer: Contingent liabilities [member]]

tlabel: Expense arising from exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources
doc: The amount of expense arising from the search for mineral resources, including minerals, oil, natural gas and similar non-regenerative resources after the entity has obtained legal rights to explore in a specific area, as well as the determination of the technical feasibility and commercial viability of extracting the mineral resource.

tlabel: Expense arising from insurance contracts
doc: The amount of expense arising from insurance contracts. [Refer: Types of insurance contracts [member]]

tlabel: Expenses, by nature
doc: The amount of expenses aggregated according to their nature (for example, depreciation, purchases of materials, transport costs, employee benefits and advertising costs), and not reallocated among functions within the entity.

tlabel: Expense due to unwinding of discount on provisions
doc: The amount of expense recognised due to the unwinding of the discount on provisions, resulting from the effect of the passage of time. [Refer: Other provisions]

tlabel: Expense for policyholder claims and benefits, without reduction for reinsurance held
doc: The amount of expense for policyholder claims and benefits, without any reduction for reinsurance held.

tlabel: Expense from cash-settled share-based payment transactions in which goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets
doc: The amount of expense arising from cash-settled share-based payment transactions in which the goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets. [Refer: Expense from share-based payment transactions in which goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets]

tlabel: Expense from equity-settled share-based payment transactions in which goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets
doc: The amount of expense arising from equity-settled share-based payment transactions in which the goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets. [Refer: Expense from share-based payment transactions in which goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets]

tlabel: Expense from share-based payment transactions in which goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets
doc: The amount of expense arising from share-based payment transactions in which the goods or services received did not qualify for recognition as assets.

tlabel: Expense from share-based payment transactions with employees
doc: The amount of expense from share-based payment transactions with employees.

tlabel: Expense of restructuring activities
doc: The amount of expense relating to restructuring. Restructuring is a programme that is planned and controlled by management and materially changes either the scope of a business undertaken by an entity or the manner in which that business is conducted. Such programmes include: (a) the sale or termination of a line of business; (b) closure of business locations in a country or region or the relocation of activities from one country or region to another; (c) changes in management structure; and (d) fundamental reorganisations that have a material effect on the nature and focus of the entity's operations.

tlabel: Expenses arising from reinsurance held
doc: The amount of expenses relating to reinsurance contracts held.

tlabel: Fair value gain (loss) that would have been recognised in profit or loss or other comprehensive income if financial liabilities had not been reclassified as measured at amortised cost, initial application of IFRS 9
doc: The fair value gain (loss) that would have been recognised in profit or loss or other comprehensive income if financial liabilities had not been reclassified so that they are measured at amortised cost as a result of the transition to IFRS 9. [Refer: Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Investments in equity instruments designated at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of investments in equity instruments that the entity has designated at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Fee and commission expense
doc: The amount of expense relating to fees and commissions.

tlabel: Fee and commission income
doc: The amount of income relating to fees and commissions.

tlabel: Fee and commission income (expense)
doc: The amount of income or expense relating to fees and commissions.

tlabel: Finance costs
doc: The amount of costs associated with financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Finance costs paid, classified as operating activities
doc: The cash outflow for finance costs paid, classified as operating activities. [Refer: Finance costs]

tlabel: Finance income
doc: The amount of income associated with interest and other financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Finance income (cost)
doc: The amount of income or cost associated with interest and other financing activities of the entity.

tlabel: Finance income (expenses) from reinsurance contracts held recognised in profit or loss
doc: The amount of finance income (expenses) from reinsurance contracts held that is recognised in profit or loss. [Refer: Insurance finance income (expenses); Reinsurance contracts held [member]]

tlabel: Finance income received, classified as operating activities
doc: The cash inflow from finance income received, classified as operating activities. [Refer: Finance income]

tlabel: Financial assets
doc: The amount of assets that are: (a) cash; (b) an equity instrument of another entity; (c) a contractual right: (i) to receive cash or another financial asset from another entity; or (ii) to exchange financial assets or financial liabilities with another entity under conditions that are potentially favourable to the entity; or (d) a contract that will, or may be, settled in the entitys own equity instruments and is: (i) a non-derivative for which the entity is, or may be, obliged to receive a variable number of the entitys own equity instruments; or (ii) a derivative that will, or may be, settled other than by the exchange of a fixed amount of cash or another financial asset for a fixed number of the entitys own equity instruments. For this purpose the entitys own equity instruments do not include puttable financial instruments classified as equity instruments in accordance with paragraphs 16A-16B of IAS 32, instruments that impose on the entity an obligation to deliver to another party a pro rata share of the net assets of the entity only on liquidation and are classified as equity instruments in accordance with paragraphs 16C-16D of IAS 32, or instruments that are contracts for the future receipt or delivery of the entitys own equity instruments. [Refer: Financial instruments, class [member]; Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Financial assets at amortised cost
doc: The amount of financial assets at amortised cost. The amortised cost is the amount at which financial assets are measured at initial recognition minus principal repayments, plus or minus the cumulative amortisation using the effective interest method of any difference between that initial amount and the maturity amount, and adjusted for any impairment. [Refer: Financial assets]

tlabel: Financial assets, at fair value
doc: The fair value of financial assets. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets]

tlabel: Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets; Other comprehensive income]

tlabel: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of financial assets that are measured at fair value and for which gains (losses) are recognised in profit or loss. A financial asset shall be measured at fair value through profit or loss unless it is measured at amortised cost or at fair value through other comprehensive income. A gain (loss) on a financial asset measured at fair value shall be recognised in profit or loss unless it is part of a hedging relationship, it is an investment in an equity instrument for which the entity has elected to present gains and losses in other comprehensive income or it is a financial asset measured at fair value through other comprehensive income. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets]

tlabel: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, classified as held for trading
doc: The amount of financial assets at fair value through profit or loss classified as held for trading. A financial asset is classified as held for trading if: (a) it is acquired principally for the purpose of selling it in the near term; (b) on initial recognition it is part of a portfolio of identified financial instruments that are managed together and for which there is evidence of a recent actual pattern of short-term profit-taking; or (c) it is a derivative (except for a derivative that is a financial guarantee contract or a designated and effective hedging instrument). [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently
doc: The amount of financial assets at fair value through profit or loss that were designated as such upon initial recognition or subsequently. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss, mandatorily measured at fair value
doc: The amount of financial assets mandatorily measured at fair value through profit or loss in accordance with IFRS 9. [Refer: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Financial assets available-for-sale
doc: The amount of non-derivative financial assets that are designated as available for sale or are not classified as (a) loans and receivables; (b) held-to-maturity investments; or (c) financial assets at fair value through profit or loss. [Refer: Derivative financial assets; Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss; Held-to-maturity investments]

tlabel: Financial assets measured at fair value through other comprehensive income
doc: The amount of financial assets that are measured at fair value through other comprehensive income. A financial asset shall be measured at fair value through other comprehensive income if both of the following conditions are met: (a) the financial asset is held within a business model whose objective is achieved by both collecting contractual cash flows and selling financial assets and (b) the contractual terms of the financial asset give rise on specified dates to cash flows that are solely payments of principal and interest on the principal amount outstanding. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial assets]

tlabel: Financial assets pledged as collateral for liabilities or contingent liabilities
doc: The amount of financial assets that the entity has pledged as collateral for liabilities or contingent liabilities, including amounts that have been reclassified in accordance with paragraph 3.2.23(a) of IFRS 9. [Refer: Contingent liabilities [member]; Financial assets]

tlabel: Financial liabilities
doc: The amount of liabilities that are: (a) a contractual obligation: (i) to deliver cash or another financial asset to another entity; or (ii) to exchange financial assets or financial liabilities with another entity under conditions that are potentially unfavourable to the entity; or (b) a contract that will, or may be, settled in the entitys own equity instruments and is: (i) a non-derivative for which the entity is, or may be, obliged to deliver a variable number of the entitys own equity instruments; or (ii) a derivative that will, or may be, settled other than by the exchange of a fixed amount of cash or another financial asset for a fixed number of the entitys own equity instruments. For this purpose, rights, options or warrants to acquire a fixed number of the entitys own equity instruments for a fixed amount of any currency are equity instruments if the entity offers the rights, options or warrants pro rata to all of its existing owners of the same class of its own non-derivative equity instruments. Also, for those purposes the entitys own equity instruments do not include puttable financial instruments that are classified as equity instruments in accordance with paragraphs 16A-16B of IAS 32, instruments that impose on the entity an obligation to deliver to another party a pro rata share of the net assets of the entity only on liquidation and are classified as equity instruments in accordance with paragraphs 16C-16D of IAS 32, or instruments that are contracts for the future receipt or delivery of the entitys own equity instruments. As an exception, an instrument that meets the definition of a financial liability is classified as an equity instrument if it has all the features and meets the conditions in paragraphs 16A-16B or paragraphs 16C-16D of IAS 32. [Refer: Financial instruments, class [member]; Financial assets; Derivatives [member]]

tlabel: Financial liabilities at amortised cost
doc: The amount of financial liabilities at amortised cost. The amortised cost is the amount at which financial liabilities are measured at initial recognition minus principal repayments, plus or minus the cumulative amortisation using the effective interest method of any difference between that initial amount and the maturity amount. [Refer: Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss
doc: The amount of financial liabilities that meet either of the following conditions: (a) they meet the definition of held for trading; or (b) upon initial recognition they are designated by the entity as at fair value through profit or loss. An entity may use this designation only when permitted by paragraph 4.3.5 of IFRS 9 (embedded derivatives) or when doing so results in more relevant information, because either: (a) it eliminates or significantly reduces a measurement or recognition inconsistency (sometimes referred to as an accounting mismatch) that would otherwise arise from measuring assets or liabilities or recognising the gains and losses on them on different bases; or (b) a group of financial liabilities or financial assets and financial liabilities is managed and its performance is evaluated on a fair value basis, in accordance with a documented risk management or investment strategy, and information about the group is provided internally on that basis to the entitys key management personnel (as defined in IAS 24). [Refer: At fair value [member]; Key management personnel of entity or parent [member]; Derivatives [member]; Financial assets; Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that meet definition of held for trading
doc: The amount of financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that meet the definition of held for trading. A financial liability is classified as held for trading if: (a) it is acquired or incurred principally for the purpose of selling or repurchasing it in the near term; (b) on initial recognition it is part of a portfolio of identified financial instruments that are managed together and for which there is evidence of a recent actual pattern of short-term profit-taking; or (c) it is a derivative (except for a derivative that is a financial guarantee contract or a designated and effective hedging instrument). [Refer: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently
doc: The amount of financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss that were designated as such upon initial recognition or subsequently. [Refer: At fair value [member]; Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss]

tlabel: Financial liabilities reclassified into equity
doc: The amount of financial liabilities reclassified into equity. [Refer: Equity; Financial liabilities]

tlabel: Fixtures and fittings
doc: The amount of fixtures and fittings, not permanently attached to real property, used in the entity's operations.

tlabel: Gain (loss) on cessation of consolidation of subsidiaries due to change of investment entity status
doc: The gain (loss) arising on the cessation of the consolidation of subsidiaries due to the change of investment entity status. [Refer: Disclosure of investment entities [text block]; Subsidiaries [member]]

tlabel: Gain (loss) on designation of financial instrument as measured at fair value through profit or loss because credit derivative is used to manage credit risk
doc: The gain (loss) recognised on designation of a financial instrument, or a proportion of it, as measured at fair value through profit or loss, because a credit derivative is used to manage the credit risk of that financial instrument. [Refer: Credit risk [member]; Derivatives [member]; Financial instruments, class [member]]

tlabel: Gain (loss) on hedge ineffectiveness recognised in profit or loss
doc: The gain (loss) recognised in profit or loss on hedge ineffectiveness. [Refer: Gain (loss) on hedge ineffectiveness]

tlabel: Gain (loss) on remeasurement, net defined benefit liability (asset)
doc: The decrease (increase) in a net defined benefit liability (asset) resulting from the remeasurement of that net defined benefit liability (asset). [Refer: Net defined benefit liability (asset)]

tlabel: Held-to-maturity investments

An entity shall not classify any financial assets as held to maturity if the entity has, during the current financial year or during the two preceding financial years, sold or reclassified more than an insignificant amount of held-to-maturity investments before maturity (more than insignificant in relation to the total amount of held-to-maturity investments) other than sales or reclassifications that: (i) are so close to maturity or the financial assets call date (for example, less than three months before maturity) that changes in the market rate of interest would not have a significant effect on the financial assets fair value; (ii) occur after the entity has collected substantially all of the financial assets original principal through scheduled payments or prepayments; or (iii) are attributable to an isolated event that is beyond the entitys control, is non-recurring and could not have been reasonably anticipated by the entity. [Refer: Derivative financial assets; Held-to-maturity investments; Prepayments]

[Refer: Revenue]

tlabel: Inventories
doc: The amount of assets: (a) held for sale in the ordinary course of business; (b) in the process of production for such sale; or (c) in the form of materials or supplies to be consumed in the production process or in the rendering of services. Inventories encompass goods purchased and held for resale including, for example, merchandise purchased by a retailer and held for resale, or land and other property held for resale. Inventories also encompass finished goods produced, or work in progress being produced, by the entity and include materials and supplies awaiting use in the production process. [Refer: Current finished goods; Current merchandise; Current work in progress; Land]

tlabel: Investments accounted for using equity method

The equity method is a method of accounting whereby the investment is initially recognised at cost and adjusted thereafter for the post-acquisition change in the investor's share of net assets of the investee. The investor's profit or loss includes its share of the profit or loss of the investee. The investor's other comprehensive income includes its share of the other comprehensive income of the investee. [Refer: At cost [member]]

tlabel: Investments for risk of policyholders

doc: Expiry date 2020-01-01: The amount of present obligations of the entity arising from past events, the settlement of which is expected to result in an outflow from the entity of resources embodying economic benefits.Effective 2020-01-01: The amount of a present obligation of the entity to transfer an economic resource as a result of past events. [Refer: Share-based payment arrangements [member]]
